title:
Positioning as the Sole Solver in High-value Accounts
How to Move from Zero to Preferred Partner in Six Months
affiliations: Fondazione ITS Meccatronica e Avionica

detail.title:
Positioning as the Sole Solver in High-value Accounts
How to Move from Zero to Preferred Partner in Six Months
detail.abstract:
The canonical doctrine of B2B positioning — articulated across decades of marketing
literature, from Ries and Trout's foundational work through the contemporary
frameworks taught in business schools across the world — rests on a premise that is
structurally incompatible with the realities of high-value account-based selling. That
premise is this: that positioning is an act performed toward a market, that its audience
is a category of buyers, and that its goal is to occupy a distinct and memorable place
in the collective mind of an industry segment.
In high-value B2B, this is not merely imprecise. It is dangerous.
This paper argues that traditional positioning, applied to complex, high-stakes B2B
accounts, produces exactly the wrong outcome: it makes you intelligible to everyone
and indispensable to no one. It optimises for recognition at the category level while
destroying the very specificity that a strategic account requires before it will extend
trust — and, ultimately, a contract.
The alternative proposed here is not a refinement of traditional positioning doctrine. It
is a structural inversion. Rather than asking "how do we want to be known in the
market?", the sole-solver approach begins with a categorically different question:
"what does this specific account need to believe about us, based on what we know
about their most urgent and career-defining problems?"
The methodology draws on the ABM research base — Bain & Company's shortlist
evidence, the Ehrenberg-Bass 95-5 rule, the Edelman-LinkedIn 2025 thought
leadership data, Forrester's buying group dynamics, Romaniuk's Category Entry Point
research — and integrates it with Fritjof Capra's systems thinking, the neuroscience of
trust, and the emerging paradigm of Generative Engine Optimization as a new layer of
physical availability in the pre-signal window. The execution sequence is developed
across complex manufacturing and industrial B2B engagements.
The conclusion is a six-month operational architecture for moving from complete
invisibility inside a high-value account to the position no competitor can easily displace: the vendor the buying group had already decided to trust before the formal
process began.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统B2B定位理论在高价值大客户销售中的适用性，提出了一种结构性反转的“唯一解决方案者”定位方法，强调针对特定账户的深度信任构建而非市场层面的品类占位。
AI.research_question: 传统B2B定位理论在高价值、基于账户的复杂销售场景中为何失效？如何构建一种替代性的定位框架？
AI.motivation: 传统定位理论（如Ries和Trout的框架）假定定位的对象是市场、受众是买家类别、目标是占据行业心智中的独特位置，但这种“面向市场”的定位逻辑在高价值B2B账户中适得其反——使供应商对所有人可理解却对任何人不可或缺，破坏了获取信任和合同所需的特异性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了ABM研究基础（Bain短名单证据、Ehrenberg-Bass 95-5规则、Edelman-LinkedIn思想领导力数据、Forrester购买群体动态、Romaniuk类别入口点研究）、Capra系统思维、信任神经科学，以及生成式引擎优化的新兴范式。
AI.method: 基于ABM研究基础的跨学科理论整合，并在复杂制造和工业B2B场景中进行执行序列开发。
AI.findings: 传统定位使供应商在品类层面可被识别，但在关键账户层面无法建立深度信任；替代方案——“唯一解决方案者”定位——通过从“市场需要知道什么”转向“这个具体账户需要相信什么”的结构性反转，构建在正式流程开始前已被购买群体信任的不可替代地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战并颠覆了延续数十年的传统B2B定位教条，提出了定位理论的结构性反转，将ABM、系统思维、信任神经科学和GEO等领域整合为新的定位框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个六个月的运营架构，指导高价值B2B企业从在关键账户中完全不可见，转变为在正式采购流程开始前已被信任的供应商，从而获得不可替代的竞争优势。

title: The AIAS™ Presence Measurement Protocol: Multi-Statistic C2 Specification and Two-Channel Recall Decomposition

detail.title: The AIAS™ Presence Measurement Protocol: Multi-Statistic C2 Specification and Two-Channel Recall Decomposition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by Samsung Electronics America (Director, Corporate Brand Creative and Governance). The AIAS™ Presence Measurement Protocol and the work reported here are the author's independent academic research, conducted outside the scope of employment, in the author's role as faculty at the School of Visual Arts MPS Branding Program and founder of Third System™. Samsung had no role in the design, execution, analysis, or interpretation of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable; no human subjects. The methodology specification reported in this paper consists of refinements to measurement protocol; the empirical anchor data is drawn from publicly-deposited prior phases (osf.io/ec6wh/v17/, osf.io/ec6wh/v18/, osf.io/ec6wh/v19/) whose ethics declarations carry forward unchanged.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: The AIAS™ Presence Measurement Protocol operationalizes AI Availability-the brand-level probability of retrieval, recommendation, or selection by an AI intermediary-as a measurable construct alongside Ehrenberg-Bass Mental Availability and Physical Availability. Protocol v1.4 (SSRN 6799479) refined AI Availability into a multi-component construct decomposing Recognition (Phase A C_P anchoring) and Recall (Phase B mention rate), empirically anchored on the v0.17 Iwachu dissociation case from a single crosscultural substrate. Joint v0.18 (SSRN 6806558) and v0.19 (SSRN 6809182) acquisitions strengthened the anchor base to thirteen Recognition-without-Recall cases across three substrate families, but in doing so surfaced two methodology refinements that v1.4's specifications cannot accommodate without revision. This paper specifies v1.5, which supersedes v1.4 on two specifications: (a) C2 within-cell adequacy moves from single-statistic modal-share to multi-statistic distinct-value-count plus modal-share, resolving the boundary failure observed at v0.19 Cell A_Heritage (modal share = 0.500 against the strict-less-than threshold) while preserving the defensive function against degenerate distributions observed at v0.18 Cells A and C (modal share = 0.875); and (b) Recall canonicalizes into two channels-R_cat (category-anchored) and R_cult (cultural-footprint)-formalizing the v0.18 §4.3 sensitivity finding and the v0.19 six-frame operationalization that surfaced three Type 1 (category-channel-preferred) dissociation cases. The refinements lock numerical thresholds for v0.20+ pre-registration: C2 requires distinct C_P values ≥ 3 ∧ modal share ≤ 0.625; Iwachu-pattern requires C_P ≥ 5/6 ∧ R_cat ≤ 2/18; Type 1 requires R_cat ≥ 5/18 ∧ R_cult ≤ 2/18; Type 2 requires R_cat ≤ 2/18 ∧ R_cult ≥ 5/18. v1.5 preserves v1.4's multi-component Recognition × Recall construct, the C_P anchoring operationalization, and the Balanced (w_R = 0.5, w_C = 0.5) and Recall-leaning (w_R = 0.3, w_C = 0.7) reference weightings unchanged. No new acquisition is reported; calibration is retrospective against the joint v0.18 + v0.19 anchor base. The canonical methodology citation set is updated to (6761698, 6797679, 6799479, [this paper]).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AIAS™存在测量协议的v1.5版本，将AI可用性（品牌被AI中介检索、推荐或选择的概率）操作化为可测量构念，并对v1.4的两个技术规范进行了修订：其一是改进C2单元格内充分性的判定标准，解决边界失败问题；其二是将Recall正规化为两个通道（类别锚定与文化足迹），并锁定了v0.20+预注册的数值阈值。
AI.research_question: 如何将AI可用性——品牌被AI中介检索、推荐或选择的概率——操作化为一个可测量的构念，并完善其测量协议？
AI.motivation: v1.4协议在v0.18和v0.19的实证锚定中暴露了两个方法论缺陷：C2单元格内充分性的边界失效问题（v0.19的A_Heritage单元模态份额恰好为0.500，与严格小于阈值冲突），以及Recall的敏感性发现和类型1解离案例的出现，表明需要将Recall规范化为双通道结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ehrenberg-Bass学派的Mental Availability（心智可用性）和Physical Availability（物理可用性）框架，将AI Availability（AI可用性）作为与二者并列的第三个品牌可用性维度，采用Recognition（再认）×Recall（回记）的多组分构念设计。
AI.method: 规范修订与回顾性校准：基于13个"再认无回记"案例（跨三个底物家族）的联合实证锚定，对v1.4的C2判定标准（从单统计量众数份额改为多统计量不同值计数+众数份额）和Recall规范（拆分为R_cat类别锚定和R_cult文化足迹两个通道）进行修订，并锁定v0.20+预注册的数值阈值。
AI.findings: v1.5版本解决了v0.19中A_Heritage单元的边界失败问题（新标准要求不同C_P值≥3且众数份额≤0.625），同时保留了v0.18中A和C单元对退化分布（众数份额=0.875）的防御功能；将Recall双通道化后，能够形式化处理v0.18的敏感性发现和v0.19中出现的三个类型1解离案例；锁定了Iwachu模式、类型1和类型2的数值阈值，为v0.20+预注册奠定基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 在Ehrenberg-Bass心智可用性/物理可用性二元框架基础上，正式将AI可用性确立为品牌可用性的第三个维度，并提供了精细化的测量协议，完善了品牌在AI中介环境中的理论化表述。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌管理者提供了可操作的AI可用性测量工具，使其能够量化品牌在AI中介（如智能助手、推荐系统）中的可见性和被选择概率，支持品牌在AI时代的资产管理和战略决策。

title: When Biased Agents Trade: Anchoring, Exploitation, and Market Failure in Agent-to-Agent Interactions

detail.title: When Biased Agents Trade: Anchoring, Exploitation, and Market Failure in Agent-to-Agent Interactions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am grateful to Professor Cass R. Sunstein at Harvard Law School for his guidance and feedback throughout the development of this project. An earlier version of this paper was written for HLS 2589: Behavioral Economics, Law, and Public Policy, Spring 2026.

detail.abstract: Large language models have well-documented behavioral biases, but all existing evidence comes from single-agent settings. This paper asks what happens when two biased LLMs meet in a commercial transaction. Across 8,341 controlled interactions on three frontier models, agents anchor on first offers about 40% more strongly than humans, yet resist information overload, largely ignore decoy products, and bid at equilibrium in auctions. Anchoring is the bias that breaks markets: a few dollars of price distortion per negotiation collapses a multiagent marketplace from 94% to 17% efficiency as sellers price themselves out and buyers walk away. When one side knows the bias, it captures up to 77% of available surplus. Naming the bias in a warning recovers two-thirds of the loss; telling the agent to reason step by step backfires, because deliberation makes the anchor more salient, not less. The three models fail in different ways, complicating any uniform regulatory response.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两大语言模型在商业交易中的行为偏差，发现锚定偏差是破坏市场效率的关键因素，且不同模型以不同方式失败。
AI.research_question: 当两个存在行为偏差的LLM在商业交易中相遇时，会发生什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献仅关注单智能体情境下的LLM偏差，但现实中的AI代理（如自动谈判）是多智能体交互的，偏差可能产生系统性市场影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的锚定效应、信息过载、诱饵效应、拍卖均衡理论等。
AI.method: 对三种前沿模型进行了8,341次受控交互实验，模拟商业交易场景。
AI.findings: （1）LLM的锚定效应比人类强约40%；（2）LLM能抵抗信息过载、忽略诱饵产品、在拍卖中实现均衡出价；（3）锚定是破坏市场的关键偏差——每笔谈判几美元的价格扭曲就使多智能体市场效率从94%暴跌至17%；（4）知晓偏差的一方可攫取高达77%的剩余；（5）警告可挽回三分之二损失，而"逐步推理"适得其反，因为深思使锚更显著；（6）三种模型以不同方式失败，使统一监管复杂化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示多智能体LLM交互中的偏差放大效应及市场崩溃机制，挑战了"逐步推理"的普适有效性，并为行为经济学中的锚定研究提供了AI语境下的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI监管（如命名偏差警告）提供了实证依据，提示自动谈判系统的设计需警惕锚定效应，且统一监管策略可能无效。

title: Economic Model and Protocol Architecture A Position Paper for Central Banks, Financial Regulators, International Standards Bodies, and Institutional Policymakers

detail.title: Economic Model and Protocol Architecture A Position Paper for Central Banks, Financial Regulators, International Standards Bodies, and Institutional Policymakers

declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is submitted as a regulatory and institutional position paper. It describes the economic model and protocol architecture of the IAEX Genesis X-1 Trust Ledger Infrastructure. The paper does not constitute legal advice, financial advice, or investment recommendation. No proprietary implementation methods are disclosed. All cost estimates are drawn from cited institutional sources or are explicitly marked as conservative analytical estimates. The paper is intended for central banks, international standards bodies, regulatory architects, competent authorities, and policy institutions engaged with the evidentiary requirements of enacted compliance mandates across pharmaceuticals, batteries, minerals, chemicals, food, financial services, AI accountability, and cross-border trade. Simultaneous submission to: BIS Innovation Hub, UN/CEFACT UNTP Working Group, OECD Trade and Agriculture Directorate, EU Commission DG GROW, and OECD Forum on Responsible Mineral Supply Chains.' Author contact: Abhishek Tiwari leadership@iaexnetwork.com

detail.abstract:
Every significant regulatory framework enacted over the past decade -across pharmaceuticals, batteries, critical minerals, chemicals, food safety, financial services, artificial intelligence, and cross-border trade - assumes that verifiable, temporally-anchored, actor-attributed records of material events exist in the governed system. In most cases, they do not. This infrastructure gap is not a compliance failure. It is an architectural failure, and its economic cost is measured in hundreds of billions of dollars annually across fraud, failed recalls, slow settlement, and inadequate cross-border regulatory cooperation.

This paper presents the economic model and protocol architecture of the IAEX Genesis X-1 Trust Ledger: constitutional evidence infrastructure designed to close this gap. The analysis establishes seven constitutional invariants as economic commitments to regulatory authorities, examines compliance cost reduction across ten regulated sectors, and models the network effects that determine adoption trajectory. Sector-level ROI analysis demonstrates break-even within 12 to 24 months for large participants, with aggregate systemic benefit estimated in the hundreds of billions annually at full adoption.

The paper addresses governance architecture, institutional failure economics, comparison to structural alternatives (document systems, national databases, public and permissioned blockchains), risk analysis, and a four-phase implementation timeline. It is submitted as a resource for central banks, international standards bodies, regulatory architects, and policy institutions engaged with the evidentiary requirements of enacted compliance mandates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并论证了IAEX Genesis X-1信任账本作为一种"宪法性证据基础设施"，旨在弥合全球监管框架所要求的可验证、时间锚定、主体归因的事件记录与现实基础设施之间的巨大鸿沟，并展示了其在十个受监管行业中降低合规成本、实现数百亿美元系统性收益的经济模型与协议架构。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和构建一种能够满足全球各行业监管框架所要求的可验证、时间锚定、主体归因事件记录的基础设施，并以经济上可行的方式弥合现有"架构性失败"？
AI.motivation: 过去十年间，制药、电池、关键矿产、化学品、食品安全、金融服务、人工智能、跨境贸易等领域的每一个重要监管框架，都假设治理系统中存在可验证、时间锚定、主体归因的物质事件记录——但大多数情况下，这种记录并不存在。这一基础设施缺口不是合规失败，而是架构性失败，其年度经济成本高达数千亿美元（涵盖欺诈、召回失败、结算缓慢、跨境监管合作不足等）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 宪法性证据基础设施理论——将七项宪法性不变量作为对监管当局的经济承诺；2) 制度失败经济学——分析现有文档系统、国家数据库、公有链和许可链等替代方案的结构性缺陷；3) 网络效应模型——决定采用轨迹的经济动力学；4) 合规成本降低模型——跨十个受监管行业的投资回报率分析。
AI.method: 1) 经济模型构建：建立IAEX Genesis X-1信任账本的经济协议模型；2) 跨行业分析：涵盖十个受监管行业的合规成本降低分析；3) 投资回报率（ROI）分析：按行业进行参与者层面的盈亏平衡测算；4) 网络效应建模：模拟采用轨迹；5) 比较制度分析：与文档系统、国家数据库、公有链和许可链等结构替代方案进行比较；6) 风险分析与实施路线图规划（四阶段）。
AI.findings: 1) 七个宪法性不变量被确立为对监管当局的经济承诺；2) 大型参与者在12至24个月内可实现盈亏平衡；3) 完全采用后，年度系统性收益估计可达数千亿美元；4) 现有替代方案（文档系统、国家数据库、公有链、许可链）均存在结构性缺陷，无法满足监管要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"宪法性证据基础设施"概念，将不变量理论引入监管合规领域；2) 从制度失败经济学视角重新定义基础设施缺口为"架构性失败"而非合规失败；3) 建立跨行业合规成本降低与网络效应相结合的经济学分析框架；4) 为监管架构设计提供基于证据基础设施的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为中央银行、国际标准机构、监管架构师和政策机构提供可操作的合规基础设施方案；2) 提供四阶段实施路线图；3) 通过跨行业ROI分析为大型参与者提供投资决策依据；4) 识别并量化现有替代方案的局限性，指导基础设施选型；5) 提出降低欺诈、召回失败、结算缓慢和跨境监管合作不足等问题的系统性解决方案。

title: Partisan Homogeneity at Work: Employee Satisfaction, Human Capital, and Labor Productivity
affiliations: Georgetown University - Department of Accounting and Business Law, , Georgetown University - Department of Accounting and Business Law and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Charlotte - Finance

detail.title: Partisan Homogeneity at Work: Employee Satisfaction, Human Capital, and Labor Productivity
detail.abstract: We merge employment records for 24 million individuals with U.S. voter registration data from 2012 to 2022 to examine how workplace political homogeneity affects corporate behavior. Greater homogeneity, defined as the absolute difference between Republican and Democratic employee shares, boosts employee job satisfaction and improves perceptions of corporate culture. These effects are concentrated among firms with more voters and in areas with strong hostility toward the other party. Homogeneous firms attract more talent, particularly highly educated, innovation-oriented workers. In support of the Social Identity Theory, these results suggest that partisan homophily reduces interpersonal friction and fosters psychological safety. Workplace homogeneity drives labor productivity and innovation gains. These economic effects center on firms with strong employee perceptions of culture and high worker inflows. In addition, results are mostly driven by non-executive employees, highlighting the importance of examining partisan homogeneity through the ranks. Our findings suggest that political alignment among employees acts as a non-pecuniary amenity, enhancing innovation by improving firm culture and attracting high-caliber human capital.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2012-2022年2400万美国个体的就业与选民登记数据，研究发现职场政治同质性（共和党与民主党员工比例差异的绝对值）能提升员工工作满意度、改善企业文化认知，并吸引高素质人才，最终提升劳动生产率和创新能力。这种效应在政治敌意较强的地区和员工文化感知较好的企业中更为显著，且主要由非高管员工驱动，支持了社会认同理论。
AI.research_question: 职场政治同质性如何影响企业行为，包括员工满意度、人才吸引、劳动生产率及创新能力？
AI.motivation: 在美国政治极化加剧的背景下，政治认同日益渗透到职场环境中。然而，现有研究对职场内部政治同质性的经济后果知之甚少，尤其是它对企业文化、人才流动和创新绩效的因果效应。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会认同理论（Social Identity Theory）：个体倾向于与同类群体成员互动，政治同质性可减少人际摩擦、增强心理安全感，从而提升协作效率和组织绩效。
AI.method: 将2400万个体的就业记录与2012-2022年美国选民登记数据进行匹配，构建企业层面的政治同质性指标，采用回归分析检验其对员工满意度、企业文化、人才吸引、劳动生产率和创新产出的影响，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 政治同质性提升员工工作满意度和企业文化感知，该效应集中在有更多选民的企业及政治敌意强的地区。2. 同质性企业更能吸引高素质、创新导向的人才。3. 职场同质性驱动劳动生产率和创新增长效应主要通过员工文化感知和人才流入渠道实现。4. 结果主要由非高管员工驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社会认同理论提供了大样本、跨时间的企业层面实证证据，揭示了政治同质性作为一种非货币性福利通过减少人际摩擦和增强心理安全感影响企业绩效的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒企业管理层和决策者关注职场政治多元化与同质性的平衡：政治同质性虽能提升短期效率和创新，但可能带来群体思维和排斥异见的长期风险，对招聘策略和文化建设具有重要启示。

title: Silent Exposure: A Comparative Study of Metadata Leakage in Encrypted Messaging Applications and Its Role in Adversarial Persona Reconstruction

detail.title: Silent Exposure: A Comparative Study of Metadata Leakage in Encrypted Messaging Applications and Its Role in Adversarial Persona Reconstruction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research received no external funding and was conducted independently as part of academic study at the University of Petroleum and Energy Studies (UPES), Dehradun, India.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a computer science systems analysis paper. The study is based entirely on publicly documented platform behaviours, published privacy policies, prior academic literature, and publicly available legal proceedings. No human participants, personal data, patient records, or primary data collection involving individuals was conducted.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded. No external grants, institutional funding, or commercial sponsorship supported this work.

detail.abstract: End-to-end encryption (E2EE) has become the de facto security standard in modern messaging applications, protecting message content from interception. However, the metadata accompanying these communications-timing, presence signals, network endpoints, socialgraph structure, and behavioural patterns-remains largely unprotected and constitutes a rich signal for adversarial inference. This paper presents a comparative empirical study of metadata leakage across six widely deployed messaging platforms: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, Signal, iMessage, and Android Messages (RCS). We introduce a fivedimensional Metadata Leakage Taxonomy (MLT) and a composite Metadata Leakage Score (MLS) that quantifies per-platform exposure across identity, presence, network, social, and behavioural dimensions. Using a synthetic dataset comprising 30 days of simulated presence logs (842 session records across two platforms) and 1,000 simulated message interactions, we demonstrate that a passive adversary can reconstruct a user's daily schedule with a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of under 30 minutes for all schedule attributes after 14 days of observation. Specifically, wake time is reconstructed with MAE ≈9 min, sleep time with MAE ≈3 min, and work hours with MAE ≤30 min. We further show that cross-platform metadata correlation reduces the required observation window to achieve 80% Adversarial Persona Build (APB) completeness from 15 days (WhatsApp alone) to 9 days, a 40% reduction. Facebook Messenger and Android Messages (RCS) achieve the highest MLS scores (6.89 and 6.70 respectively), while Signal achieves the lowest (3.75), reflecting its privacy-bydesign architecture. Our findings underscore that E2EE alone is insufficient and motivate standardised metadata minimisation practices.

AI.tldr: 本文对六大即时通讯平台（WhatsApp、Facebook Messenger、Telegram、Signal、iMessage、Android Messages RCS）的元数据泄露进行了比较实证研究，提出了五维元数据泄露分类法（MLT）和复合元数据泄露评分（MLS），发现被动对手可在14天内以MAE≤30分钟重建用户日程，跨平台关联可将攻击时间缩短40%，而Signal最低的MLS得分（3.75）表明其隐私设计最有效。
AI.research_question: 不同即时通讯平台在E2EE加密通信下的元数据泄露程度如何？被动对手能否利用元数据重建用户行为模式？
AI.motivation: 尽管E2EE已成为消息内容保护的标准，但通信元数据（时间、存在信号、网络端点、社交图谱、行为模式）仍大量暴露，构成严重的隐私威胁，现有研究缺乏对多平台元数据泄露的系统性比较和量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五维元数据泄露分类法（MLT）：身份维度、存在维度、网络维度、社交维度、行为维度；复合元数据泄露评分（MLS）；对抗性角色构建（APB）完整性指标。
AI.method: （1）构建五维MLT分类框架；（2）设计复合MLS评分体系；（3）合成数据集实验：30天模拟存在日志（842条会话记录）+ 1,000条模拟消息交互；（4）跨平台元数据关联分析。
AI.findings: （1）被动对手在14天观察后能以MAE≈9分钟重建起床时间、MAE≈3分钟重建睡眠时间、MAE≤30分钟重建工作时间；（2）跨平台元数据关联将80% APB完整性所需时间从15天（仅WhatsApp）降至9天（降幅40%）；（3）Facebook Messenger和Android Messages（RCS）的MLS最高（6.89和6.70），Signal最低（3.75）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统化的元数据泄露量化评估框架（MLT+MLS），为隐私安全研究提供了可比较、可复现的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 实证证明了E2EE不足以保护通信隐私，为平台和监管机构推动元数据最小化实践提供了数据支撑；提示用户应优先选择隐私设计更优的平台（如Signal）。

title: Type 2 Confirmation, Recognition Ceiling, and Phantom Brand Persistence on a Cosmetics IL-Gradient Substrate

detail.title: Type 2 Confirmation, Recognition Ceiling, and Phantom Brand Persistence on a Cosmetics IL-Gradient Substrate

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by Samsung Electronics America (Director, Corporate Brand Creative and Governance). The AIAS™ Presence Measurement Protocol and the work reported here are the author's independent academic research, conducted outside the scope of employment, in the author's role as faculty at the School of Visual Arts MPS Branding Program and founder of Third System™. Samsung had no role in the design, execution, analysis, or interpretation of this work. None of the 24 brands in the v0.21 registry is affiliated with Samsung Electronics America (pre-acquisition COI screen documented as DEVIATIONS Entry 0).
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable; no human subjects. The research uses publicly accessible LLM APIs queried with non-personal, category-anchored prompts.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

keywords: 5 C2 Replication on a Uniform-Saturation Substrate

detail.abstract:
The AIAS™ Presence Measurement Protocol operationalizes AI Availability — the brand-level probability of retrieval, recommendation, or selection by an AI intermediary — as a measurable construct alongside Ehrenberg-Bass Mental Availability and Physical Availability. Protocol v1.5 (SSRN 6810758) closed the methodology layer for v1.4's multi-component Recognition × Recall construct by adding a C2 multi-statistic adequacy rule (distinct C_P values ≥ 3 ∧ modal share ≤ 0.625) and a two-channel Recall decomposition (R_cat for category-canonical retrieval, R_cult for cultural-footprint retrieval). v0.20 (SSRN 6811441) was the first prospective phase under v1.5 and produced PARTIAL Type 2 emergence on a skincare substrate. This paper reports v0.21, the first replication phase under v1.5 — holding the protocol fixed and testing it on a substrate selected to maximize Cell B Identity Load.

The substrate is cosmetics, sampled across three cells stratified by Identity Load on the consumer-discovery surface: Cell A (prestige, medium IL: MAC Cosmetics, NARS, Bobbi Brown, Tom Ford Beauty, Giorgio Armani Beauty, Hourglass, Chantecaille, Laura Mercier), Cell B (celebrity-DTC / cult, high IL: Rare Beauty, Fenty Beauty, Haus Labs, Pat McGrath Labs, Charlotte Tilbury, Huda Beauty, Kylie Cosmetics, Anastasia Beverly Hills), and Cell C (drugstore / mass, low IL: Maybelline, L'Oréal Paris, CoverGirl, Revlon, NYX Professional Makeup, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Wet n Wild, Milani Cosmetics). Each cell carries 8 brands; worldwide n = 24 pre-floor. The reference panel is the locked six-slot v0.17 panel. Phase B uses a six-frame battery splitting cleanly across the v1.5 channels: q1–q3 anchor R_cat (best, makeup-artist-recommended, highest quality); q4–q6 anchor R_cult (popular, celebrity, viral/cult). Four pre-registered hypotheses are tested orthogonally.

The four hypotheses returned the following verdicts. H_Type2_emergence — the primary hypothesis for v0.21 — returned EMERGED with three Cell B cases clearing the ex-ante threshold (Rare Beauty: R_cat = 1, R_cult = 17; Huda Beauty: R_cat = 0, R_cult = 11; Kylie Cosmetics: R_cat = 0, R_cult = 5), plus a fourth Type 2 case in Cell C (e.l.f. Cosmetics: R_cat = 1, R_cult = 9) — the first out-of-cell Type 2 surface in the program. Rare Beauty's 1:17 channel split is the program's textbook Recognition × Recall dissociation. H_Regime4_cosmetics returned FALSIFIED at the regime-floor: C2 fails in all three cells by identical uniform-saturation shape (distinct = 1, modal share = 1.000 per cell). Cosmetics is a maximally-coded category at the Recognition channel — every panel brand scores C_P = 6/6 — collapsing the v1.5 framework's discrimination signal entirely into Recall. H_Dissociation_substrate_generalization returned GENERALIZED with Iwachu-pattern cases (C_P ≥ 5 ∧ R_cat ≤ 2) distributed across all three cells (13 cases total, the largest single-phase count in the program); the v1.4/v1.5 multi-component construct is now anchored across five substrate families. H_IdentityLoad_moderator (five-leg joint over v0.16 × v0.17 × v0.18 × v0.20 × v0.21; v0.19 excluded for uniform-IL design) returned NARROWED, driven by the v0.21 H_Regime4 falsification, despite the cleanest substantive IL channel-asymmetry signature in the program (Cell B R_cult-lead 2.83×; Cell A R_cat-lead 2.20×).

The v0.21 acquisition also surfaces an empirical regularity in the off-panel residual: Glossier (a v0.20 Cell B panel brand) appeared in cultural-channel frames for all six panel LLMs in q6 and three of six in q4 and q5 — the strongest single Phantom Brand Persistence demonstration in the program. Estée Lauder appeared in the canonical channel for all six models (R_cat = 13/18). The panel-internal scoring is correct under the locked methodology; the off-panel pattern is identified as a Protocol v1.6 measurement candidate. For AIAS™ 1.0's foundational construct, v0.21 completes the substrate breadth requirement (five families anchored, Type 2 quadrant populated above the EMERGED threshold for the first time) and identifies three v1.6 protocol increments. Pre-registration discipline (tag v0.21-prereg-r1, deposited at osf.io/ec6wh/v21/) locks panel, hypotheses, decision rules, and verdict matrices ex-ante.

AI.tldr: 本文报告AIAS™存在测量协议v1.5下的首次复制阶段（v0.21），以化妆品为基质检验协议稳定性。主要发现：Cell B出现Type 2涌现（如Rare Beauty的1:17通道分裂）；但Regime 4被证伪——化妆品类别在所有三个细胞中呈现最大编码状态（C_P = 6/6），使识别通道完全饱和；解离-基质泛化假设被支持（13个案例跨三个细胞分布）；身份负荷调节效应收窄。还发现了Glossier等"幻影品牌持续"现象。
AI.research_question: 在协议v1.5锁定后，以化妆品为基质进行首次复制阶段测试，检验四个预注册假设：H_Type2_emergence（Type 2涌现）、H_Regime4_cosmetics（化妆品领域的Regime 4）、H_Dissociation_substrate_generalization（解离-基质泛化）、H_IdentityLoad_moderator（身份负荷调节效应）。
AI.motivation: v0.20在护肤品基质上仅产生PARTIAL Type 2涌现，需要进一步检验协议v1.5在不同基质上的稳定性和判别力。化妆品基质被选为能最大化Cell B身份负荷的基质，以验证多组件构念的跨基质泛化能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: AIAS™存在测量协议（AI Availability），整合Ehrenberg-Bass心理可及性与物理可及性；多组件Recognition × Recall构念；C2多统计量充足性规则；双通道Recall分解（R_cat类别典则检索、R_cult文化足迹检索）；身份负荷（Identity Load）理论。
AI.method: 六帧电池测量，q1-q3锚定R_cat（最佳、化妆师推荐、最高质量），q4-q6锚定R_cult（流行、名人、病毒式/狂热）。24个品牌跨三个细胞分层抽样（Cell A prestige、Cell B celebrity-DTC/cult、Cell C drugstore/mass）。锁定v0.17参考面板。预注册于osf.io。四假设正交检验。
AI.findings: 1) H_Type2_emergence: 涌现，Cell B三个案例突破先验阈值（Rare Beauty 1:17, Huda Beauty 0:11, Kylie Cosmetics 0:5），Cell C e.l.f. Cosmetics出现首个出细胞Type 2表面；2) H_Regime4_cosmetics: 证伪，三个细胞均因均匀饱和形状（distinct=1, modal share=1.000）导致C2失败；3) H_Dissociation_substrate_generalization: 泛化，13个Iwachu模式案例分布三个细胞；4) H_IdentityLoad_moderator: 收窄，因Regime 4证伪；另发现Glossier的强幻影品牌持续现象和Estée Lauder的典则通道高得分。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次填充Type 2象限至涌现阈值以上；发现化妆品类别的最大编码状态（完全饱和的识别通道），揭示类别特性对AI存在测量框架的调制作用；解离模式跨五个基质家族锚定；识别出三个v1.6协议增量方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌AI存在（AI Availability）提供可操作化测量协议；揭示化妆品类别中识别通道完全饱和，品牌需更多依赖Recall通道（文化足迹/流行度）建立AI存在；Rare Beauty的1:17通道分裂为品牌AI战略提供典型案例；Glossier的幻影品牌持续现象提示品牌退出面板后仍可能被AI检索。

title: Type 2 Emergence and First Prospective v1.5 C2 Calibration on a Skincare IL-Gradient Substrate

detail.title: Type 2 Emergence and First Prospective v1.5 C2 Calibration on a Skincare IL-Gradient Substrate

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by Samsung Electronics America (Director, Corporate Brand Creative and Governance). The AIAS™ Presence Measurement Protocol and the work reported here are the author's independent academic research, conducted outside the scope of employment, in the author's role as faculty at the School of Visual Arts MPS Branding Program and founder of Third System™. None of the 24 brands in the v0.20 registry is affiliated with Samsung Electronics America (pre-acquisition COI screen documented as DEVIATIONS Entry 0).
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable; no human subjects. The research uses publicly accessible LLM APIs queried with non-personal, category-anchored prompts.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract:
The AIAS™ Presence Measurement Protocol operationalizes AI Availability — the brand-level probability of retrieval, recommendation, or selection by an AI intermediary — as a measurable construct alongside Ehrenberg-Bass Mental Availability and Physical Availability. Protocol v1.5 (SSRN 6810758) closed the methodology layer for v1.4's multi-component Recognition × Recall construct by adding a C2 multi-statistic adequacy rule (distinct C_P values ≥ 3 ∧ modal share ≤ 0.625) and a two-channel Recall decomposition (R_cat for category-canonical retrieval, R_cult for cultural-footprint retrieval). v1.5's §6 flagged three open items: Type 2 cases (the cultural-channel-preferred quadrant) had not yet been empirically populated; the C2 rule had been calibrated retrospectively against joint v0.18 + v0.19 data but never tested prospectively; and the cumulative anchor base for the multi-component construct spanned only three substrate families. This paper reports v0.20, the first prospective phase pre-registered against the v1.5 thresholds, and the first acquisition to test the construct on a fourth substrate family.

The substrate is indie- and prestige-segmented skincare, sampled across three cells stratified by Identity Load on the consumer-discovery surface: Cell A (prestige, medium IL), Cell B (celebrity-DTC, high IL — the Type 2 hunting cell), and Cell C (clinical / dermatologist-recommended, low IL). Each cell carries 8 brands; worldwide n = 24 pre-floor. The reference panel is the locked six-slot v0.17 panel. Phase B uses a six-frame battery splitting cleanly across the v1.5 channels: q1–q3 anchor R_cat (best, dermatologist-recommended, effective); q4–q6 anchor R_cult (popular, celebrity, viral/cult). Four pre-registered hypotheses are tested orthogonally.

The four hypotheses returned heterogeneous verdicts. H_Type2_emergence — the primary novel hypothesis for v0.20 — returned PARTIAL with two Type 2 cases in Cell B (Glossier and Rhode, with Augustinus Bader at the threshold boundary), populating the v1.5 dissociation framework's third quadrant for the first time. H_Regime4_skincare, the first prospective exercise of v1.5 C2, returned FALSIFIED with C2 failures in two of three cells: Cell C fully saturated (modal C_P share = 1.000, distinct = 1 — the predicted Cell C cascade-saturation pattern) and Cell A failing on bimodal C_P distribution. Cell B passed C2 cleanly. H_Dissociation_substrate_generalization returned GENERALIZED, with Iwachu-pattern cases distributed across all three cells; the v1.4/v1.5 multi-component construct is now anchored across four substrate families. H_IdentityLoad_moderator (4-leg joint) returned NARROWED, driven by the v0.20 H_Regime4 falsification; the substantive IL channel asymmetry (Cell C R_cat-dominant 10.88 vs. R_cult 8.38; Cell B R_cult-dominant 5.38 vs. R_cat 1.62) remains visible in the raw data and is discussed as a substrate-specific moderator signature beneath the joint verdict.

For AIAS™ 1.0's foundational construct, v0.20's headline contribution is the empirical population of the Type 2 quadrant — the construct's three-quadrant dissociation framework is no longer hypothetical. The pre-registration discipline (commit 4e5ab60, tag v0.20-prereg-r1, deposited at osf.io/ec6wh/v20/) locks panel, hypotheses, decision rules, and verdict matrices ex-ante, with the v1.5 numerical thresholds locked at pre-reg r1 — the first phase to do so prospectively.

AI.tldr: 本文报告AIAS™存在度量协议v0.20阶段的前瞻性测试，首次在第四基质家族（独立与高端护肤品）上实证填充了先前假设的Type 2象限（文化渠道偏好象限），并检验了v1.5协议中的C2多重统计适切性规则。四个预先注册的假设获得了不同结果：Type 2象限部分验证、C2规则被证伪、解离框架跨基质泛化、身份负荷调节效应被收窄。
AI.research_question: AIAS™存在度量协议v1.5中定义的Type 2案例（文化渠道偏好象限）能否在独立与高端护肤品基质家族中被实证填充？C2多重统计适切性规则能否在第四次基质家族上得到前瞻性验证？多组件解离框架能否泛化到新的基质家族？身份负荷（Identity Load）是否调节品牌在各渠道的Recall表现？
AI.motivation: v1.5协议标记了三个未解决问题：Type 2象限缺乏实证数据、C2规则仅靠回溯校准未做前瞻测试、多组件建构的累积锚基底座仅覆盖三个基质家族。v0.20阶段旨在通过第四次基质家族的前瞻性数据填补这些空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: AIAS™存在度量协议将AI可用性（品牌被AI中介检索、推荐或选择的概率）操作化为可测量构念，与Ehrenberg-Bass心理可用性和物理可用性并列。核心构念包括Recognition×Recall多组件度量，以及将Recall分解为R_cat（类别典范检索）和R_cult（文化足迹检索）的双通道模型，辅以C2多重统计适切性规则（区分C_P值≥3且模态份额≤0.625）。
AI.method: 前瞻性、预注册研究。基质为独立与高端护肤品，在三组细胞中按消费者发现表面的身份负荷分层：Cell A（高端，中等IL）、Cell B（名人DTC，高IL）、Cell C（临床/皮肤科医生推荐，低IL）。每组8个品牌，全球n=24。使用锁定六槽v0.17参考面板，六帧电池分别锚定R_cat（q1–q3）和R_cult（q4–q6）。测试四个正交预先注册假设。
AI.findings: (1) H_Type2_emergence部分验证，Cell B中发现两个Type 2案例（Glossier和Rhode），Augustinus Bader处于阈值边界；(2) H_Regime4_skincare被证伪，Cell C完全饱和（模态C_P份额=1.000，区分度=1），Cell A双峰C_P分布失败，仅Cell B通过C2检验；(3) H_Dissociation_substrate_generalization泛化成立，Iwachu模式案例分布于所有三组细胞；(4) H_IdentityLoad_moderator被收窄，但原始数据显示Cell C中R_cat主导（10.88 vs. 8.38），Cell B中R_cult主导（5.38 vs. 1.62）的实质性IL渠道不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证填充了AIAS™协议的Type 2象限，使三象限解离框架从假设变为实证基础；展示了C2规则在不同基质家族中的异质性表现，为规则校准提供反馈；验证了多组件解离框架跨四个基质家族的泛化能力；揭示了身份负荷作为基质特异性调节因子的潜力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌管理者提供AI可用性度量的实证工具，帮助理解品牌在AI中介环境中的检索和推荐机制；揭示了不同市场细分（高端、名人DTC、临床推荐）中品牌Recall渠道偏好的差异，指导品牌在类别典范渠道与文化足迹渠道间的资源分配策略。

title: A Detailed Study and Analysis on Business to Business (B to B) E Commerce as an Economy Booster
affiliations: Lincoln University College

detail.title: A Detailed Study and Analysis on Business to Business (B to B) E Commerce as an Economy Booster
detail.abstract:
In the contemporary global landscape, digital transformation has catalysed the emergence of new economic paradigms. This study ventures into the world of Business-to-Business (B2B) e-commerce, conceptualizing it not merely as a transactional method but as a significant, self-sustaining economy. Drawing from foundational economic theories such as Transaction Cost Economics (Coase, 1937; Williamson, 1981) and the Resource-Based View (Barney, 1991), this research posits that B2B e-commerce platforms have evolved into complex ecosystems that fundamentally alter inter-firm relationships, supply chain dynamics, and overall market structures.
Adopting a robust mixed-methods approach (Creswell & Clark, 2017), this study integrates quantitative data from market research with qualitative insights from academic literature and industry case studies (Cisco, Steelcase, Unilever). Market forecasts project the global B2B e-commerce market to reach tens of trillions of dollars at a CAGR of 14–18%, far outpacing global GDP growth (Grandview Research, 2024; Mordor Intelligence, 2025).
The research examines the pivotal role of Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning, blockchain, and the Internet of Things (IoT) in automating processes, enhancing personalization, and optimizing supply chains, applying the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) to explain adoption. Findings reveal that B2B e-commerce generates systemic efficiency gains, creates a powerful economic multiplier effect, and redefines competitive advantage through digital capabilities (RBV). The study offers strategic recommendations for businesses (digital-first culture, CX focus, AI investment) and policymakers (harmonized regulation, digital infrastructure, workforce development) to navigate this transformative digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究将B2B电子商务概念化为一种自给自足的经济生态系统，运用交易成本经济学、资源基础观和技术接受模型等理论，结合混合研究方法，探讨AI、区块链、物联网等数字技术如何重塑企业间关系、供应链动态和市场结构。研究发现B2B电商能产生系统性效率提升、经济乘数效应，并通过数字能力重新定义竞争优势。
AI.research_question: B2B电子商务平台如何从交易方式演变为自给自足的经济生态系统？数字化技术（AI、区块链、物联网等）在这一演变过程中如何改变企业间关系、供应链动态和市场结构？
AI.motivation: 在数字化转型催生新经济范式的全球背景下，B2B电子商务已超越了单纯的交易方式，亟需将其概念化为一个重要的、自给自足的经济体进行研究，以理解其对经济体系的深远影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学（Coase, 1937; Williamson, 1981）、资源基础观（Barney, 1991）、技术接受模型（TAM）
AI.method: 混合研究方法：整合来自市场研究的定量数据与学术文献及行业案例（思科、Steelcase、联合利华）的定性洞察。
AI.findings: 1) B2B电商产生系统性效率提升；2) 创造强大的经济乘数效应；3) 通过数字能力重新定义竞争优势（基于RBV）。全球B2B电商市场预计以14-18%的年复合增长率达到数十万亿美元，远超全球GDP增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 将B2B电子商务从交易方式重新概念化为自给自足的经济生态系统，拓展了交易成本经济学和资源基础观在数字经济背景下的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供战略建议（数字化优先文化、客户体验聚焦、AI投资），为政策制定者提供建议（协调监管、数字基础设施、劳动力发展），以应对转型中的数字经济。

title: Dissemination Design in AI Regulatory Sandboxes

detail.title: Dissemination Design in AI Regulatory Sandboxes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: AI regulatory sandboxes have become a central implementation instrument in the EU AI Act and related national programs, but their information dissemination rules remain undertheorized. We model two competing AI providers deciding whether to deploy a frontier model under regulatory classification uncertainty. When an admitted sandbox participant deploys the frontier model, the regulator learns its classification; the design question is whether that learning remains confidential or becomes public. Confidential dissemination strengthens the participant's incentive to deploy the frontier model, acting on the classification before the rival learns it; while public dissemination eliminates this edge, leaving only the reputational reward from participation. The welfare trade-off reduces to which regulatory objective binds: inducing frontier experimentation (confidential dominates) or preventing rivals from continuing to deploy a model whose systemic-risk status has been confirmed (public dominates). We translate these results into a two-question diagnostic and concrete design predictions and recommendations for current sandbox programs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI监管沙盒中的信息披露规则设计，通过博弈模型分析保密披露与公开披露对前沿模型部署激励的影响，为欧盟AI法案等监管项目提供设计建议。
AI.research_question: 在AI监管沙盒中，监管者获取的前沿模型分类信息应保密还是公开披露？两种披露规则如何影响竞争性AI企业的部署决策和整体社会福利？
AI.motivation: AI监管沙盒已成为欧盟AI法案等监管框架的核心实施工具，但其信息传播规则在理论和设计上缺乏充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管分类不确定性和信息设计理论，构建双寡头竞争博弈模型，分析保密披露与公开披露两种信息披露机制。
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论模型），分析两种竞争性AI提供商在监管分类不确定性下的部署决策。
AI.findings: 保密披露增强参与者的前沿模型部署激励（因其可在对手知情前先行动），公开披露则消除此先发优势、仅保留参与声誉回报。福利权衡取决于监管目标：若目标是激励前沿实验则保密披露占优，若目标是阻止对手在确认系统性风险后继续部署则公开披露占优。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI监管沙盒的信息披露规则设计提供了首个系统性理论分析框架，揭示了保密与公开披露之间的基本权衡机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 将理论结果转化为两问诊断工具和具体设计预测，为欧盟AI法案等现行沙盒项目提供可操作的政策建议。

reference: Journal of Information Security and Applications, volume 100, 2026[10.1016/j.jisa.2026.104510]
title: Pufzin: Secure and Scalable Blockchain-Iot with Pufs and Zero-Knowledge Proofs
affiliations: Texas A&M University, Metropolitan State University and Texas A&M University

detail.title: Pufzin: Secure and Scalable Blockchain-Iot with Pufs and Zero-Knowledge Proofs

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Information Security and Applications, volume 100, 2026[10.1016/j.jisa.2026.104510]

detail.abstract: Securing the rapidly expanding Internet of Things (IoT) requires robust, scalable, and privacy-preserving authentication. This paper presents PUFZIN (Physical Unclonable Functions and Zero-knowledge proofs for IoT Networks), a framework for securing blockchain-based IoT systems through the integration of Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs) and Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs). PUFZIN addresses critical challenges in IoT security, including device authentication, data privacy, and system scalability, while considering the practical constraints of IoT deployments. We demonstrate PUFZIN's feasibility using the Ethereum development environment, achieving efficient proof generation (averaging 65.3 ms on standard hardware and 3.87 s on resource-constrained devices) and 100% authentication success under the simulated PUF noise model (0–10%) using an explicit error-tolerant acceptance rule. A comprehensive security analysis supports PUFZIN's resilience against various attacks, including device impersonation and data tampering, under standard cryptographic assumptions and a simulated PUF noise model. The experimental results, conducted across different hardware configurations and operating conditions, support PUFZIN's practicality for IoT-oriented deployments while clarifying methodological limitations for simulated PUF evaluation. This work provides a foundation for secure and scalable blockchain-based IoT systems, with particular emphasis on resource optimization and practical deployment considerations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PUFZIN框架，将物理不可克隆函数（PUF）与零知识证明（ZKP）相结合，用于保障基于区块链的物联网系统的安全认证与隐私保护。实验表明，该框架在标准硬件上平均生成证明仅需65.3毫秒，在资源受限设备上为3.87秒，在模拟PUF噪声模型下认证成功率达100%。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种兼顾安全性、可扩展性和隐私保护的物联网设备认证方案，以适应资源受限的IoT部署场景？
AI.motivation: 物联网设备快速增长，亟需鲁棒、可扩展且保护隐私的认证机制。现有方案在设备认证、数据隐私和系统可扩展性方面存在瓶颈，并且难以适应IoT设备的资源约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理不可克隆函数（PUF）——利用设备物理特性的唯一性进行身份识别；零知识证明（ZKP）——在不泄露敏感信息的前提下验证声明真实性；区块链——提供去中心化、不可篡改的信任基础。
AI.method: 提出PUFZIN框架，整合PUF与ZKP实现认证与隐私保护；在以太坊开发环境中实现原型；通过模拟PUF噪声模型（0–10%）并采用显式容错接受规则进行实验评估；在不同硬件配置和运行条件下测试性能与安全性。
AI.findings: 1) 证明生成高效：标准硬件平均65.3毫秒，资源受限设备3.87秒；2) 在0–10%的模拟PUF噪声下，认证成功率达100%；3) 安全性分析表明PUFZIN能抵抗设备冒充和数据篡改等攻击；4) 实验验证了其在IoT部署中的实用性，同时指出模拟PUF评估的方法论局限。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将PUF与ZKP整合到区块链IoT认证中，提出显式容错接受规则以应对PUF噪声问题，为资源受限环境下的隐私保护认证提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可落地的IoT安全认证方案，在以太坊上实现已验证的原型，性能指标表明其可部署于实际IoT设备，兼顾了安全性与资源效率。

title: The Missing Value of Data
affiliations: , University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics and Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: The Missing Value of Data
detail.abstract: Data assets are increasingly vital in modern economies, yet macroeconomic measurement is not well-adapted to capturing their value. Part of the problem is that data is an intangible asset: investments in data are missed in national accounts, and depreciation losses are missed in firms' balance sheets. Another part, unique to data, is that it serves as a means of payment in the modern economy: consumption bartered for data is also omitted from national accounts. We propose an output-based approach to measure the missing value of data. We treat data as an asset, measure its volume based on the quality of firms' revenue forecasts, and endogenously determine its depreciation. We then capitalize the data value and explore what the measured GDP would be if the data were treated and transacted similarly to a physical asset. Our findings suggest that the aggregate value of data is about 1.5% of GDP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于产出的方法，将数据视为资产，通过企业收入预测质量衡量数据价值，并内生决定其折旧。研究发现，数据的总价值约占GDP的1.5%。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量宏观经济中数据的价值？数据资产在国民核算中被遗漏的部分有多大？
AI.motivation: 数据资产在现代经济中日益重要，但宏观经济测算未能很好地捕捉其价值。数据作为无形资产，投资被遗漏在国民账户之外；同时数据作为现代经济的支付手段，以数据交换的消费也被忽略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将数据视为资产，采用基于产出的方法；通过企业收入预测质量衡量数据量，内生决定数据折旧，进而资本化数据价值。
AI.method: 提出产出导向的测量方法，基于企业收入预测质量衡量数据体量，内生确定折旧率，对数据价值进行资本化测算。
AI.findings: 数据总价值约占GDP的1.5%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将数据作为资产进行宏观经济测量的新框架，填补了国民账户中数据价值缺失的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和统计机构提供了量化数据资产价值的方法，有助于更准确地评估数据驱动型经济体的真实产出。

title: Alignment Between Model Intrinsic and Post-Hoc Interpretations: A Novel Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Unstructured Data
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology - IT Management Area, Jiaxing University, Georgia Institute of Technology - Ernest Scheller Jr. College of Business  and Pennsylvania State University - Department of Marketing

detail.title: Alignment Between Model Intrinsic and Post-Hoc Interpretations: A Novel Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Unstructured Data
detail.abstract: Interpretable deep learning is increasingly central to high-stakes business applications, as stakeholders cannot act on predictions they cannot verify. Yet the two dominant paradigms, intrinsic methods (e.g., attention values) and post-hoc methods (e.g., Shapley values), routinely produce inconsistent and even contradictory explanations for the same model on the same data. We trace this tension to a structural problem we term \emph{interpretation misalignment}, and prove with four impossibility results for attention values and three inferiority results for Shapley values that neither method in isolation can yield reliable interpretations. To resolve this, we propose an \emph{Interpretation Alignment Framework} that exploits a mutually beneficial relationship in deep learning: more accurate intrinsic interpretations enable a better-calibrated prediction model, which in turn yields more accurate post-hoc interpretations. Unlike prior approaches that rely on externally specified targets, our framework derives the alignment target endogenously and iteratively co-optimizes prediction and interpretation tasks. Theoretically, our framework is guaranteed to converge and mitigate the issues in existing interpretation methods. Empirically, we apply the framework to a face perception task across seven business-to-consumer contexts, where it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both prediction accuracy and interpretation quality; an illustrative cost-benefit analysis translates the gain into \$160{,}000 of additional net benefit, and a downstream fairness-aware classification model built on these interpretations achieves significant improvements on accuracy and fairness simultaneously. Finally, generalizability analyses on two additional image-classification tasks and an NLP task confirm that the alignment principle holds across modalities, establishing it as a flexible, interpretable deep learning framework in practical business applications.

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-7
title: Where is AI in GDP statistics?
affiliations: University of Virginia and Government of Canada - Bank of Canada

detail.title: Where is AI in GDP statistics?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-7
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Key Takeaways

• Quality-adjusted AI production in the United States grew at over 2,000 percent per year in 2024 and 2025, driven by three compounding forces: expanding data-center capacity, hardware efficiency gains, and—the largest of the three—algorithmic progress.
• Treating the AI sector as a coherent economic entity yields preliminary estimates of nominal AI GDP at approximately $250 billion in 2025, growing at roughly 2,600 percent per year in quality-adjusted real terms.
• National economic statistics accounts were not designed to track this kind of activity. Statistics agencies should begin developing AI-focused satellite accounts now, before the measurement gap becomes a policy gap.

The AI economy in the United States has been growing at an unprecedented rate, but this extraordinary growth is largely invisible in conventional statistics. The authors propose developing an “AI GDP” framework to better measure AI’s growing role in the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“AI GDP”框架，估算2024-2025年美国质量调整后的AI生产年增长率超过2000%，2025年名义AI GDP约为2500亿美元，并呼吁统计机构建立AI卫星账户以弥补测量缺口。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够有效衡量美国AI经济产出的统计框架？AI经济在以多快的速度增长？
AI.motivation: 传统国民经济统计无法捕捉AI领域前所未有的高速增长，导致政策制定者缺乏准确的参考依据。作者希望建立一个“AI GDP”框架来量化这一增长，并呼吁统计机构及时行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质量调整后的GDP核算方法；AI卫星账户（satellite accounts）的概念；将AI部门作为独立经济实体进行核算。
AI.method: 构建“AI GDP”框架，综合考虑数据中心扩张、硬件效率提升和算法进步三个叠加力量，对AI生产进行质量调整后的增长率和名义价值估算。
AI.findings: （1）2024-2025年，美国质量调整后的AI生产年增长率超过2000%；（2）驱动增长的三重力量为数据中心扩张、硬件效率提升和算法进步，其中算法进步贡献最大；（3）2025年名义AI GDP约2500亿美元，质量调整后的实际年增长率约为2600%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“AI GDP”这一新的经济核算概念框架，将AI视为独立的经济部门进行产出测量，拓展了国民收入核算在技术经济领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为统计机构提供具体建议，呼吁尽快开发AI卫星账户，防止测量缺口演变为政策缺口；为政策制定者和投资者提供AI经济规模的量化参考。

reference: Queen Mary Law Research Paper No. 488/2026
title: Evergreening in Intellectual Property Law: Policies, Strategies & Regulation
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London - Centre for Commercial Law Studies (CCLS), , Queen Mary University of London: Centre for Commercial Law Studies, Queen Mary University of London, Centre for Commercial Law  Studies and Queen Mary University of London, School of Law - Centre for Commercial Law Studies

detail.title: Evergreening in Intellectual Property Law: Policies, Strategies & Regulation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Queen Mary Law Research Paper No. 488/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Queen Mary Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This report summarises the 2025 Roundtable on Evergreening in Intellectual Property (IP) Law held at the Queen Mary Intellectual Property Research Institute (QMIPRI), Queen Mary University of London. It examines how IP rights, including overlapping design and copyright protection, trade marks, and secondary pharmaceutical patents, are used to extend market exclusivity beyond their original scope. While participants debated the precision and usefulness of the term “evergreening”, there was broad agreement that the cumulative and sequential deployment of IP rights raises significant challenges for doctrinal coherence and competition policy. Rather than advancing a single conclusion, the report identifies key areas in which tensions between innovation, access, and enforcement warrant further research and regulatory attention.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了2025年伦敦玛丽女王大学知识产权研究所举办的“知识产权长青化”圆桌会议，讨论了多种知识产权（设计权、版权、商标、二级药品专利）如何被用于延长市场独占期，并指出“长青化”虽定义存疑，但IP的累积与序列化使用对法律连贯性和竞争政策构成重大挑战。
AI.research_question: 知识产权（设计权、版权、商标、二级药品专利）的“长青化”实践如何影响市场独占期、法律连贯性与竞争政策？
AI.motivation: 知识产权长青化现象日益普遍，但其精确含义与法律后果尚不明确，需要学术与监管层面的深入讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权法的连贯性理论、竞争政策与创新激励的平衡理论。
AI.method: 圆桌会议讨论总结与报告撰写，基于多学科参与者（法律学者、政策制定者、从业者）的辩论与共识提炼。
AI.findings: 1) 参与者对“长青化”一词的精确性与有用性存在争议；2) 普遍共识是IP权利的累积和序列化部署对法律连贯性和竞争政策构成重大挑战；3) 创新、获取（access）与执法之间的紧张关系需要进一步研究和监管关注。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了“长青化”概念在学术讨论中的模糊性，并强调IP权利叠加使用对传统知识产权法教义体系的冲击。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构识别出需要进一步研究与干预的关键领域，即创新、可及性与执法之间的平衡点。

title: Conditional Equity Factor Risk Premium
affiliations: Mitchell E. Daniels, Jr School of Business, Purdue University

detail.title: Conditional Equity Factor Risk Premium
detail.abstract: I estimate the conditional risk premia of equity factors using a Kalman filter. I assume that the stochastic discounting factor consists of two components: market and future investment opportunity set. The state variable is the covariance with the investment opportuntiy set which is unobservable, and the signal is the realized factor return. I estimate the risk premia in monthly frequency and find predictability for many factors. Factor timing based on the estimates (i.e., mean timing) improves the Sharpe ratio in a sizable magnitude. For many factors, the improvement is distinct from the one from volatility timing. I explore the relationship between the risk premia and macroeconomic variables to understand the economic origins of the time-varying risk premia.

AI.tldr: 本文使用卡尔曼滤波器估计股票因子条件风险溢价，发现许多因子具有可预测性，基于风险溢价均值的因子择时能显著提升夏普比率，且这种提升不同于波动率择时。
AI.research_question: 因子条件风险溢价是否随时间变化且可预测？基于风险溢价估计的因子择时能否改善投资绩效？
AI.motivation: 传统因子模型假设风险溢价恒定，但实际中风险溢价可能随时间变化。探究时变风险溢价的存在性及其经济来源，以及利用时变风险溢价进行因子择时的潜在收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机贴现因子（SDF）由市场成分和未来投资机会集成分组成；状态变量是与投资机会集的不可观测协方差；信号是已实现的因子收益。
AI.method: 使用卡尔曼滤波器（Kalman filter）估计因子条件风险溢价，以月度频率进行估计。
AI.findings: 1) 许多因子具有可预测的条件风险溢价；2) 基于风险溢价均值估计的因子择时能显著提升夏普比率；3) 这种提升不同于传统的波动率择时效果；4) 风险溢价与宏观经济变量之间存在关联，揭示了时变风险溢价的经济来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种基于卡尔曼滤波的因子条件风险溢价估计方法，揭示了因子风险溢价的时变性及其与宏观经济变量的关系，为因子定价的跨期动态提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了可操作的因子择时策略——基于条件风险溢价均值进行择时，能显著提升投资组合的夏普比率，且补充了传统的仅基于波动率择时的策略。

title: Gradual Linking of Permit Markets
affiliations: , University of Basel - Faculty of Business and Economics, Resources for the Future , Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK) and Colorado State University, Fort Collins

detail.title: Gradual Linking of Permit Markets
detail.abstract: Linking permit markets offers substantial efficiency gains, but immediate price convergence creates distributional challenges that can make it politically infeasible. We show that achieving gradual price convergence in linked markets with permit banking requires two instruments: permit conversion rates to govern trading across markets and banking across periods. Absent the latter, anticipated future exchange rates propagate backward through banking, neutralizing intended phase-ins and potentially inducing perverse trade flows and emission increases. We characterize how the two instruments must be jointly calibrated to achieve a targeted convergence path without environmental harm. A numerical application to the EU ETS1 and ETS2 illustrates policy implications and quantifies associated tradeoffs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在连接排放交易市场时，为实现渐进式价格趋同，需要同时使用许可证转换率（控制跨市场交易）和银行政策（控制跨期存储）两种工具，否则银行机制会通过预期未来汇率向后传导，破坏渐进式改革的意图。
AI.research_question: 在具有许可证银行（banking）功能的连接排放交易市场中，如何设计政策工具以实现渐进式的价格趋同，同时避免环境损害和逆向贸易流动？
AI.motivation: 连接排放交易市场能带来显著的效率提升，但立即的价格趋同会产生分配问题，使其在政治上不可行。因此需要渐进式改革，但现有文献缺乏对连接市场中银行机制与渐进价格趋同相互作用的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨期银行（intertemporal banking）理论、排放交易市场连接理论、许可证转换率（permit conversion rate）设计理论。
AI.method: 理论建模，刻画在银行存在下连接市场的均衡条件；数值应用（欧盟ETS1和ETS2）量化政策权衡。
AI.findings: 仅控制跨市场交易（许可证转换率）不足以实现渐进式价格趋同，因为预期未来汇率会通过银行机制向后传导，抵消渐进设计的意图，甚至导致逆向贸易和排放增加。必须同时校准跨市场转换率和跨期银行政策才能实现目标趋同路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在连接市场中，银行机制与渐进价格趋同之间被忽视的相互作用；建立了同时使用两种工具（转换率和银行政策）以实现渐进式连接的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟ETS1与ETS2的实际连接提供了政策设计指导，量化了渐进式趋同路径下的效率与环境权衡。

title: The Mathematics of Safeguarding: A Computational Audit of AI Policies and Compliance for Non-Verbal SEND Learners

detail.title: The Mathematics of Safeguarding: A Computational Audit of AI Policies and Compliance for Non-Verbal SEND Learners

keywords: GRID Simulation v1.0 | Live simulation: grid-simulation.netlify.app | Practitioner consultation: Graham Spencer

detail.abstract:
For non-verbal learners on the Autism Spectrum with Moderate to Severe Learning Difficulties, safeguarding is not a procedural question. It is a mathematical one. These learners cannot self-report. Their safety depends entirely on whether trained staff observe the right signals, record them accurately, and pass them up a governance chain before escalation occurs. Each of these conditions is a measurable variable. When they interact under real operational pressure, they produce predictable and quantifiable outcomes.

Yet, current regulatory frameworks operate in total isolation from these metrics. The DfE routinely designs guidelines for the broader educational population, covering everything from restrictive interventions and generative AI product safety to school safeguarding, and then retrofits them to specialist SEND settings without calibrating for their operational realities. The House of Commons Education Committee confirms this systemic blind spot in its report on the SEND crisis, noting that the DfE did not yet understand how outcomes differ for children with similar needs across different settings. Consequently, compliance on paper becomes completely decoupled from compliance in practice. For a non-verbal child who cannot report what is happening to them, this gap is not administrative. It is the difference between protection and harm. 

This paper proposes GRID, the Governance Risk and Infrastructure Diagnostics framework for SEND-AI Environments, and stress-tests it using agent-based simulation, a method borrowed from engineering that models how governance systems actually behave under operational pressure rather than how their designers intended them to behave. No child was studied. No real data was used. The method preserves student rights and privacy by design.

The simulation produces three findings. Trained staff generate significantly more validated observational data than current governance structures capture or act on. Workload and the absence of protected documentation time create compounding gaps that no AI monitoring tool can compensate for. And AI governance compliance assessed at the tool level, without accounting for operational infrastructure, does not protect the child. These findings have direct implications for the DfE Generative AI Product Safety Standards (January 2026), the KCSIE 2026 draft, the Data Use and Access Act 2025, and the DfE Restrictive Interventions Guidance for Schools (April 2026), all four of which are entering force or consultation now. The live simulation is available at: https://grid-simulation.netlify.app

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRID框架（SEND-AI环境下的治理风险与基础设施诊断框架），通过基于智能体的仿真方法，揭示当前英国SEND（特殊教育需求与残疾）领域监管框架与运营现实之间的系统性脱节：非言语自闭症学生的安全取决于人员观察、记录和上报链条的可靠性，而现有政策对此缺乏量化校准，导致纸上合规与实际保护之间存在致命鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 对于有中重度学习困难且无法自我报告的非言语自闭症学生，当前英国监管框架（如DfE指南、KCSIE、AI产品安全标准等）在多大程度上能够确保其实际安全，而非仅实现程序上的合规？
AI.motivation: 非言语自闭症学生无法自我报告安全风险，其保护完全依赖工作人员的观察、记录和上报链条。然而，现有监管框架（如DfE政策）是针对普通教育人群设计的，事后才改造至SEND特殊场景，且决策者并不了解不同环境下具有相似需求的学生结果差异。这种"纸面上的合规"与实际保护之间的差距对非言语儿童而言意味着伤害风险。因此需要一种能够量化评估治理系统实际表现的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统工程视角下的治理框架量化分析。借鉴工程领域的基于智能体仿真（Agent-Based Simulation）方法，将治理系统中的关键环节（人员观察、记录准确性、上报链条）视为可测量的变量，通过模拟这些变量在真实运营压力下的相互作用来评估系统实际行为，而非仅依赖设计意图。
AI.method: 基于智能体的仿真（Agent-Based Simulation），无真实儿童数据，无真人受试，通过设计保护学生隐私和权利的方式进行模拟验证。
AI.findings: 1. 训练有素的工作人员产生的有效观察数据远超当前治理结构能够捕获和处理的数量；2. 工作负荷和缺乏受保护的文件记录时间造成的复合性缺口，是任何AI监控工具都无法弥补的；3. 仅在工具层面评估AI治理合规性而不考虑运营基础设施，根本无法保护儿童安全。
AI.theory_contributions: 将工程领域的基于智能体仿真方法引入SEND教育治理研究，为评估特殊教育领域的治理系统实际效能提供了可量化的方法论框架（GRID），揭示了政策设计中"意图"与"实际表现"之间的系统性偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 对英国四项即将生效或正在咨询中的政策（DfE生成式AI产品安全标准2026年1月版、KCSIE 2026草案、数据使用与获取法案2025、DfE学校限制性干预指南2026年4月版）具有直接的政策修订启示，指出AI监控工具无法替代人员时间与工作负荷管理，治理评估必须纳入运营基础设施维度。

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 26-8
title: Haunted by Tariffs and Trade Wars: A Positive Trade Policy for US Agriculture
affiliations: Hogan Lovells, International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI), Peterson Institute for International Economics and

detail.title: Haunted by Tariffs and Trade Wars: A Positive Trade Policy for US Agriculture

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 26-8
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: US farmers have been some of the biggest beneficiaries of US free trade agreements and the postwar creation of a rules-based global trading system. The entry into force of the North American Free Trade Agreement in 1994, the World Trade Organization's Agreement on Agriculture in 1995, and the enactment of the Freedom to Farm Act in 1996 contributed to a more than doubling of farm incomes over the past decades. Accordingly, farmers have been disadvantaged by the US shift away from forging such trade pacts under recent Democratic and Republican administrations. Furthermore, agriculture is among the US sectors most affected by the volatility and uncertainty created by both the first and second Trump administrations' embrace of high, often changing, tariffs as the primary focus of its trade policy. Both Trump administrations provided subsidies to compensate farmers for lost export revenue, but this is not a sustainable long-term solution and cannot replace a more positive US trade policy. This policy approach promises at best increased input costs, while raising uncertainty over foreign market access. US trade policy would help the US agricultural sector more by improving trade rules and expanding farmers' market access abroad.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国贸易政策转向对农民的影响。自1990年代以来，自由贸易协定和农业法案使美国农民收入翻倍，但近年来美国两届政府（尤其是特朗普政府）转向高关税保护主义，导致农业部门遭受巨大不确定性和损失。虽然政府提供了补贴补偿，但这不是可持续方案。更好的路径是通过改善贸易规则和扩大海外市场准入来帮助农业部门。
AI.research_question: 美国从自由贸易转向保护主义贸易政策对本国农业部门产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 美国农民曾是自由贸易的最大受益者之一，但近年贸易政策转向导致其利益受损，作者旨在指出当前补贴政策的不可持续性，呼吁回归基于规则的贸易政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策理论、农业经济学、保护主义与自由贸易的对比分析。
AI.method: 政策分析/评论文章，基于历史贸易政策变化和农业经济数据的分析。
AI.findings: 1. 历史上NAFTA、WTO农业协定和自由农场法案曾使农民收入翻倍；2. 近年保护主义关税政策严重打击农业；3. 补贴无法替代贸易自由化；4. 关税政策增加农民成本和市场不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了贸易保护主义对农业部门的系统性负面影响，论证了补贴政策的不可持续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国农业政策制定者提供了明确的政策建议：应改善贸易规则、扩大海外市场准入，而非依赖关税和补贴。

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 26-9
title: Measuring the AI Economy
affiliations: University of Virginia and Government of Canada - Bank of Canada

detail.title: Measuring the AI Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 26-9
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We construct a macroeconomic estimate of total AI production for the United States, combining inference and R&D/training activities and applying quality adjustments based on the evolution of API prices at fixed performance levels and the pace of algorithmic progress. We estimate that nominal AI compute spending grew over 140 percent per year each in 2024 and 2025, raw compute capacity grew over 200 percent per year, and quality-adjusted AI output grew over 2,000 percent per year. These growth rates reflect three compounding forces: expanding data-center capacity, continued improvements in chip efficiency, and rapid algorithmic progress. We then employ our estimates to develop a nascent framework for "AI GDP" that tracks the AI economy as a coherent whole rather than dispersed across standard industry classifications. Quality-adjusted AI GDP grew by more than 2,500 percent each in 2024 and 2025. Our measures complement traditional national accounts by providing visibility into a fast-moving sector whose activity is difficult to isolate in existing statistics, and they may serve as building blocks for satellite accounts that track AI's growing role in the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了美国AI总产出的宏观经济估算，涵盖推理与研发/训练活动，并基于固定性能水平的API价格演变和算法进步速度进行质量调整。估算显示，2024和2025年名义AI计算支出年增长超140%，原始计算能力年增长超200%，质量调整后的AI产出年增长超2000%。质量调整后的AI GDP在2024和2025年每年增长超2500%。
AI.research_question: 如何构建美国AI总产出的宏观经济估算，并开发"AI GDP"框架来追踪整个AI经济？
AI.motivation: AI经济活动在传统国民经济统计中分散于各个行业分类，难以单独识别和追踪，需要新的测量框架来反映这一快速增长的部门。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于API价格固定性能水平演变和算法进步速度的质量调整方法，以及卫星账户（satellite accounts）框架。
AI.method: 结合推理与研发/训练活动，对名义AI计算支出、原始计算能力和质量调整后AI产出进行综合估算。
AI.findings: 2024和2025年：名义AI计算支出年增长超140%，原始计算能力年增长超200%，质量调整后AI产出年增长超2000%，质量调整后AI GDP年增长超2500%。增长驱动因素：数据中心容量扩张、芯片效率持续提升、算法快速进步。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"AI GDP"这一概念框架，将AI经济作为整体而非分散在行业分类中加以追踪，为传统国民经济核算提供了补充性测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了识别和追踪AI经济活动的定量工具，可作为构建AI卫星账户的基础模块，帮助更好地理解AI在经济中日益增长的作用。

title: Stock Market Liberalization and Capital Misallocation
affiliations: and Wesleyan University

detail.title: Stock Market Liberalization and Capital Misallocation
detail.abstract: The 2001 stock market reform in China ended the administrative quota system for public listings, which had prioritized market access for provinces with larger state sectors. This reform led to a convergence of the probability of firms' listing across provinces. Firms experiencing larger increases in listing probability exhibit higher growth in assets and investment, along with larger reductions in both costs of capital and marginal revenue product of capital. These patterns suggest that the reform improved capital allocation efficiency across Chinese firms, including unlisted ones. We identify equity market liberalization as a key institutional lever that drives reduced capital misallocation and thus contribute to debates on financial development and economic efficiency in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 2001年中国股权分置改革取消了行政配额制，使各省企业上市概率趋同。上市概率提升更大的企业实现了资产和投资增长加快、资本成本和资本边际收益产品下降，表明改革改善了资本配置效率。
AI.research_question: 2001年中国股票市场改革（取消行政配额制）是否改善了资本配置效率？
AI.motivation: 探究新兴市场中股权市场自由化这一制度杠杆能否减少资本错配，为金融发展与经济效率的学术争论提供证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本配置效率理论、金融发展理论、资本错配与边际收益产品均等化理论
AI.method: 利用2001年改革作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）比较各省之间上市概率变化差异，分析企业资产、投资、资本成本和资本边际收益产品的变化。
AI.findings: 改革后各省上市概率趋于收敛；上市概率提升越大的企业，资产和投资增长越快，资本成本和资本边际收益产品下降越大，表明资本配置效率提高。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了股权市场自由化是减少资本错配的关键制度机制，丰富了金融发展与经济增长关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场国家推进股权市场自由化改革、减少行政干预以提升资本配置效率提供了政策依据。

reference: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1996; https://doi.org/10.59576/sr.1196
title: Regulatory Arbitrage Within the Firm
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management

detail.title: Regulatory Arbitrage Within the Firm

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1996
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Regulation shapes the boundaries of firms. When prudential standards bind asymmetrically across subsidiaries of an integrated organization, internal capital markets become a mechanism for regulatory arbitrage. We study this in U.S. banking, where holding companies encompass both heavily regulated depository institutions and lightly regulated nonbank affiliates. Following Basel III in 2015, holding companies extract equity from nonbank subsidiaries to recapitalize their banks. Bank subsidiaries accumulate 5-8 percentage points more excess capital than comparable standalone banks through internal transfers; consolidated equity, assets, and lending are unchanged. In response to the same regulatory shock, nonbank affiliates within these organizations exhibit declining capital ratios, deteriorating credit quality, and expansion into consumer lending. The consolidated organization remains exposed to nonbank distress. We calibrate stress scenarios to 2008-scale losses on nonbank assets. If parents were to recapitalize distressed subsidiaries, 4-6 percent of holding companies would exhaust their capital buffers. For the most exposed institutions, the apparent improvement in bank safety is substantially overstated once the implicit liability to nonbank affiliates is accounted for. Organizational structure is a fundamental determinant of regulatory outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国银行业在巴塞尔III监管下，控股公司如何通过内部资本市场从非银行子公司抽取股权为银行子公司补充资本，从而进行监管套利。结果显示，银行资本充足率提升，但非银行子公司风险上升，合并组织的整体风险并未降低。
AI.research_question: 当审慎监管标准在综合组织的不同子公司间不对称约束时，内部资本市场如何成为监管套利机制？
AI.motivation: 监管塑造企业边界。当监管标准在不同子公司间不对称时，企业可能通过内部资本市场进行监管套利，这可能导致表面上的风险改善掩盖了整体风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部资本市场理论、监管套利理论、企业组织边界理论
AI.method: 基于美国银行业数据，对比银行控股公司旗下的银行子公司与独立银行，分析巴塞尔III实施前后内部资本转移、资本比率、资产质量等变化，并校准压力情景模拟非银行资产损失。
AI.findings: （1）巴塞尔III后，控股公司从非银行子公司抽取股权为银行注资，银行超额资本积累5-8个百分点；（2）合并报表的权益、资产和贷款不变；（3）非银行子公司资本比率下降、信用质量恶化、扩张至消费贷款；（4）若母公司需救助困境子公司，4-6%的控股公司将耗尽资本缓冲；（5）银行表面安全改善被高估。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示组织架构是监管结果的根本决定因素；指出内部资本市场在不对称监管下的套利功能；表明合并监管可能低估整体风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供政策启示：应关注控股公司整体风险而非仅银行子公司；监管套利可能削弱资本监管有效性；压力测试应纳入对非银行子公司的隐性负债。

title: Currency Transition: The Use of Foreign Coins and "Dollarization" in Seventeenth-Century Ottoman Istanbul
affiliations: University of Connecticut - Department of Economics,  and University of Connecticut

detail.title: Currency Transition: The Use of Foreign Coins and "Dollarization" in Seventeenth-Century Ottoman Istanbul
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the 17 th-century Ottoman Empire's transition from domestic to foreign currency, a striking episode in early modern monetary history. Drawing on over 22,000 Istanbul court records, we provide the first large-scale quantitative account of how European coins, especially the Spanish reale and Dutch lion dollar, displaced Ottoman currency in everyday legal and economic transactions. Our analysis combines descriptive trends with regression models to examine variation across gender, religion, socioeconomic status, case type, and court district. We show that while men and non-Muslims initially dominated foreign coin use, women and Muslims disproportionately adopted foreign currencies in commercial cases and in Istanbul's central courts, revealing the social complexities of access to and reliance on foreign monies. These findings challenge state-centered narratives of Ottoman monetary history by highlighting the routine practices through which currency transitions occurred. More broadly, the study situates the Ottoman experience within global patterns of early modern money, demonstrating how fragmented and socially differentiated currency transitions were across time and space.

AI.tldr: 本文利用奥斯曼帝国伊斯坦布尔法庭的22,000余份记录，首次大规模量化研究了17世纪奥斯曼帝国从本国货币转向外国货币（尤其是西班牙里亚尔和荷兰狮币）的历史过程，揭示了货币转型中性别、宗教和社会地位的复杂性。
AI.research_question: 17世纪奥斯曼帝国如何从本国货币转向外国货币？不同社会群体（性别、宗教、社会经济地位）在使用外国货币方面存在怎样的差异？
AI.motivation: 早期现代货币史中，奥斯曼帝国的货币转型是一个引人注目但研究不足的案例。以往研究多从国家中心视角出发，缺乏对日常实践和社会差异的量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币社会学、早期现代全球货币史、社会分层与货币使用理论
AI.method: 基于22,000余份伊斯坦布尔法庭记录的大规模量化分析，结合描述性统计和回归模型，考察性别、宗教、社会经济地位、案件类型和法庭区域等维度的差异。
AI.findings: 1）男性和非穆斯林最初主导外国货币的使用；2）女性和穆斯林在商业案件和伊斯坦布尔中央法庭中不成比例地采用了外国货币；3）货币转型呈现出高度的社会分化和碎片化特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了国家中心的奥斯曼货币史叙事，强调日常实践中货币转型的社会复杂性；将奥斯曼经验置于早期现代全球货币格局中，揭示货币转型在时间和空间上的碎片化与分化特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史上货币替代和货币多元化的社会基础提供了实证参考，对当代发展中国家的货币政策和金融包容性具有启示意义。

title: Passive Flows and the Limits to Arbitrage
affiliations: University of Connecticut and Harvard Business School

detail.title: Passive Flows and the Limits to Arbitrage
detail.abstract: We show that passive flow-induced trading acts as a limit to arbitrage: accounting-based long-short anomaly strategies earn significantly lower realized returns among stocks that experience larger passive inflows during the holding period. The mechanism is that inelastic demand from index-fund flows has a larger price impact on short-leg stocks, where demand multipliers are larger on average. Thus, even though the long and short legs have similar levels of passive flow-induced trading, passive inflows raise short-leg stock returns by more during the holding period, compressing long-short return spreads. We provide evidence that one channel for the higher short-leg multipliers is short covering: among heavily shorted stocks, passive-flow shocks are followed by larger declines in short interest.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，被动型指数基金流量引发的交易会作为一种套利限制，降低基于会计指标的长期-短期异常策略的回报。机制在于：指数基金的非弹性需求对空头头寸股票的价格影响更大，因为这些股票的需求乘数平均更高。因此，即使多头和空头头寸的被动流量驱动交易水平相似，被动资金流入在持有期内会更多地推高空头头寸的股票回报，从而压缩多空回报差。其中一个渠道是空头回补：在被大量做空的股票中，被动流量冲击后空头持仓会大幅下降。
AI.research_question: 被动流量驱动的交易如何作为套利限制影响基于会计指标的多空异常策略的回报？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对套利限制的研究多关注主动交易者行为，而对被动投资（如指数基金）通过非弹性需求所产生的价格影响及其对套利策略有效性的限制关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非弹性需求理论、需求乘数差异、空头回补机制
AI.method: 实证分析：比较被动流量对多空头寸股票回报的不同影响，检验需求乘数差异和空头回补渠道。
AI.findings: 被动流入对空头股票回报的提升幅度大于多头股票，压缩多空回报差；空头回补是导致空头股票需求乘数更高的渠道之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 将被动流量驱动交易识别为一种新的套利限制机制，并揭示需求乘数不对称在其中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒量化策略投资者需关注被动资金流动对多空策略收益的侵蚀效应，尤其是在做空高被做空股票时。

title: The AI Act as a Third Structural Pole: A Constrained Retrospective on the Predictive Frame (2015 to 2026)

detail.title: The AI Act as a Third Structural Pole: A Constrained Retrospective on the Predictive Frame (2015 to 2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author operates Sprinkling Act, an independent pre-conformity advisory firm in the EU AI Act compliance market, based in Brussels (Belgium, BCE BE 1034.962.482). The doctrinal argument advanced in §6 of this paper (the "third structural pole" as the deployer-side documentation cascade under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) is consistent with the author's commercial activity. At the time of this paper's publication, no commercial relationship exists between Sprinkling Act and the entities, providers, or sources cited in this paper. Readers may reasonably weigh this alignment when assessing the doctrinal claim. The empirical findings in §2 through §5, sourced exclusively to external primary documentation (Epoch AI, METR, Stanford AI Index, OJ L of 12 July 2024, peer-reviewed neuroscience and AI safety literature), are independent of the doctrinal claim and can be accepted or rejected separately.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a doctrinal discussion paper based on publicly available primary sources (regulatory documentation, peer-reviewed academic literature, technical reports, public AI benchmark trackers). No human or animal subjects, no patient data, no surveys, and no interviews are involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author through Sprinkling Act (Brussels, Belgium). No external funding, grants, or sponsorships were received from any organization with a stake in the regulatory outcomes discussed. The author retains full editorial independence.

detail.abstract: In January 2015, Tim Urban consolidated the dominant AI predictive frame of his moment, drawing on Bostrom's Superintelligence, Kurzweil's The Singularity Is Near, the Müller-Bostrom expert survey, and Yudkowsky's writings on the alignment problem. Eleven years later, the empirical record is verifiable. This discussion paper scores twenty-five atomic claims from the 2015 frame against primary sources at May 2026 using a methodology derived from Armstrong (2012) and Tetlock (2015). The aggregate distribution exhibits directional correctness with systematic magnitude bias: four claims verified, seven partially verified, three refuted, six premature, five non-falsifiable. The paper then proposes a doctrinal reframing. It argues that the empirical record of 2015 to 2026 is consistent with the emergence of a third structural pole between the Bostromian binary of extinction and immortality: the regulated deployment regime created by Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, operationalised through the deployer-side documentation cascade under Articles 25, 26, 27, 49 and 50. This pole is neither the AI system nor the regulator's certification; it is the article-by-article public artefact that any deployer of a high-risk system must produce to be in a defensible position. The paper closes with a constrained prediction, falsifiable by 2 December 2027, that at least one formal Article 99 enforcement action against a designated systemic-risk GPAI provider will have been opened under Article 55(1)(d). The methodology note (§7) is generalisable to retrospective exercises on comparable predictive frames. Companion to the EU AI Act Readiness Report (April 2026) and Annex A: The Deployer Multiplier (May 2026)

AI.tldr: 本文评估了2015年主流AI预测框架（基于Bostrom、Kurzweil等人）的25项原子性主张，发现其在方向正确但量级偏差严重。作者提出欧盟AI法案（Regulation 2024/1689）构成了Bostrom式"灭绝vs永生"二元论之外的第三极——一个通过部署者文档化合规流程实现的规范化监管体制。论文最后给出了一个可在2027年12月2日前证伪的约束性预测。
AI.research_question: 2015年AI预测框架（"奇点/灭绝"范式）在实证检验中表现如何？是否需要一个替代性分析框架？
AI.motivation: 2015年Tim Urban整合的主流AI预测框架已在2026年积累了足够实证记录可供检验；同时欧盟AI法案的出台表明既有"要么灭绝要么永生"的二元叙事遗漏了一个正在实际运作的监管第三极。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合Armstrong (2012)的预测评分方法论与Tetlock (2015)的超级预测者框架，对预测主张进行原子化拆解与实证验证。在此基础上提出"监管第三极"概念，挑战Bostrom的二元结构。
AI.method: 对2015年框架的25项原子性主张进行文献追踪与实证评分（方向正确性与量级偏差评估），分类为已验证、部分验证、证伪、过早、不可证伪五类。
AI.findings: 4项已验证，7项部分验证，3项被证伪，6项过早，5项不可证伪。整体呈现方向正确但系统性量级偏差。欧盟AI法案（Articles 25-27, 49-50等）构成了一个可操作的监管体制，其核心是部署者层面的文档化合规链条（deployer-side documentation cascade）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"监管第三极"理论概念，打破Bostrom式"灭绝vs永生"的二元分析框架；提出"部署者乘数"（Deployer Multiplier）概念，强调合规文档链作为可验证的公共人工制品的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI风险预测提供了可复制的回顾性评估方法论（§7）；为欧盟AI法案合规实践提供了可操作的文档化路径指引；提出了一个可在2027年12月2日前被明确证伪的具体预测（针对系统性风险GPAI提供商的Article 99执法行动），推动了AI治理领域的可证伪性实践。

title: Weakened Linkages between Regulatory Disclosures and Financial Reporting: Evidence from IFRS Adoption
affiliations: , Stockholm School of Economics,  and

detail.title: Weakened Linkages between Regulatory Disclosures and Financial Reporting: Evidence from IFRS Adoption
detail.abstract: Firms are often subject to industry-or jurisdiction-specific disclosure requirements designed and mandated by distinct regulators alongside the applicable accounting standards. However, empirical evidence on the linkages between regulatory disclosures and financial statements remains limited. This study shows how a change in the financial reporting regime (from Canadian GAAP to IFRS) weakens the linkage between Canadian oil and gas (O&G) firms' reserve disclosures and their financial reports. While Canadian GAAP explicitly required companies to consider reserve disclosures when preparing financial statements (e.g., depreciation and impairment tests), IFRS adoption relaxed such integration, despite the reserves information generally being viewed as economically relevant. We exploit this weakening of the formal linkage between the two reporting systems in our study. Consistent with prior literature, we find that reserve estimates by Canadian O&G firms are value relevant, however, their value relevance decreases significantly in the post-IFRS period, indicating that investors place less weight on reserve information once its connection to the financial statements is weakened. We also find weakened capital market reactions (abnormal returns and liquidity) to the release of reserve news in the post-IFRS period for Canadian O&G firms. We examine two channels to explain the observed effects: (i) increased information processing costs and (ii) lower information reliability. Our tests indicate that both higher processing costs and lower perceived reliability explain the post-IFRS decline in reserve informativeness. Our results are relevant in contexts where both mandatory economically relevant disclosures (R&D projects, mineral reserves, GHG emissions) and accounting numbers are independently provided to users.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加拿大油气公司从加拿大GAAP转向IFRS后，储备披露与财务报表之间的正式联系被削弱，导致储备信息的价值相关性、市场反应和流动性均显著下降，主要原因是信息处理成本上升和感知可靠性降低。
AI.research_question: 当财务报告制度发生变化，导致监管性披露（如油气储备信息）与财务报表之间的正式联系被削弱时，储备信息的价值相关性和资本市场反应会发生怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 企业常需同时遵守行业/司法管辖区特定的披露要求与会计准则，但二者之间的关联如何影响信息有用性，现有实证证据有限。本文利用加拿大GAAP向IFRS转换这一外生冲击，探究两类报告系统之间正式联系弱化的经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息价值相关性理论、信息处理成本理论、信息可靠性理论。正式制度联系（formal linkage）影响信息的"可及性"与"可信度"，进而调节投资者对信息的依赖程度。
AI.method: 采用双重差分或前后对比设计，利用加拿大油气公司从加拿大GAAP转向IFRS这一准自然实验；使用回归分析检验价值相关性（股价关联）、事件研究法分析市场反应（异常收益率和流动性），并检验信息处理成本和感知可靠性两个中介渠道。
AI.findings: （1）加拿大油气公司的储备估计在IFRS实施后仍然具有价值相关性，但价值相关性显著下降；（2）IFRS实施后，市场对储备新闻发布的异常收益率和流动性反应减弱；（3）这种下降可由信息处理成本上升和感知可靠性降低两个渠道解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了正式制度联系（formal linkage）在调节非财务信息披露与财务报表之间关系中的关键作用；拓展了对会计准则变更如何影响监管性披露信息有用性的理解；为"信息生态"中不同报告系统之间的互动提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 对监管机构（如会计准则制定者、行业监管者）有重要启示：在设计披露要求时需关注不同类型报告之间的制度协调；对投资者而言，提示在会计准则变更后需调整对特定信息的权重；对国际财务报告准则的后续修订和类似情境（如研发项目、矿产储量、温室气体排放等独立披露）具有参考价值。
