title: The Gender Wage Gap after a Large Minimum Wage Increase: Evidence from Spain
affiliations: American University - Department of Economics, Department of Fundamentals of Economic Analysis I (Economic Analysis) and

detail.title: The Gender Wage Gap after a Large Minimum Wage Increase: Evidence from Spain
detail.abstract: Spain's 2019 minimum wage reform raised the statutory wage floor by 22.3%, an unprecedented increase in a low-inflation environment. This paper studies its effects on the gender wage gap using administrative data drawn from Spanish social security records. Exploiting cross-municipality variation in pre-reform exposure to the reform, we find that the policy substantially compressed gender wage inequality, reducing the gender wage gap by 36% at the 5th percentile and 24% at the 10th percentile of the wage distribution. To investigate the underlying mechanisms, we implement a bin-based difference-indifferences design comparing men and women at the same point of the pre-reform wage distribution. We find that treated men and women experienced nearly identical wage gains of approximately six percentage points, with little evidence of differential effects on hours worked, employer mobility, or employment retention. Taken together, the results indicate that the decline in the gender wage gap was driven by the disproportionate concentration of women in low-wage jobs, where the policy was most binding, rather than by differential labor market responses between comparable men and women.

AI.tldr: 西班牙2019年最低工资改革使法定工资下限提高了22.3%，该政策通过女性在低工资岗位上的过度集中（而非男女性劳工市场反应的差异），显著压缩了性别工资差距，在工资分布第5和第10百分位分别降低了36%和24%。
AI.research_question: 西班牙2019年最低工资大幅上涨如何影响性别工资差距？其背后的作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 西班牙2019年最低工资改革在低通胀环境下实现了22.3%的空前涨幅，这为研究最低工资政策对性别工资不平等的影响提供了难得的准自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工资分布的分位数分析框架，利用不同城市在改革前对最低工资的暴露程度差异，以及分档双重差分设计来比较同一工资分布点上男女的不同反应。
AI.method: 利用西班牙社保记录的行政数据，采用跨城市改革前暴露程度的差异识别策略，并结合基于工资分档的双重差分设计（bin-based DiD），比较改革前后同一工资分布点上男性和女性的工资变化。
AI.findings: （1）改革使性别工资差距在工资分布第5百分位缩小了36%，第10百分位缩小了24%；（2）受影响的男性和女性工资涨幅均约为6个百分点，几乎没有差异；（3）工作时间、雇主流动性和就业留存等方面不存在显著的性别差异效应；（4）性别工资差距的缩小主要源于女性在低工资岗位上的过度集中，而非男女劳工市场反应的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了最低工资政策影响性别工资差距的机制——并非通过改变相同条件下男女的劳工市场行为差异，而是通过女性在工资分布底端的结构性集中来实现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了最低工资作为缩小性别工资不平等工具的有力证据，表明大幅提高最低工资可以有效减少低分位处的性别工资差距。

title: AI Governance for FDIC-Insured Institutions: A Practitioner's Framework

detail.title: AI Governance for FDIC-Insured Institutions: A Practitioner's Framework

declarations.funderStatement: Unfunded. Independent research conducted by the author.

detail.abstract: Federal regulatory mandates for AI governance in financial services have accelerated since January 2025. Community and regional banks with assets between $100M and $10B face examiner expectations under SR 11-7, OCC 2011-12, and April 2026 revised model risk management guidance without access to tools built for institutions their size. The regulatory gap is real and documented. SR 11-7, extended to AI by the April 2026 interagency guidance, ends up in examination reports that most community banks are not ready for. The sections below map those requirements to a practical governance framework for midmarket institutions. The analysis draws on 42 applied AI certifications and risk management practice developed across 9 or more regulated entities at a $74B+ financial conglomerate. A working reference implementation provides the evidence. The goal is not to prove that regulation is demanding. It is to make compliance operationally tractable. The implementation exists.

AI.tldr: 本文针对资产规模在1亿至100亿美元之间的社区和区域银行，提出了一套可操作的人工智能治理框架，以应对2025年1月以来加速出台的联邦监管要求（如SR 11-7、OCC 2011-12及2026年4月修订的模型风险管理指南）。作者基于在740亿美元以上金融集团中获得的42项AI认证和风险管理实践经验，构建了参考实施方案，旨在将合规要求转化为中等规模机构可实际执行的路径。
AI.research_question: 社区和区域银行如何在缺乏为其规模量身定制的工具的情况下，有效满足联邦监管机构对AI治理的合规要求？
AI.motivation: 2025年1月以来联邦AI治理监管加速，但现有监管框架（如SR 11-7）主要服务于大型机构，社区和区域银行面临实际但缺乏可行工具的合规压力，监管检查中已暴露出这些机构尚未准备好的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模型风险管理框架（SR 11-7、OCC 2011-12）、2026年4月修订的跨部门AI治理指南，以及将这些监管要求映射到中等规模机构可操作的治理框架。
AI.method: 基于42项AI认证和风险管理实践经验，在740亿美元以上金融集团的9个以上受监管实体中开发，并提供了可工作的参考实现作为证据。
AI.findings: 监管差距真实存在且已被记录；大多数社区银行未准备好应对SR 11-7及2026年4月跨部门指南扩展至AI的检查要求；但通过将监管要求映射到中等规模机构的实际治理框架，合规可以变得在操作上可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 将抽象的联邦AI治理监管要求具体化为中等规模金融机构可操作的治理框架，填补了现有模型风险管理指南在社区和区域银行AI治理中的实践空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产1亿至100亿美元的社区和区域银行提供了可直接参考的AI治理实施方案，使监管合规在操作层面变得可行，帮助这些机构应对2026年4月修订后的模型风险管理检查期望。

title: Inequality, Welfare, and the Cost of Coordination Failure
affiliations: Georgetown University - Department of Economics and Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB)

detail.title: Inequality, Welfare, and the Cost of Coordination Failure
detail.abstract: Coordination failures arise when society gets stuck in a "bad" equilibrium when a Pareto superior one exists. How does wealth inequality affect coordination failure? This paper models a large, heterogeneous society where individuals' consumptionsavings choices are influenced by investment spillovers. The cost of coordination failure (CCF) in this society is the welfare difference between the "good" (high investment) and the "bad" (low investment) equilibrium. We provide natural conditions under which the CCF is increasing under mean-preserving spreads in wealth inequality. We also establish a trifurcation result in which high enough inequality creates a coordination failure where none had existed. Starting from a stable equilibrium where investment is unaffected by inequality, the equilibrium becomes unstable as inequality increases, and two other stable equilibria-a good one and a bad one-emerge. In the bad equilibrium, inequality always reduces both aggregate investment and aggregate welfare. In the good one, inequality is always investment-enhancing. Furthermore, there is a range of parameters where inequality is actually Pareto-improving in the good equilibrium. In all cases, the welfare gap (the CCF) between the two equilibria increases with inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了财富不平等如何影响社会中的协调失败（即社会陷入次优均衡的情况），发现不平等加剧会扩大协调失败的成本，并可能催生新的协调失败均衡，同时在不同均衡下不平等对投资和福利的影响截然不同。
AI.research_question: 财富不平等如何影响社会中的协调失败（协调失败的成本）？
AI.motivation: 协调失败（社会陷入帕累托次优均衡）是一个重要的经济学问题，但现有研究对财富不平等在其中扮演的角色关注不足。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质性主体的一般均衡模型，引入投资溢出效应和消费储蓄选择，结合均值保留展型（mean-preserving spread）分析不平等的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学推导，分析均值保留展型下财富不平等对协调失败成本（CCF）的影响，并建立均衡的三分叉（trifurcation）结果。
AI.findings: (1) 在自然条件下，协调失败成本随财富不平等（均值保留展型）递增；(2) 存在三分叉结果：当不平等足够高时，原本稳定的均衡变得不稳定，分裂出一个好均衡和一个坏均衡；(3) 坏均衡下不平等降低总投资和总福利，好均衡下不平等促进投资；(4) 在特定参数范围内，好均衡下的不平等是帕累托改进的；(5) 两种均衡之间的福利差距（协调失败成本）始终随不平等增加而扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模了财富不平等与协调失败之间的因果关系，揭示了不平等通过影响均衡稳定性进而改变社会协调结果的理论机制，提出了“三分叉”这一新的均衡动态理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：控制财富不平等不仅是公平问题，也是效率问题——过高的不平等可能引发或加剧协调失败，导致社会陷入低投资、低福利的坏均衡。

title: Luxembourg's Long-Term Pressures and a Sustainability Compact Ageing, Productivity, Climate and Inclusion in a AAA Financial Centre
affiliations: Independent Policy Analyst

detail.title: Luxembourg's Long-Term Pressures and a Sustainability Compact Ageing, Productivity, Climate and Inclusion in a AAA Financial Centre

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial or personal relationships that could influence the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a policy analysis and does not involve human participants, patient data, or empirical studies requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Luxembourg’s AAA sovereign rating, world-class financial centre, and high per capita income reflect genuine institutional strength. Yet beneath this resilience, four structural pressures are accumulating simultaneously and reinforcing each other: demographic ageing and pension sustainability risks, weak productivity growth, climate-transition adjustment pressures, and persistent labour-market skill mismatches. Drawing on IMF, OECD, European Commission, and Luxembourg national institutional assessments, this paper develops a qualitative policy framework examining how these pressures interact within Luxembourg’s finance-led economic model. The paper argues that fragmented sector-by-sector reform is unlikely to remain fiscally or politically sustainable over the long term. Instead, it proposes a phased sustainability compact linking pension reform, productivity and innovation policy, climate-transition sequencing, and labour-market inclusion within a coordinated governance framework. The paper’s contribution is organisational and policy-analytical rather than econometric: it synthesises convergent institutional assessments into a sequenced implementation framework calibrated to Luxembourg’s consensus-oriented governance architecture. The analysis concludes that earlier, moderate and coordinated reforms are substantially less disruptive than delayed reactive adjustment once structural pressures intensify.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了卢森堡面临的人口老龄化、生产率增长乏力、气候转型压力和劳动力市场技能错配这四大结构性压力及其相互强化作用，提出了一个分阶段、协调一致的可持续发展契约框架，主张尽早实施温和且协调的改革以避免未来更严重的破坏性调整。
AI.research_question: 在以金融为主导的卢森堡经济模式下，四大结构性压力（人口老龄化与养老金可持续性、生产率增长乏力、气候转型压力、劳动力市场技能错配）如何相互作用？以及如何设计一个协调的治理框架来应对这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 卢森堡虽然拥有AAA主权评级、世界级金融中心和高人均收入，但四大结构性压力正在同时累积并相互强化。碎片化的部门改革在长期财政和政治上不可持续，亟需一个协调的综合政策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于IMF、OECD、欧盟委员会和卢森堡国家机构的评估，构建了一个定性的政策分析框架，关注结构性压力在金融主导经济模式下的相互作用机制。
AI.method: 定性政策分析，综合了多边机构和本国机构的评估报告，提出了一个分阶段实施的政策框架。
AI.findings: 碎片化的部门改革不可持续；早期温和且协调的改革比延迟的被动调整破坏性小得多；需要一个将养老金改革、生产率与创新政策、气候转型排序和劳动力市场包容性联系起来的可持续发展契约。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的贡献在于组织性和政策分析层面，而非计量经济学层面——将趋同的机构评估综合成一个适合卢森堡共识导向治理架构的分阶段实施框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卢森堡政策制定者提供了一个可操作的、分阶段的可持续发展契约框架，强调早期协调改革相较于延迟调整的优势。

title: Transitory Shocks and Consumption Dynamics: Pent-Up Demand or Hand-to-Mouth?
affiliations: Swiss National Bank - Study Center Gerzensee, Swiss Finance Institute and Queen Mary University of London - School of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Transitory Shocks and Consumption Dynamics: Pent-Up Demand or Hand-to-Mouth?
detail.abstract: We examine the recovery of U.S. consumer spending following the COVID-19 recession using monthly transaction data for over 34,000 individuals. We find limited evidence that cutbacks in spending on in-person services or durables during the recession generated pent-up demand. Instead, spending dynamics are largely consistent with hand-to-mouth behavior: expenditures during and after the recession are correlated with income changes, even more so among households with low liquidity buffers and lower income levels. These results underscore the central role of income and liquidity, rather than sentiment or forced savings, in driving the post-recession dynamics of consumer spending.

AI.tldr: 本文利用超过34,000名个人的月度交易数据，研究了美国消费者支出在COVID-19衰退后的恢复情况。研究发现，衰退期间在面对面服务或耐用品上的支出削减并未产生显著的被压抑需求。相反，支出动态主要与"手到口"（hand-to-mouth）行为一致：衰退期间及之后的支出与收入变化相关，在流动性缓冲较低和收入水平较低的家庭中尤为明显。这些结果强调了收入和流动性而非情绪或强制储蓄在推动消费者支出后衰退动态中的核心作用。
AI.research_question: 美国消费者支出在COVID-19衰退后如何恢复？衰退期间被压抑的服务和耐用品需求是否推动了支出复苏？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情导致的衰退具有独特性——消费者被迫削减服务支出（而非由于收入下降或信心不足），这产生了大量强制性储蓄。理解这种独特冲击下消费者支出恢复的驱动因素（是被压抑需求还是收入变化），对预测经济复苏路径和制定政策具有重要价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 被压抑需求理论（pent-up demand）：认为疫情期间被迫储蓄会导致后期支出激增；2) 手到口行为理论（hand-to-mouth behavior）：强调消费主要受当期收入和流动性约束影响，而非跨期平滑。
AI.method: 使用超过34,000名美国消费者的月度交易数据进行实证分析，通过比较不同收入水平和流动性缓冲的家庭在衰退期间及之后的支出模式，检验被压抑需求假说与手到口行为假说。
AI.findings: 1) 未发现被压抑需求的显著证据，服务及耐用品支出削减并未转化为后期支出激增；2) 支出动态与手到口行为一致，即消费与当期收入变化高度相关；3) 这种收入-支出关联在流动性缓冲低和收入水平低的家庭中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了疫情期间常见的"被压抑需求"驱动复苏的观点，提供了手到口行为理论在特殊冲击情境下的实证支持，丰富了关于消费者支出对收入冲击反应的研究文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：在后疫情时期刺激消费复苏时，直接收入支持（如转移支付）比释放"被压抑需求"更为有效。对于低收入和低流动性家庭，保障收入稳定性是稳定消费的关键。

title: Structural OS for Human Understanding (SOHU): A Full-Stack Architecture for Meaning, Cognition, and AI Alignment
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Structural OS for Human Understanding (SOHU): A Full-Stack Architecture for Meaning, Cognition, and AI Alignment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper presents a conceptual framework and does not involve human participants or patient data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Current AI systems demonstrate remarkable capability in language fluency, reasoning, and code generation, yet they consistently fail at a more fundamental task: structurally understanding the human being they interact with. This paper introduces Structural OS for Human Understanding (SOHU), a five-layer structural stack — Semantic OS, Cognitive OS, Interaction OS, Context OS, and Civilization Framework — built on top of the Human Natural Structure (HNS) 36-Matrix coordinate system. SOHU uses HNS as its kernel and integrates with the External Verification Architecture (EVA) to form the world's first structural full-stack OS for human-aligned AI.

The framework provides: (1) interpretable AI alignment, (2) hallucination prevention at the conceptual level, and (3) foundational infrastructure for human-AI cognitive alignment. The HNS–SOHU–EVA three-layer architecture aligns with ISO/IEC 42001:2023, the EU AI Act, and IEEE P7001.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SOHU（人类理解结构化操作系统），一个五层结构栈（语义OS、认知OS、交互OS、上下文OS和文明框架），基于HNS 36-矩阵坐标系构建，并结合外部验证架构EVA，形成首个用于人类对齐AI的结构化全栈操作系统。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够从根本上结构化理解人类的AI系统，以解决当前AI系统在人类理解上的根本性失败？
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在语言流畅性、推理和代码生成方面表现出色，但在更基础的任务——结构化理解所交互的人类——上却持续失败。这构成了AI对齐的根本性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: HNS（人类自然结构）36-矩阵坐标系、五层结构栈（语义OS、认知OS、交互OS、上下文OS、文明框架）、EVA（外部验证架构）
AI.method: 提出HNS–SOHU–EVA三层架构，将人类结构化理解作为AI内核（HNS），构建全栈操作系统（SOHU），并集成外部验证机制（EVA）。
AI.findings: 该框架提供：(1)可解释的AI对齐，(2)概念层面的幻觉预防，(3)人机认知对齐的基础设施。且与ISO/IEC 42001:2023、EU AI Act和IEEE P7001等国际标准对齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出将人类自然结构（HNS）作为AI操作系统的内核，构建了结构化的全栈人类理解框架，为AI对齐提供了新的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可落地的AI对齐基础设施方案，能够预防概念层面的AI幻觉，并符合多项国际AI治理标准。

title: From Jurisdiction to Administrative Capability: Reconstructing State Tax Enforcement in the Digital Economy
affiliations: New York State Department of Taxation & Finance

detail.title: From Jurisdiction to Administrative Capability: Reconstructing State Tax Enforcement in the Digital Economy
detail.abstract: The expansion of digital commerce has significantly transformed the operational structure of state taxation within the United States. Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., states acquired broader jurisdictional authority through economic nexus standards, permitting taxation based upon economic participation rather than physical presence alone. While the legal reach of state taxation expanded rapidly after Wayfair, administrative enforcement systems have evolved at a comparatively uneven pace. This paper examines the growing divergence between expanded jurisdictional authority and the administrative capability required to enforce compliance effectively within digitally mediated economies. The analysis introduces the concept of the Jurisdiction-Capability Gap to describe the structural imbalance between legal authority and operational enforcement capacity in modern tax systems. The paper further develops the concept of the Digital Enforcement Gap, referring to enforcement limitations arising from fragmented data environments, retrospective audit methodologies, limited cross-system integration, and the increasing complexity of digital transaction ecosystems. The analysis argues that contemporary enforcement limitations increasingly arise not from insufficient legal authority, but from insufficient administrative capability. To address these structural limitations, the paper explores the potential role of AI-assisted administrative systems within risk-based tax enforcement frameworks, including multi-source data integration, adaptive risk prioritization, anomaly detection systems, and scalable analytical infrastructures. Rather than advocating replacement of professional judgment or legal interpretation, this paper examines how administrative modernization may improve enforcement efficiency while preserving procedural fairness, statutory interpretation, and human oversight. The paper contributes to broader discussions in public finance, digital governance, administrative modernization, and digital taxation by arguing that the future effectiveness of tax administration increasingly depends upon institutional capability rather than jurisdictional reach alone.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国数字商业扩张背景下，州税收管辖权扩大与执法能力之间的结构性失衡，提出了"管辖权-能力缺口"和"数字执法缺口"两个概念，并分析了AI辅助系统在风险导向税收执法中的潜在作用。
AI.research_question: 在数字商业扩张背景下，美国州税收管辖权扩大后，税务机关的执法能力是否足以支撑扩大的管辖权？如何弥合管辖权与执法能力之间的结构性缺口？
AI.motivation: South Dakota v. Wayfair案后，各州获得了基于经济联系而非实体存在的税收管辖权，但行政执法的实际能力并未同步提升，导致法律授权与执法能力之间出现日益扩大的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管辖权-能力缺口理论（Jurisdiction-Capability Gap）、数字执法缺口理论（Digital Enforcement Gap）、风险导向税收执法框架
AI.method: 概念分析与理论建构，基于对美国州税制度演进、Wayfair案后法律变革及数字化交易环境的系统分析。
AI.findings: 当代税收执法的限制主要源于行政能力不足而非法律授权不足；数字执法缺口源于碎片化数据环境、回溯性审计方法、有限的跨系统整合以及数字交易生态系统的日益复杂化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"管辖权-能力缺口"和"数字执法缺口"两个原创性概念，为理解现代税制中法律授权与行政能力之间的结构性张力提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 探讨了AI辅助行政系统（多源数据整合、自适应风险优先级排序、异常检测系统、可扩展分析基础设施）在风险导向税收执法中的潜在应用，强调在不替代专业判断和司法解释的前提下提升执法效率。

title: BOOK REVIEW: Investment Positivism: the New Main Event; Insider Trading Remains the Sideshow
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University, Dickinson Law

detail.title: BOOK REVIEW: Investment Positivism: the New Main Event; Insider Trading Remains the Sideshow
detail.abstract: Prior to the 1929 stock market crash, the securities markets were functioning as a circus-a source of entertainment and wonder for everyday folks. Readers of Sorkin's new book, 1929: Inside the Greatest Crash in Wall Street History, get a front row seat at this event. Analogies exist between the circus atmosphere preceding the 1929 crash and today's securities markets that invite reflection on the regulatory approach adopted after the crash to ensure fair and efficient markets. As one example, insider trading was acknowledged as undesirable behavior in the 1929 crash postmortem and was addressed through disclosure requirements. Insider trading was not viewed as fraudulent behavior undermining the reliability of U.S. markets. Market manipulation was the focus of federal securities regulation because, among other things, it undermined the ability of organic economic forces to determine stock prices. Today, allegations of insider trading assail the marketplace. As was true in 1929, insider trading remains a spectacle sideshow. This essay suggests a new risk to market integrity: investment positivism. It identifies investment positivism as the concept that the government is responsible for determining the profitability and social utility of stock investments for the benefit of its taxpaying citizens. This concept is observed in the government's recent acquisition of a 9.9% equity stake in Intel, Inc. This essay asserts that investment positivism merits empirical analysis to determine its current and potential impact on American markets, and deserves legal research to ascertain whether the nonagenarian pillars of federal securities regulation built in 1934 are adequate to any negative consequences of this emerging practice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比1929年股市崩盘前后的证券市场监管与当今市场，提出了一种新的市场诚信风险——"投资实证主义"（即政府有责任为纳税人确定股票投资的盈利性和社会效用），并以政府收购英特尔9.9%股权为例，呼吁对该现象进行实证分析和法律研究。
AI.research_question: 当代证券市场中"投资实证主义"（政府决定股票投资盈利性与社会效用的理念）对市场诚信构成何种风险？1934年建立的联邦证券监管框架是否足以应对这一新兴实践？
AI.motivation: 1929年股市崩盘前的"马戏团式"氛围与当今证券市场存在相似之处，但当前市场中内幕交易问题持续存在，且出现了政府直接干预股票投资价值判断的新现象，引发对现有监管框架适用性的反思。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史类比分析；投资实证主义概念框架；联邦证券监管的立法基础（1934年证券交易法）。
AI.method: 历史分析（1929年崩盘回顾与监管应对）；案例研究（政府收购英特尔9.9%股权）；概念建构（投资实证主义）。
AI.findings: 1929年崩盘后，监管重点在于市场操纵（因为其破坏有机经济力量决定股价的能力），而非内幕交易（仅通过披露要求处理）；当今内幕交易仍是"边表演"；投资实证主义作为一种新的市场诚信风险已被识别，但缺乏实证分析和法律研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"投资实证主义"这一新概念，将政府直接参与股票投资价值判断界定为一种潜在的市场诚信风险，拓展了证券市场监管理论的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁对政府股权投资行为进行实证分析以评估其对市场的影响；提出需研究1934年证券监管框架是否足以应对投资实证主义的负面后果，为政策制定和监管改革提供方向。

title: Lifeboat money: Securing human wellbeing
affiliations: International Institute for Self-Governance

detail.title: Lifeboat money: Securing human wellbeing

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not relevant

detail.abstract: Simplified “lifeboat” money was widely locally issued as “Stamp Scrip” in the Great Depression. It substantially reduced the cost of the financial system by its negative interest rate paid by users buying a 2% stamp to be fixed to its paper notes each week. This user payment was sufficient to redeem the notes in a year. Today this payment could become less than the tap-and-go cost of digital money. Beside sustaining life in the short run of a financial crisis, lifeboat money could also sustain life in the long run if it was re-introduced with its value defined by the sustainability of humanity on the planet. An initial metric of sustainability would be the amount of benign renewable energy consumed in each bioregion as a percentage of the total energy produced. The most sustainable regions would obtain the best exchange rates to sustain superior human wellbeing. Once market failure had been removed to stop consuming non-renewable energy then other metrics for sustaining wellbeing could be added to recycle non-renewable materials, protecting biodiversity, and matching the population levels in each region to its eternally sustainable regional endowments as achieved by Indigenous Australians. Lifeboat money removes inflation, the need for central banks, exchange rate volatility and uncertainly about the future.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在金融危机期间发行"救生艇货币"（Stamp Scrip）的构想，通过负利率机制降低金融系统成本，并进一步将其与可持续发展挂钩，以地区可再生能源消费占比定义货币价值，旨在消除通胀、央行需求、汇率波动和未来不确定性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种"救生艇货币"，既能应对短期金融危机，又能在长期内通过可持续性指标支撑人类福祉？
AI.motivation: 大萧条时期"邮票券"（Stamp Scrip）的成功实践表明，负利率货币可有效降低金融系统成本；而当前全球面临气候危机、资源枯竭等长期挑战，亟需将货币体系与可持续发展目标结合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负利率货币理论、可持续发展理论、区域生态承载力理论（借鉴澳大利亚原住民长期可持续实践）。
AI.method: 历史案例分析法（大萧条邮票券）、理论推演与概念设计。
AI.findings: 1）救生艇货币的负利率（每周2%印花税）成本已低于现代数字支付成本；2）以各地区良性可再生能源消费占比作为初始可持续性度量，最可持续地区可获得最优汇率；3）该货币可消除通胀、央行干预、汇率波动和未来不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将负利率货币从应急工具拓展至长期可持续性治理框架；2）提出以生态指标（而非传统经济指标）定义货币价值的新范式；3）融合原住民可持续实践与现代货币设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融危机提供低成本、去中心化的货币解决方案；2）通过货币汇率机制激励区域可再生能源转型和生态保护；3）为构建不依赖央行、无通胀的全球货币体系提供蓝图。

title: Research on Robust Dance Transfer Video Generation for High-Quality Human Subjects
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Shanghai Normal University and Jeonbuk National University

detail.title: Research on Robust Dance Transfer Video Generation for High-Quality Human Subjects
detail.abstract: The core requirement of human dance transfer video generation is to fuse the reference human subject with the target dance pose sequence while preserving the subject’s identity features, so as to generate video content with high fidelity and strong continuity. This technology boasts extensive application value in fields such as virtual try-on, short video creation, and film and television special effects. However, existing models generally suffer from poor visual consistency caused by multi-source feature disconnection, motion stuttering arising from insufficient spatiotemporal modeling, as well as detail distortion and texture warping in high-resolution generation. To address the aforementioned issues, this paper proposes an end-to-end generation network integrating dual-core modules (T-Net and RGB Module). Specifically, the T-Net module achieves deep collaboration among facial textures, scene styles, and motion structures through source-specific enhancement of multi-source features, dual cross-attention interaction, and temporal dependency modeling. The RGB Module adopts the strategies of multi-scale branch refinement and progressive residual fusion to ensure the consistency between small-scale details (e.g., hair strands and lip lines) and large-scale structures (e.g., limb contours). Experimental validation based on the TikTok Dataset demonstrates that the proposed model outperforms existing methods in both quantitative and qualitative comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合双核心模块（T-Net和RGB模块）的端到端生成网络，用于解决人体舞蹈迁移视频生成中多源特征断裂、动作卡顿和高分辨率畸变等问题，在TikTok数据集上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
AI.research_question: 如何生成高保真、强连续性的人体舞蹈迁移视频，实现参考人物与目标舞蹈姿势序列的深度融合？
AI.motivation: 现有模型存在多源特征断裂导致视觉一致性差、时空建模不足引起动作卡顿、高分辨率生成中的细节畸变和纹理扭曲等问题，亟需一种端到端的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多源特征增强、双交叉注意力交互、时序依赖建模（T-Net）；多尺度分支精炼与渐进残差融合（RGB模块）。
AI.method: 提出端到端生成网络，包含T-Net模块（多源特征增强+双交叉注意力+时序依赖建模）和RGB模块（多尺度分支精炼+渐进残差融合）。
AI.findings: 在TikTok数据集上的定量和定性比较中，所提模型均优于现有方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了T-Net与RGB模块双核心协同的端到端生成框架，解决了多源特征分离和时空一致性难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为虚拟试穿、短视频创作、影视特效等应用场景提供了高质量的人体舞蹈迁移视频生成方案。

title: Learning Networks
affiliations: Virginia Tech - Department of Economics, , Virginia Tech and Virginia Tech - Department of Economics

detail.title: Learning Networks
detail.abstract: We study repeated games in which agents observe only local actions and do not know how information flows across others. This creates uncertainty about both opponents' behavior and the interaction structure that determines payoffs and observations. We consider a setting in which this structure is not commonly known and ask whether it can be learned from repeated play.  Agents update beliefs based on their observations and choose actions that are optimal given their current beliefs. We show that behavior converges in finite time to the complete-information Nash equilibrium of the realized stage game, even without full identification of the interaction structure. We provide conditions under which the structure is identified and characterize how the speed of learning depends on network topology. A linear-quadratic example shows that when equilibrium actions reflect walk profiles in the network, then they can generically reveal the underlying structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在只能观察局部行动且不知信息如何流动的重复博弈中，代理人能否通过重复互动学习交互结构，并最终收敛到完全信息纳什均衡。
AI.research_question: 在交互结构（决定收益和观察）不被共同知识的情况下，代理人能否通过重复博弈学习该结构？
AI.motivation: 现实博弈中，代理人往往只知局部信息，不了解全局交互结构（如网络连接、信息流动路径），这带来了关于对手行为和交互结构的双重不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重复博弈理论、贝叶斯学习、网络博弈、结构识别理论
AI.method: 理论建模与证明，包含有限时间收敛分析、结构可识别性条件刻画，以及线性二次型示例分析。
AI.findings: (1) 即使在结构不共知的情况下，行为会在有限时间内收敛到完全信息纳什均衡；(2) 即使结构未被完全识别，收敛仍可能发生；(3) 给出了结构可识别的条件；(4) 学习速度依赖于网络拓扑；(5) 线性二次型例子显示，均衡行为反映网络中的行走轮廓时，可一般性地揭示底层结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不完全信息学习扩展到交互结构未知的重复博弈，揭示了有限时间收敛与结构识别的分离性，为网络博弈中的学习理论提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解社交网络、经济网络中的分散化学习过程，对网络设计、信息传播干预策略有参考价值。

title: EU Competition policy and the European integration of the Countries of Central and Eastern Europe that acceded to the European Union
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: EU Competition policy and the European integration of the Countries of Central and Eastern Europe that acceded to the European Union

keywords: countries of Central and Eastern Europe

publicationDetails.detailsText: Published in: L’Europe Unie / United Europe (Paris, France), Print ISSN 2780-8173; Online ISSN 2743-4052, Vol. 18, 2022, pp. 42–50

detail.abstract:
Published in: L’Europe Unie / United Europe (Paris, France), Print ISSN 2780-8173; Online ISSN 2743-4052, Vol. 18, 2022, pp. 42–50, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15178378.

The historical development of the EU competition policy has been instrumental for the structure of the Member States’ competition regimes, as well as for the legislative framework in the field of competition of a large number of countries beyond EU borders. This paper analyses how the provisions of the EU’s competition policy have been gradually adopted into national competition systems, either by voluntary convergence, or by preconditioning the access to the internal market of the Central and Eastern European countries pursuing EU accession to the alignment and harmonisation of the national legislation on competition to the EU competition provisions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟竞争政策如何通过自愿趋同或入盟条件，逐步被成员国及中东欧入盟国家的国内竞争制度所采纳。
AI.research_question: 欧盟竞争政策是如何被逐步采纳到成员国及入盟国家的国内竞争制度中的？
AI.motivation: 欧盟竞争政策的历史发展对成员国竞争体制结构及众多欧盟以外国家的竞争立法框架具有重要影响，因此有必要系统分析其采纳路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度趋同理论、欧洲化理论、法律移植与协调理论。
AI.method: 文献分析与制度比较研究，追踪欧盟竞争政策向国内竞争制度的采纳过程。
AI.findings: 欧盟竞争政策通过两种路径被采纳：一是自愿趋同，二是将国内竞争立法与欧盟竞争条款对齐和协调作为中东欧国家入盟的前提条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对欧盟竞争政策外部治理机制（特别是入盟条件性）如何推动制度趋同的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了欧盟竞争政策向域外扩散的机制和路径参考，对理解竞争法的国际协调具有实践意义。

title: Family Formation under a Subjective Future Constraint: Well-Being, Optimism, and Population Economics

detail.title: Family Formation under a Subjective Future Constraint: Well-Being, Optimism, and Population Economics
detail.abstract: Population economics has developed powerful models of marriage, fertility, and household formation. These models show how income, prices, education, child costs, time constraints, bargaining, housing markets, and family policy shape demographic behavior. Yet they leave underdeveloped a margin that is increasingly central to explaining declining fertility, delayed marriage, and weaker household formation: how people evaluate the future into which family commitments are made. After synthesizing this literature and the canonical models, I introduce the concept of a subjective future constraint. Family formation requires more than material affordability and temporal feasibility; it also requires a sufficiently favorable subjective assessment of the future to justify durable, long-horizon commitments. This constraint can be measured using subjective well-being, especially future life evaluation. I then outline an empirical agenda for population economics that integrates subjective well-being measures into models of fertility, household formation, labor markets, and macroeconomic equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文指出人口经济学模型虽能解释收入、价格、教育等因素对婚姻、生育和家庭形成的影响，却忽略了人们对未来的主观评估这一日益重要的维度。作者提出"主观未来约束"概念，认为家庭形成不仅需要物质可负担性和时间可行性，还需要对未来有足够有利的主观评估。文章建议将主观幸福感尤其是未来生活评价纳入人口经济学模型。
AI.research_question: 如何将人们对未来的主观评估纳入人口经济学模型，以解释生育率下降、婚姻延迟和家庭形成减弱等人口现象？
AI.motivation: 现有的人口经济学模型在解释收入、价格、教育、时间约束、住房市场等客观因素对人口行为的影响方面已相当成熟，但对于"人们如何评估将进行家庭承诺的未来"这一日益关键的维度却关注不足，而这对于解释持续下降的生育率、延迟的婚姻和减弱的家庭形成至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主观未来约束理论——家庭形成不仅需要物质 affordability 和时间 feasibility，还需要对未来的主观评估足够 favorable 以证明长期、持久的承诺是合理的。该约束可通过主观幸福感（尤其是未来生活评价）来衡量。
AI.method: 文献综合与理论建构，提出将主观幸福感测量（尤其是未来生活评价）纳入人口经济学模型的研究议程。
AI.findings: 提出"主观未来约束"概念，认为家庭形成决策受三类条件制约：物质可负担性、时间可行性，以及对未来足够有利的主观评估。后一维度可通过主观幸福感中"未来生活评价"指标进行测量。
AI.theory_contributions: 为人口经济学引入"主观未来约束"这一新概念，将主观评价维度纳入经典的人口经济学分析框架，扩展了生育、婚姻和家庭形成决策的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解低生育率和婚姻延迟提供了新的分析视角和测量方法，提示政策制定者不仅需要关注物质激励和时间政策，还需关注人们的主观未来预期和幸福感。

title: Mapping Perception Gaps: Measuring Objective-Subjective Divergence in Local Conditions Across German Districts
affiliations: Arizona State University (ASU),  and Arizona State University (ASU) - School of Complex Adaptive Systems

detail.title: Mapping Perception Gaps: Measuring Objective-Subjective Divergence in Local Conditions Across German Districts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses secondary, aggregated, anonymized survey data at the German district level. The authors did not collect data directly from human participants and did not have access to personally identifiable individual-level responses. The survey data were obtained under a confidential data-use agreement, and all analyses were conducted on district-level aggregated measures. Accordingly, no additional ethics approval or written participant consent was required for the present secondary analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a district-level social indicator of perception gaps: the extent to which residents evaluate local conditions more negatively or more positively than would be expected from the national objective-subjective relationship. The analysis uses Germany's 2024 Equivalence Report, which combines district-level administrative indicators with a purpose-built survey covering all 400 German districts (Kreise) and independent cities (kreisfreie Städte). We pair objective and subjective measures in eight domains: regional economy, household material situation, safety, supermarket availability, childcare, medical-care access, education access, and air quality. Within each domain, objective indicators are harmonized so that more favorable objective indicators are directionally aligned with more favorable survey responses. The district residual from that national relationship defines the perception gap. The results show, first, that alignment between objective and subjective conditions varies sharply across domains: it is strongest for regional economy, childcare, education access, and air quality, and substantially weaker for household material situation and supermarket availability. Second, perception gaps are geographically structured. Eastern districts evaluate several domains more negatively than comparable western districts, while large urban districts show more negative-than-expected gaps in childcare and air quality; all eight domains exhibit positive spatial autocorrelation. Third, in exploratory ecological models, more negative gaps in several domains are associated with higher district far-right vote share after a limited set of structural controls, although the design does not support causal claims. These findings underscore the need for targeted, place-based policy approaches that address perceptual disparities as part of achieving equitable living conditions. The paper argues that divergence between objective and subjective local conditions should be conceptualized as a substantively meaningful regional outcome rather than dismissed as residual variation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于德国400个地区的主客观数据，构建了"感知差距"指标（实际主观评价与基于客观条件预期的主观评价之差），发现该差距在不同领域差异显著、存在地理结构，且与极右翼投票率相关。论文主张将感知差距视为有实质意义的区域结果而非残差。
AI.research_question: 居民对当地条件的主观评价与基于客观条件预期的主观评价之间存在多大差距？这种差距在不同领域、不同地区如何分布？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，社会指标研究多关注客观条件，但居民的主观感知同样重要且可能与客观条件脱节。理解这种"感知差距"及其地理分布，有助于制定更有针对性的区域政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知差距理论（perception gaps）：将主观评价对客观条件的回归残差定义为感知差距，即居民评价比客观条件预期更消极或更积极的程度。
AI.method: 使用德国2024年Equivalence Report数据，覆盖400个地区。配对八个领域的主客观指标（区域经济、家庭物质状况、安全、超市可得性、儿童保育、医疗可及性、教育可及性、空气质量），将客观指标标准化方向与主观评价一致。通过回归残差定义感知差距，并进行空间自相关分析和生态回归模型。
AI.findings: (1)主客观对齐程度因领域而异：区域经济、儿童保育、教育可及性、空气质量较强；家庭物质状况、超市可得性较弱。(2)感知差距存在地理结构：东部地区多领域评价更消极；大城市在儿童保育和空气质量上更消极；所有领域均呈现正向空间自相关。(3)在控制有限结构变量后，多个领域更消极的感知差距与更高极右翼投票率相关（非因果）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证了"感知差距"这一概念框架，将主客观条件的残差从统计噪声重新概念化为具有实质意义的区域社会指标，为区域不平等研究提供了新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供基于感知差距的精准施策依据，识别出哪些领域、哪些地区存在"客观改善但主观未感知"或"客观尚可但主观悲观"的错配问题，有助于设计针对性的沟通策略和区域政策。

title: The Pigouvian Bias: Distributional Weights and Discrete Choice Valuation
affiliations: University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

detail.title: The Pigouvian Bias: Distributional Weights and Discrete Choice Valuation
detail.abstract: Discrete choice experiments (DCEs) have become the standard tool for environmental policy evaluation, applying a willingness-to-pay (WTP) criterion to assess whether environmental interventions generate net social benefits. This practice assumes distributional neutrality, a marginal cost of public funds equal to one, and behavioural responses limited to consumer-side substitution. These conditions are inherited from the marketing origins of DCEs and are misaligned with the institutional and distributive structures shaping environmental taxation.Drawing on the sufficient-statistics framework of optimal taxation, this paper shows that the standard WTP-based criterion is a restrictive special case of a broader welfare-consistent environmental tax formula incorporating distributional weights, avoidance behaviour, and firm-side rent-seeking. Using calibrated simulations based on European income distributions, we quantify what we term the Pigouvian Bias as the systematic divergence between the aggregate-WTP benchmark and the socially optimal environmental tax. The magnitude of this bias ranges from 14.6 to 36 per cent across parameterisations, with a baseline component of 14.6% driven solely by the marginal cost of public funds and independent of any normative assumptions about inequality aversion. The direction and magnitude of the remaining component depend on the income distribution and the degree of inequality aversion, varying systematically across European economies.We then propose the DCE-Saez, a redesigned stated-preference instrument that recovers the distributional, behavioural, and firm-response parameters required for welfare-consistent evaluation. The design follows Johnston et al. (2017) on incentive compatibility and consequentiality, extending current stated-preference practice to recover the parameters that social welfare evaluation requires.

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于支付意愿（WTP）的离散选择实验（DCE）环境政策评估方法存在"庇古偏差"，将其与最优税收的充分统计量框架结合，提出了修正后的DCE-Saez工具，并通过欧洲数据量化了14.6%-36%的评估偏差。
AI.research_question: 基于WTP的DCE方法是否以及如何在环境政策评估中产生系统性偏差？如何设计新的陈述偏好工具以进行福利一致的环境税评估？
AI.motivation: DCE已成为环境政策评估的标准工具，但其继承自市场营销的假设（分配中性、公共资金边际成本为1、仅考虑消费者替代行为）与最优税收理论和环境税制度设计存在根本性错配，可能导致政策评估的系统性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优税收的充分统计量框架、庇古税理论、社会福利函数、分配权重理论、消费者与厂商行为理论
AI.method: 理论推导结合校准模拟：基于欧洲收入分布数据进行参数化校准，量化标准WTP准则与最优环境税之间的系统性偏差（"庇古偏差"）。
AI.findings: 标准WTP基准与最优环境税之间的"庇古偏差"在14.6%-36%之间；其中14.6%的基线成分仅由公共资金边际成本驱动，独立于不平等厌恶假设；其余成分的方向和大小取决于收入分布和不平等厌恶程度，在欧洲各经济体中存在系统性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了标准DCE的WTP准则与最优环境税理论之间的理论断层；将充分统计量框架引入环境偏好评估领域；理论化并量化了"庇古偏差"的概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了DCE-Saez这一新的陈述偏好工具设计，能够恢复福利一致评估所需的分配、行为和厂商响应参数；为环境政策评估提供了可操作的方法论改进方案。

title: A farm-level framework for integrating ecosystem service supply, scarcity, and feasibility: The case of crop pollination
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, International Center for Tropical Agriculture (CIAT) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A farm-level framework for integrating ecosystem service supply, scarcity, and feasibility: The case of crop pollination
detail.abstract: Biodiversity decline in agricultural landscapes is well documented, yet existing decision-support approaches often fail to connect ecologically plausible ecosystem service (ES) diagnostics with farm-level constraints and implementable management decisions. This article introduces a codebook-based, farm-level framework that integrates ES supply, multidimensional scarcity, and implementation feasibility into a transparent decision-support logic. The framework addresses three persistent limitations in current ES approaches: (i) the disconnect between spatial or biophysical assessments of ES supply and farm-level decision-making, (ii) the reduction of relevance to monetary valuation, which obscures dependence and risk, and (iii) the insufficient integration of feasibility constraints such as labor, costs, and coordination. In response, the framework combines qualitative, rule-based scorecards for assessing ES supply potential, a multidimensional scarcity concept capturing ecological, functional, spatial, and institutional constraints, and a structured cost module reflecting farm-operational feasibility. All components are governed by a transparent codebook to ensure traceability and auditability under realistic data conditions. The framework is operationalized for crop pollination and applied to four illustrative farms to demonstrate feasibility under information constraints. Results show that supply, scarcity, and feasibility do not necessarily align, and that implementation barriers can be more decisive than ecological scarcity. By explicitly linking ecological diagnostics with farm-level decision logic, the framework provides a transferable approach for structuring biodiversity-related decision-making in agricultural systems beyond pollination. The article presents a conceptual framework and proof-of-concept application rather than a statistically validated decision-support tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于编码手册的农场层面决策框架，整合生态系统服务供给、多维稀缺性和实施可行性，以解决农业景观中生物多样性决策支持不足的问题，并在作物传粉服务中进行了概念验证。
AI.research_question: 如何在农场层面将生态系统服务供给诊断与可落地的管理决策有效连接，克服现有方法在空间评估、货币化局限和可行性约束整合三方面的不足？
AI.motivation: 农业景观中生物多样性下降问题严峻，但现有决策支持方法未能将生态服务诊断与农场层面的管理决策有效衔接，且存在三大局限：空间评估与农场决策脱节、过度依赖货币化估值、忽视实施可行性约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务供给理论、多维稀缺性概念（生态、功能、空间、制度）、实施可行性理论（劳动力、成本、协调约束）
AI.method: 基于编码手册的定性规则计分卡评估ES供给潜力，构建多维稀缺性概念框架，设计结构化成本模块反映农场运营可行性，并以作物传粉服务为例对四个示范农场进行概念验证应用。
AI.findings: 供给、稀缺性和可行性三者并不必然一致；实施障碍可能比生态稀缺性更具决定性；该框架能在信息受限条件下实现可追溯、可审计的决策支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"多维稀缺性"概念框架，超越单一货币化估值逻辑；将实施可行性纳入生态决策分析，弥补理论与实践的鸿沟；构建了可审计的编码手册方法，提升决策透明度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农场管理者提供了一套可操作、可追溯的决策支持框架；将生态诊断与农场运营约束（劳动力、成本、协调）直接挂钩，提升了决策的现实可行性；框架具有可迁移性，可推广至传粉服务以外的农业生物多样性决策场景。

title: The Ecological Cost of Climate Governance: Evidence That Solar Land Use Harms Bird Biodiversity
affiliations: Peking University, Peking University School of Economics, University of Rhode Island - Department of Environmental and Natural Resource Economics and Peking University School of Economics

detail.title: The Ecological Cost of Climate Governance: Evidence That Solar Land Use Harms Bird Biodiversity
detail.abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) energy is widely promoted as a cornerstone of climate change mitigation, yet its land-intensive deployment may impose unintended ecological costs. This study provides a comprehensive empirical assessment of PV land use impacts on bird biodiversity in China leveraging high-resolution county-month panel data. Using a two-way fixed effects model combined with an instrumental variable strategy, we find that a 1% increase in PV panel area leads to a 0.55% decline in bird abundance and a 0.365% decline in species richness. Evidence on mechanisms suggests that these effects operate primarily through the loss of surface vegetation, which reduces habitat availability. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the negative impacts are most pronounced on forestlands, followed by croplands and grasslands. Low-density centralized plants impose greater harm than high-density distributed plants, and construction during autumn overlapping with migratory periods—exerts a more severe impact. Key Ecological Function Zones, which primarily target ecological conservation, showed little additional advantage in terms of ecological gains for birds when developing PV projects. Our findings highlight an underap- preciated trade-off between renewable energy expansion and biodiversity conservation, and underscore the importance of incorporating ecological externalities into energy planning.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国高分辨率县级月度面板数据，评估了光伏（PV）土地利用对鸟类生物多样性的影响。研究发现，光伏面板面积每增加1%，鸟类丰度下降0.55%，物种丰富度下降0.365%。主要机制是通过地表植被丧失减少栖息地。负面影响在林地最严重，低密度集中式电站比高密度分布式电站危害更大，秋季施工与候鸟迁徙期重叠影响尤为剧烈。研究揭示了可再生能源扩张与生物多样性保护之间被低估的权衡关系。
AI.research_question: 光伏能源的土地利用对中国鸟类生物多样性有何影响？其作用机制和异质性表现是什么？
AI.motivation: 光伏能源被视为减排的关键手段，但其土地密集型部署可能带来未预料的生态成本，而目前缺乏全面的实证评估，尤其是在高分辨率面板数据层面的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地利用变化与生物多样性损失理论；可再生能源部署的外部性理论；栖息地丧失对鸟类种群影响的生态学理论。
AI.method: 采用双向固定效应模型结合工具变量策略，基于中国高分辨率县级月度面板数据进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）光伏面板面积每增加1%，鸟类丰度下降0.55%，物种丰富度下降0.365%；（2）主要机制是通过地表植被丧失减少栖息地；（3）负向影响在林地最突出，其次是农田和草地；（4）低密度集中式电站比高密度分布式电站危害更大；（5）秋季施工与候鸟迁徙期重叠影响更严重；（6）生态功能保护区在光伏开发上未显示出额外的鸟类保护优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地量化了光伏土地利用对鸟类多样性的负面影响，揭示了可再生能源扩张与生物多样性保护之间的权衡关系，补充了能源转型生态外部性的理论与实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源规划提供生态外部性纳入考量的实证依据；建议优先发展高密度分布式光伏、避免在林地部署、避开迁徙季节施工；提示生态功能区在光伏开发中的实际保护效果有限，需优化政策设计。

title: Solving the Small-N Problem in Zonal Travel Cost Models:,A Panel Approach with Application to Kruger National Park
affiliations: Florida Gulf Coast University and University of Washington - Department of Economics

detail.title: Solving the Small-N Problem in Zonal Travel Cost Models:,A Panel Approach with Application to Kruger National Park
detail.abstract: Zonal travel cost models with limited origin data face restricted degrees of freedom, hampering reliable parameter estimation, which is common in protected area valuation, where visitors mainly come from wealthy countries. We propose a panel approach that uses variations in assumed travel costs over time to convert cross-sectional data into panel observations, increasing the sample size while maintaining the cluster structure for accurate inference. Varying the time cost from 15% to 50% of the wage rate creates panel variation that enables estimation where traditional methods cannot. When applied to the Kruger National Park with 13 zones and 424 visitors, this yields 468 observations (13 zones × 36 cost variations). The results show expected negative price coefficients and elasticities, with consistently negative travel cost coefficients across different ranges, functional forms, and jackknife samples, confirming robustness despite limited clusters (p=0.186). Bootstrap methods were used to validate the standard errors. Panel elasticity (-0.076) indicates highly inelastic demand, suggesting that fee increases will not significantly reduce visitation or revenue. Individual analysis shows median willingness to pay $839/day vs. the current $25 fee, implying underpricing by 8–16 times. This method—resolving small-N issues via panel structure—applies broadly to protected areas with limited origin diversity, which is common in conservation funding for developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面板化方法，通过变动时间成本假设将截面数据转换为面板数据，解决保护区估值中因客源地有限导致的样本量不足问题，并以克鲁格国家公园为例验证了方法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在客源地有限（小N问题）的旅行成本模型中获得可靠的参数估计？
AI.motivation: 传统分区旅行成本模型因客源地有限导致自由度不足，参数估计不可靠，这一问题在保护区估值中尤为突出（游客多来自少数富裕国家）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅行成本法（Travel Cost Method）、面板数据方法、时间成本机会成本理论
AI.method: 将时间成本从工资率的15%到50%进行变动，把横截面数据转化为面板观测（13个区×36种成本变动=468个观测值），采用聚类标准误和Bootstrap方法进行推断。
AI.findings: 旅行成本系数显著为负，需求高度缺乏弹性（面板弹性-0.076）；游客中位支付意愿为$839/天，而当前门票仅$25，定价偏低8-16倍；系数在不同范围、函数形式和Jackknife样本中稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通过时间成本假设变动将小样本截面数据转化为面板数据的方法论创新，解决了传统TCM中因客源地有限导致的自由度不足问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家保护区的定价策略提供依据：需求高度缺乏弹性，提高门票价格不会显著减少游客量和收入，当前定价严重偏低。

title:
Sentier De La Maison 

Rooted Expansion: A Circular Societal Framework for Values-Coherent Global City Growth; Introducing the Circular Belonging Framework (CBF); Standardised, Localised, and Commercially Grounded 

Belonging as a Scalable Business Model - A Societal Framework with Measurable SROI for High-Growth Cities
affiliations: QANNIK Projects

detail.title:
Sentier De La Maison 

Rooted Expansion: A Circular Societal Framework for Values-Coherent Global City Growth; Introducing the Circular Belonging Framework (CBF); Standardised, Localised, and Commercially Grounded 

Belonging as a Scalable Business Model - A Societal Framework with Measurable SROI for High-Growth Cities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: self

detail.abstract:
Rapid global city expansion consistently produces a documented tension between economic ambition and social coherence. Existing frameworks address this challenge in isolation:  urban design improves walkability, civic programmes deliver culture, policy instruments target talent retention, but none integrate these elements into a single self-reinforcing, commercially viable system. The post-pandemic recalibration of values, accelerating geopolitical reordering, and the fiscal constraints of rapid urbanisation together constitute what scholars and practitioners are increasingly terming perma-crisis — and, simultaneously, the conditions under which new societal architectures can take root.

This paper introduces the Circular Belonging Framework (CBF): a standardised, universally applicable model for values-coherent global city growth, structured across four verticals, namely The Productive Estate, The Cultural Residence, The Civic House, and The Commons. Three verticals are designed to be independently commercially viable; the Civic House operates on a Social Return on Investment logic; its value measured through the long-term societal compounding that supports GDP growth from the social foundation upward.  The CBF is the urban-scale extension of the author’s prior RHSROI Framework (Regenerative Hospitality Social Return on Investment (Schaeflein, 2022)) and draws on permaculture’s design ethics of earth care, people care, and fair share (Holmgren, 2002), circular economy thinking (Raworth, 2017; Stahel, 2016), and Social Return on Investment methodology (Nicholls et al., 2012).

The framework is designed for standardised adoption by any high-growth city and for localisation to specific cultural, regulatory, and economic contexts. The UAE, and Dubai specifically, is presented as the first proposed pilot, chosen for its extraordinary combination of growth ambition, innovative appetite, policy boldness, hospitality heritage, and the acute belonging deficit of an 88.5% non-national population projected to double under D33. The paper presents the standardisation-localisation protocol that enables any city to adopt the framework while retaining its universal circular logic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"循环归属框架"（CBF），一个标准化、普适的全球城市增长模型，整合经济雄心与社会凝聚力。该框架包含四个垂直领域（生产性庄园、文化居所、公民大厦、公共资源），其中三个可独立商业运营，第四个基于社会投资回报逻辑运作。它以永续农业伦理、循环经济思想和社会投资回报方法为基础，可在任何高增长城市标准化采用并本地化适配。阿联酋迪拜被提议为首个试点城市。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够整合城市经济扩张与社会凝聚力、标准化且可本地化的综合框架，以应对全球城市在"永久危机"背景下的发展挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有框架将城市设计、文化项目、政策工具割裂处理，未能将其整合为单一自强化、商业可行的系统。后疫情时代价值观重构、地缘政治重组与快速城市化的财政约束共同催生了"永久危机"，同时也为新的社会架构提供了生根条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环归属框架（CBF）基于三个理论支柱：1）永续农业的设计伦理（关爱地球、关爱人类、公平分享）；2）循环经济思想；3）社会投资回报（SROI）方法论。CBF是作者前期RHSROI框架的城市尺度延伸。
AI.method: 本文提出标准化-本地化协议，使任何城市在保留普适循环逻辑的前提下采用该框架。框架包含四个垂直领域，其中三个独立商业可行，第四个（公民大厦）采用社会投资回报逻辑，其价值通过长期社会复利衡量。以阿联酋迪拜为首个拟议试点进行说明。
AI.findings: CBF是一个由四个垂直领域构成的结构化模型：生产性庄园、文化居所、公民大厦和公共资源。三个垂直领域设计为独立商业可行；公民大厦基于社会投资回报逻辑，其价值通过支撑GDP增长的社会基础向上积累的长期社会复利来衡量。该框架可在任何高增长城市标准化采用并针对具体文化、监管和经济环境本地化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将永续农业伦理、循环经济思想与社会投资回报方法整合为统一的城市发展框架；将RHSROI框架从酒店业扩展到城市尺度；提出标准化与本地化并行的普适模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球高增长城市提供可标准化采用并本地化适配的综合发展框架；以迪拜为试点案例（88.5%非本国人口、D33计划下人口翻倍、归属感赤字突出），展示框架的实践可行性；为城市管理者、规划者和政策制定者提供协调经济雄心与社会凝聚力的可操作工具。

title: Privacy-Preserving Hybrid Large Language Model Frameworks for Healthcare and Financial Systems
affiliations: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology

detail.title: Privacy-Preserving Hybrid Large Language Model Frameworks for Healthcare and Financial Systems
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for high-impact decision-support workflows in healthcare and financial systems. However, direct cloud-based LLM deployment can expose sensitive clinical, biometric, transactional, and customer-risk data to privacy, latency, auditability, and regulatory challenges. This paper proposes a privacy-preserving hybrid edge-cloud LLM framework for secure inference, domain-aware orchestration, federated adaptation, and explainable governance across regulated healthcare and financial environments. The framework combines edge-side data minimization, local sensitive-entity filtering, lightweight small language model triage, secure cloud inference escalation, federated learning, policy-aware routing, and explainability logging. scoring, and customer-support triage. The The paper contributes a concise architecture and evaluation model for organizations seeking scalable, privacy-preserving, and regulation-aware LLM deployment in safety-critical sectors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种隐私保护的混合边缘-云端LLM框架，用于医疗和金融领域的安全推理、领域感知编排、联邦自适应和可解释治理。
AI.research_question: 如何在保证隐私、低延迟、可审计性和符合监管要求的前提下，在医疗和金融等高影响力决策场景中安全部署大语言模型？
AI.motivation: 直接基于云端的LLM部署会暴露临床、生物识别、交易和客户风险数据，面临隐私、延迟、可审计性和监管合规方面的严峻挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合边缘计算、联邦学习、数据最小化、小语言模型预筛、策略感知路由和可解释性日志记录的多层混合架构。
AI.method: 提出边缘端数据最小化、本地敏感实体过滤、轻量级小语言模型分诊、安全云端推理升级、联邦学习、策略感知路由与可解释性日志记录相结合的系统性框架。
AI.findings: 提供了一套适用于医疗和金融等安全关键领域的、兼具可扩展性、隐私保护性和监管合规性的LLM部署架构与评估模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了混合边缘-云LLM部署的理论架构，为隐私保护与高性能推理的权衡提供了设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了在实际监管环境（如医疗和金融）中安全、合规地部署LLM的可操作架构和评估模型。

title: Self-updating Retrieval Mechanisms for Scalable and Personalized RAG Systems in Dynamic Environments
affiliations: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology

detail.title: Self-updating Retrieval Mechanisms for Scalable and Personalized RAG Systems in Dynamic Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: done
declarations.ethicsApproval: done
declarations.funderStatement: done

detail.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a practical mechanism for improving the factuality, traceability, and domain relevance of large language model (LLM) systems. However, many deployed RAG pipelines remain static: documents are embedded periodically, user context is handled through shallow prompt engineering, and compliance controls are applied after retrieval rather than during inference. These assumptions are increasingly inadequate for healthcare, finance, insurance, and regulated enterprise environments where documents, policies, user permissions, and operational risk profiles change continuously. This paper proposes SURA-RAG , a self-updating retrieval architecture for scalable and personalized RAG systems in dynamic environments. The framework combines event-driven indexing, freshness-aware ranking, edge-cloud LLM orchestration, federated personalization signals, policy-gated retrieval, and explainable evidence logging. A lightweight simulation is presented to compare static RAG, periodic index rebuilding, cloud-only personalization, and the proposed self-updating architecture. Results indicate that SURA-RAG can improve retrieval freshness, reduce stale-answer risk, and strengthen compliance traceability while maintaining acceptable latency. The paper contributes a concise technical framework for privacy-preserving, scalable, and auditable RAG deployment in high-impact sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SURA-RAG，一种面向动态环境的自更新检索增强生成架构，通过事件驱动索引、新鲜度感知排序、边缘-云端编排、联邦个性化、策略门控检索和可解释证据日志等机制，在医疗、金融等受监管领域中显著提升检索新鲜度、减少过时答案风险并增强合规可追溯性。
AI.research_question: 如何在动态变化的企业环境中（如医疗、金融、保险等受监管领域），设计一种能够实时自更新、可扩展且保护隐私的RAG系统架构，以解决静态RAG存在的文档过时、合规控制滞后、个性化不足等问题？
AI.motivation: 当前已部署的RAG管线多为静态：文档周期性嵌入、用户上下文依赖浅层提示工程、合规控制在检索后而非推理中执行。这种假设在医疗、金融等文档、政策、权限和风险画像持续变化的环境中日益不适用，亟需一种能够自主适应动态变化的RAG架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件驱动架构、新鲜度感知排序算法、边缘-云端协同推理、联邦学习个性化、策略门控检索机制、可解释AI与审计日志。
AI.method: 提出SURA-RAG框架，集成六大核心模块（事件驱动索引、新鲜度排序、边缘-云端LLM编排、联邦个性化信号、策略门控检索、可解释证据日志），并通过轻量级仿真实验对比静态RAG、周期性索引重建、纯云端个性化与SURA-RAG四种方案。
AI.findings: SURA-RAG能够提升检索新鲜度、降低过时答案风险、增强合规可追溯性，同时保持可接受的延迟水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将事件驱动机制与新鲜度感知排序引入RAG架构，并整合联邦个性化与策略门控检索，为动态环境下隐私保护、可审计的RAG部署提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗、金融、保险等高影响受监管行业提供了一种可落地的、兼顾实时性、个性化、合规性与可扩展性的RAG部署方案。

title: From Erasure to Obfuscation: A Paradigm Shift in Privacy in the Age of Generative AI

detail.title: From Erasure to Obfuscation: A Paradigm Shift in Privacy in the Age of Generative AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests in relation to this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual paper that does not involve human subjects, animal subjects, or the processing of personal data of identifiable individuals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Privacy governance after the internet has been organised around erasure—Article 17 of the GDPR, Article 47 of China's PIPL, and parallel provisions elsewhere. Generative AI disturbs the premise on which that paradigm rests. As large language models increasingly mediate how individuals are publicly known, the operative threat shifts from data being recorded to data being automatically integrated into stable profiles. I argue that erasure, while still important, no longer exhausts the field of privacy protection: a second strategy is needed, one that weakens profile stability through the deliberate production of internal inconsistency in self-representation. I call this strategy narrative autonomy and distinguish it from five adjacent concepts—Goffmanian self-presentation, context collapse, online obscurity, contextual integrity, and obfuscation in the Brunton–Nissenbaum sense. What it adds is a target: not data collection or audience management, but the integration step itself. The essay closes with a speculative observation that model collapse may unintentionally support this kind of privacy interest. The contribution is conceptual.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，在以“删除”为核心的现有隐私治理范式之外，需要一种新策略——叙事自主权，即通过刻意制造自我表征的内部不一致性来削弱大语言模型对个人身份的稳定整合，从而保护隐私。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI（特别是大语言模型）时代，传统的以“删除/擦除”为核心的隐私治理范式是否仍然充分？还需要什么样的补充策略？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型改变了隐私威胁的性质：威胁不再仅仅是数据被记录，而是数据被自动整合为稳定的个人画像。因此，仅仅依赖删除权已不足以保护隐私，需要新的概念工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事自主权（Narrative Autonomy），区别于戈夫曼的自我呈现、语境崩溃、网络匿名性、语境完整性、以及Brunton-Nissenbaum意义上的混淆策略。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证，辅以对模型坍塌（model collapse）的推测性观察作为支持性论据。
AI.findings: 删除策略仍然重要但不够；叙事自主权——通过制造自我表征的内部不一致来削弱AI对个人身份的稳定整合——是必要的补充策略；模型坍塌可能无意中支持这种隐私利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“叙事自主权”（Narrative Autonomy）这一新概念，并将其与五个相邻概念进行了清晰区分；指出了隐私保护的新目标——不是数据收集或受众管理，而是AI对个人信息的自动整合环节。
AI.practical_contributions: 为隐私治理政策制定者和技术设计者提供了新的思路：除了强化删除权外，还应鼓励或保护个体刻意呈现不一致自我表征的行为，以抵抗AI的稳定画像整合。

title: Leveling the Playing Field: Resolving Infrastructure Inequality in Youth Soccer
affiliations: Policy Brief Writing And Publishing

detail.title: Leveling the Playing Field: Resolving Infrastructure Inequality in Youth Soccer
detail.abstract:
The access to good quality sports facilities in America is extremely uneven, especially within poor neighborhoods. The inequalities become very clear within youth soccer, where the quality of the playing fields depends on the local availability of facilities for practice and maintenance. Despite being often referred to as the sport of the people due to its accessibility, soccer in the US continues to be affected by funding and geography. Poor conditions of fields-which can include uneven playing surface, lack of grass, broken goals, and poor maintenance of the field-not only increase the risk of injuries but also hinder the players' development. 
According to me, this is an illustration of the bigger picture, which pertains to the unequal allocation of resources by the government for recreational facilities. For this reason, I propose a legislative approach that involves the increase of accessibility, public-private partnership programs, maintenance framework, and funding from the government. Direct investments can be made by the city in poor neighborhoods so that athletes can get equal opportunities regardless of their social status. In this essay, I have attempted to show that developing soccer facilities goes beyond sports.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国贫困社区体育设施（特别是足球场地）质量不均衡的问题，并提出通过立法、公私合作、政府投资等方式改善设施条件，促进体育公平。
AI.research_question: 如何通过政策与资源分配解决美国贫困社区足球场地设施质量不均衡的问题？
AI.motivation: 美国贫困社区体育设施质量极不均衡，足球场地的劣质条件不仅增加受伤风险，也阻碍球员发展，这一问题反映了政府在 recreational 设施资源分配上的不公平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源分配不平等理论、体育公平与社会正义、公共产品与政府职能理论。
AI.method: 基于观察与定性分析的立法提案式论述，提出政策建议。
AI.findings: 美国贫困社区足球场地条件恶劣（地面不平、缺草、球门破损、维护差），加剧了运动伤害和发展障碍；这本质上是政府资源分配不均的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将体育设施不平等问题上升到政府资源分配不公的理论层面，强调体育发展不仅是运动问题，更是社会公平问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的立法与政策路径：增加可达性、公私合作、建立维护框架、政府直接投资贫困社区，以实现运动员无论社会地位都能获得平等机会。

title:
Governing What AI must Never Replace:
A Framework for Human Value Protection in Enterprise AI Deployment

detail.title:
Governing What AI must Never Replace:
A Framework for Human Value Protection in Enterprise AI Deployment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Human Value Governance and holds a pending trademark registration for the term Human Value Governance with the United States Patent and Trademark Office. No financial relationships with other organizations influenced this research. This paper was developed independently without institutional funding.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
The deployment of artificial intelligence in enterprise environments has generated substantial governance literature addressing model reliability, algorithmic bias, regulatory compliance, and risk management. Existing frameworks — including the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the Cloud Data Management Capability framework — provide increasingly sophisticated instruments for governing AI systems. This paper identifies a structural gap that each of these frameworks approaches but does not fully resolve: the absence of an explicit governance discipline for protecting the human qualities that organizations depend on when AI systems are placed in supervisory, evaluative, or decision-making roles above people.

This paper introduces Human Value Governance as a governance framework designed to address this gap. The framework defines six protected human assets — empathy, moral judgment, trust, experiential wisdom, emotional presence, and critical thinking — and proposes seven governance covenants that translate these assets into auditable organizational commitments with defined scope, normative requirements, and conformance evidence standards. The framework is explicitly positioned as additive to existing governance regimes, occupying the implementation layer at which human oversight obligations require substantive content rather than procedural form alone.

The paper argues that current governance frameworks govern AI systems effectively while leaving unresolved the question of what human qualities those systems must be prohibited from displacing. The institutional, labor market, leadership pipeline, and institutional trust consequences of this governance gap are examined, and an institutional path through which Human Value Governance could achieve formal standards recognition alongside existing frameworks is proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有AI治理框架（如EU AI Act、NIST AI风险管理框架等）虽然日趋成熟，但存在一个结构性缺口——缺乏专门保护当AI处于监督、评估或决策角色时人类所依赖的宝贵品质的治理规范。为此，作者提出"人类价值治理"（Human Value Governance）框架，定义了六项受保护的人类资产（同理心、道德判断、信任、经验智慧、情感在场、批判性思维），并设计了七项治理盟约将其转化为可审计的组织承诺。
AI.research_question: 现有AI治理框架在保护人类核心品质方面存在何种结构性缺口？如何构建一个专门针对"AI凌驾于人类之上"场景下保护人类价值的治理框架？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有诸多AI治理框架（EU AI Act、NIST AI风险管理框架、ISO/IEC 42001等），它们在管理AI系统的可靠性、算法偏见、合规性和风险方面日益精进，但都未能充分解决一个根本问题：当AI被置于监督、评估或决策人类的位置时，哪些人类品质是AI不应也不能取代的？这一缺失可能导致制度、劳动力市场、领导力管道和制度信任层面的严重后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类价值治理（Human Value Governance）框架。该框架包含：六项受保护的人类资产（同理心、道德判断、信任、经验智慧、情感在场、批判性思维）和七项治理盟约（将这些资产转化为可审计的组织承诺，包含范围、规范要求和符合性证据标准）。该框架定位为对现有治理体系的补充，占据实施层面，使人类监督义务具有实质性内容而非仅程序性形式。
AI.method: 理论构建与框架设计。作者通过对现有治理框架（EU AI Act、NIST AI风险管理框架、ISO/IEC 42001、云数据管理能力框架）的系统性分析，识别其共同的结构性缺口，进而提出新的治理框架，并论证其制度化的可行路径。
AI.findings: 现有治理框架有效治理了AI系统本身，但未解决"AI系统必须被禁止取代哪些人类品质"这一关键问题。人类价值治理框架可以填补这一缺口，通过六项受保护的人类资产和七项治理盟约，将保护人类价值的义务从程序性要求转化为具有实质内容的可审计组织承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次明确提出"人类价值治理"概念，并将其系统化为一个可操作的治理框架；识别出现有AI治理文献和实践中被忽视的结构性缺口——即关注AI系统本身的治理而忽视了被AI影响的人类品质的保护；将人类价值保护从伦理讨论层面推进到治理机制和标准层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和组织提供了在部署AI（特别是将AI置于监督、评估或决策人类角色的场景下）时保护人类核心品质的具体操作指南；六项受保护人类资产和七项治理盟约可直接转化为组织的审计标准和合规要求；提出了该框架获得正式标准认可的可行制度路径，有望成为现有AI治理体系的补充标准。

title: Latent Profiles of Psychological Distress in Emergency Professionals: Associations with Emotion Regulation, Posttraumatic Stress, Social Support, and Performance in a Virtual Reality Task
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Latent Profiles of Psychological Distress in Emergency Professionals: Associations with Emotion Regulation, Posttraumatic Stress, Social Support, and Performance in a Virtual Reality Task
detail.abstract: Professionals working in high-risk occupations, such as firefighters and emergency medical personnel, are repeatedly exposed to potentially traumatic events that may affect both psychological functioning and decision-making under pressure. However, psychological responses to occupational stress are heterogeneous, and their implications for performance remain insufficiently understood. The present study adopted a person-centered approach to examine latent profiles of psychopathological symptoms and their associations with emotional, social, and behavioral functioning in a virtual reality (VR) emergency simulation. A sample of 395 Portuguese firefighters completed the Brief Symptom Inventory (BSI), measures of emotion regulation difficulties, posttraumatic stress symptoms, and perceived social support, and performed a VR-based medical emergency task assessing decision-making accuracy under stress. Latent profile analysis identified four distinct symptom profiles: Low Psychological Distress, Moderate Internalizing Distress, High Global Psychological Distress, and Mixed / Interpersonal Distress. Profiles differed significantly in emotion regulation difficulties, posttraumatic stress symptoms, perceived social support, and VR task performance. Notably, individuals characterized by a Mixed / Interpersonal Distress profile, marked by elevated interpersonal sensitivity, hostility, and paranoid ideation, committed significantly more decision-making errors in the VR simulation than those in the Low Psychological Distress profile. In contrast, high global psychological distress was not uniformly associated with poorer performance. These findings suggest that decision-making under stress in emergency contexts is shaped less by generalized psychopathology and more by specific interpersonal and affective symptom configurations. The study underscores the value of person-centered approaches and immersive VR methodologies for identifying psychologically meaningful risk patterns, with important implications for assessment, training, and targeted intervention in emergency service professions.

AI.tldr: 本研究以395名葡萄牙消防员为样本，采用以人为中心的方法，通过潜在剖面分析识别出四种心理症状剖面（低心理困扰、中等内化困扰、高整体心理困扰、混合/人际困扰），并发现混合/人际困扰剖面（高人际敏感性、敌意、偏执观念）的消防员在虚拟现实紧急任务中决策错误显著更多，而高整体心理困扰并不一致导致更差表现，表明决策受损更多取决于特定人际和情感症状配置而非泛化的心理病理。
AI.research_question: 高风险职业人员（如消防员）的心理症状异质性如何影响其在压力下的决策表现？具体而言，不同心理病理症状剖面与情绪调节困难、创伤后应激症状、社会支持感知及虚拟现实紧急任务中的决策准确性之间存在怎样的关联？
AI.motivation: 高风险职业人员反复暴露于潜在创伤事件，其心理反应存在异质性，但对压力下决策表现的影响尚不充分了解。现有研究多采用变量中心方法，忽略了症状模式的异质性及其与绩效的不同关联，因此有必要采用以人为中心的方法来识别有意义的风险模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在剖面分析（LPA）、心理病理症状异质性理论、情绪调节理论、决策压力理论。
AI.method: 以395名葡萄牙消防员为样本，采用以人为中心的潜在剖面分析（LPA），使用简要症状量表（BSI）、情绪调节困难量表、创伤后应激症状量表、社会支持感知量表进行测量，并在虚拟现实（VR）医疗急救任务中评估压力下的决策准确性。
AI.findings: 识别出四种症状剖面：低心理困扰、中等内化困扰、高整体心理困扰、混合/人际困扰。剖面间在情绪调节困难、创伤后应激症状、社会支持感知和VR任务表现上存在显著差异。混合/人际困扰剖面（高人际敏感性、敌意、偏执观念）的决策错误显著多于低心理困扰剖面。高整体心理困扰并不一致导致更差表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了决策受损更多取决于特定人际和情感症状配置而非泛化的心理病理，丰富了对心理症状异质性与压力下决策关系的理论理解，支持以人为中心方法在心理病理研究中的价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应急服务人员的心理评估、训练和针对性干预提供了实证依据，强调识别混合/人际困扰等高风险症状配置的重要性，VR沉浸式方法论可用于识别心理风险模式以提升培训效果。

title: Compression is All you Need
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Compression is All you Need
detail.abstract:
Compression algorithms and functions have been extensively utilized in various applications, e.g., in digital storage and communication. In recent years and thanks to the rise of large language models (LLMs), researchers have studied and utilized compression techniques for addressing key problems in LLMs and generative AI models, e.g., for optimizing KV-cache memory in LLMs. Due to extensive applications of compression algorithms in different domains, a whole new era of innovations and applications for data compression algorithms can be envisioned. After all, compression and intelligence are two closely related notions.

In this article, we highlight some of the interesting applications of compression algorithms in large language models. We discuss that compression functions with interesting properties, e.g., fully homomorphism, can have applications beyond compressing data, e.g., for performing computation on compressed data. To motivate future research, we ask whether large language models (LLMs) can help us discover yet novel compression functions with interesting properties. Particularly, studying compression functions with the fully homomorphic property is appealing because of various reasons. While it is mathematically interesting to study such functions, fully homomorphic compression functions can be useful for compute intensive applications such as LLM \& AI inference, image and video processing, FHE, and ZKP applications.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了压缩算法在大语言模型（LLMs）中的有趣应用，特别关注具有全同态性质的压缩函数，并提出了一个前瞻性问题：LLMs能否帮助我们发现具有新颖特性的压缩函数。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型能否帮助我们发现具有新颖特性（特别是全同态性质）的压缩函数？
AI.motivation: 压缩算法已在数字存储和通信等领域广泛应用，近年来又因LLMs的兴起而用于优化KV缓存等关键问题。压缩与智能密切相关，探索LLMs与压缩算法的交叉融合具有重要价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 压缩理论与全同态加密（FHE）理论；压缩函数与智能（LLMs）之间的双向关系。
AI.method: 本文为观点/展望性文章，通过梳理现有应用来提出未来研究方向，并未呈现具体的实验方法。
AI.findings: 压缩算法在LLMs中有重要应用（如KV缓存优化）；具有全同态性质的压缩函数不仅数学上有趣，还可用于LLM/AI推理、图像视频处理、FHE和零知识证明等计算密集型应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将全同态性质引入压缩函数研究，拓展了压缩理论的研究边界；提出了LLMs与压缩函数发现之间的双向促进关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM推理加速、存储优化、隐私计算（FHE、ZKP）等领域提供了新的潜在技术路径。

title: Robust Identification of Business Cycle Turning Points
affiliations: University of Oregon - Department of Economics

detail.title: Robust Identification of Business Cycle Turning Points
detail.abstract: The global pandemic created extreme swings in macroeconomic data that complicate statistical analysis. This included an uncharacteristically short recession that was unprecedented in the monthly growth rates observed during the recession. This paper first shows that the performance of standard Markov-switching models for classifying business cycle phases and their turning points drastically deteriorates when the pandemic recession is included in the data sample. Further, simulations reveal that this deterioration would have likely happened even if the pandemic recession had been far less severe. An alternative, robust, approach to Markov-switching models for classifying business cycle phases is proposed based on Markov-switching quantile models. Specifically, I investigate the performance of dynamic factor Markov switching (DFMS) models that are specified in terms of switching quantiles rather than switching means. I show that these quantile DFMS models are capable of classifying recessions, both retrospectively and in real time, even when the estimation sample contains outlier recessions.

AI.tldr: 本文指出标准马尔可夫转换模型在包含疫情衰退的数据中表现急剧恶化，并提出基于分位数的马尔可夫转换模型（DFMS）作为稳健替代方案，能够有效处理包含异常值衰退的样本。
AI.research_question: 标准马尔可夫转换模型在包含疫情导致的极端衰退数据时，其经济周期阶段分类和转折点识别性能如何？是否存在更稳健的替代方法？
AI.motivation: 疫情导致宏观经济数据出现极端波动，使得标准经济周期分类模型的性能大幅下降，亟需一种对异常值更稳健的模型来准确识别经济周期阶段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫转换模型；马尔可夫转换分位数模型；动态因子马尔可夫转换（DFMS）模型
AI.method: 首先实证检验标准马尔可夫转换模型在包含疫情衰退样本时的性能恶化；通过模拟验证即使在疫情衰退不那么严重时恶化仍会发生；提出基于分位数的DFMS模型作为替代方案，并评估其回顾性和实时分类能力。
AI.findings: 标准马尔可夫转换模型在包含疫情衰退的数据中分类性能急剧恶化，且模拟表明即使疫情衰退程度较轻时也会发生类似恶化；而基于分位数的DFMS模型能够在包含异常值衰退的样本中准确分类衰退期，无论是在回顾性分析还是实时预测中均表现良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种对极端观测值更稳健的马尔可夫转换模型方法（分位数DFMS），拓展了经济周期分类的理论工具，解决了标准模型在处理异常值衰退时的失效问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济分析师提供了在宏观经济数据存在极端波动时依然可靠的衰退识别工具，有助于更准确地进行经济周期监测和实时决策。

title: Toxicity-aware Reinforcement Learning for Liquidity Provisioning on Uniswap v3: A Systematic Ablation
affiliations: AIvancity School for Technology, Business & Society

detail.title: Toxicity-aware Reinforcement Learning for Liquidity Provisioning on Uniswap v3: A Systematic Ablation
detail.abstract:
We present an empirical study of toxicity-aware deep reinforcement learning for liquidity provisioning on Uniswap v3, with a primary finding that toxicity signals act as tail-risk regulators rather than mean-return enhancers. The swap-size signature configuration (R5_volsize) achieves a 100% episode-level win rate across five rolling windows, is the only configuration with a strictly positive CVaR 10% ($ + 4.00 versus-$11.84 for the toxicity-blind baseline), and outperforms the baseline by +$36.65 in stressed market regimes specifically. Concentrated-liquidity automated market makers (AMMs) such as Uniswap v3 expose liquidity providers (LPs) to adverse selection by informed arbitrageurs, formalised as Loss-Versus-Rebalancing (LVR) by Milionis et al. [2022]. While prior work has applied deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to active LP rebalancing [Xu and Brini, 2025, Zhang et al., 2023], no existing approach explicitly enriches the agent's observation with toxicity signals derived from on-chain microstructure. We design four complementary toxicity scores: an analytical LVR proxy, a price-deviation spread, a volume-weighted realised toxicity, and a swap-size signature, each empirically validated to scale with market regime by factors of 2.79× to 8.46× between calm and stressed hours on the WETH/USDC 0.05% pool. We then conduct a factorial ablation over seven observation configurations, five rolling windows, and three random seeds (105 PPO runs of 80,000 timesteps each), using 24,019 hourly observations spanning May 2021 to January 2024 reconstructed from Dune Analytics ($428B cumulative volume, $214M cumulative fees). All seven PPO configurations beat a passive width-20-tick baseline in mean excess return, but effect sizes on mean return are small relative to outcome variance, so no configuration achieves statistically significant superiority over the toxicity-blind baseline (Welch t-test, all p > 0.20; Fisher exact test, all p > 0.10).This is consistent with structural noise dominance in AMM rewards: the standard deviation of capital outcomes (σ ≈ $23–$57) exceeds cross-configuration mean differences (∆ ≈ $6–$16). The distributional improvements, by contrast, are consistent
across all five windows and across three market regimes. R5_volsize also exhibits a Pearson correlation of r = +0.41 between its toxicity observation and the defensive range-widening action it selects (computed on held-out test episodes), a behavioural pattern consistent with the agent acting as a CVaR-constrained policy [Chow and Ghavamzadeh, 2014] despite being trained on a standard mean-return objective. All code, data and trained models are publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文对Uniswap v3上的流动性提供进行毒性感知深度强化学习实证研究，发现毒性信号主要作为尾部风险调节器而非均值回报增强器。其中基于swap规模特征(R5_volsize)的配置在五个滚动窗口中实现100%的回合级胜率，是唯一具有严格正CVaR 10%的配置，并在压力市场条件下表现优于基线。所有PPO配置在均值超额收益上均优于被动基线，但效应量较小，无统计显著性。研究公开了所有代码、数据和训练模型。
AI.research_question: 将链上微结构毒性信号纳入深度强化学习智能体的观测空间，是否能改善Uniswap v3上主动流动性提供(rebalancing)的表现？毒性信号是作为均值回报增强器还是尾部风险调节器发挥作用？
AI.motivation: Uniswap v3等集中流动性AMM使流动性提供者面临来自知情套利者的逆向选择（形式化为LVR）。已有工作将DRL应用于主动流动性再平衡，但尚无研究明确将链上微结构衍生的毒性信号纳入智能体观测空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: Milionis等人[2022]的Loss-Versus-Rebalancing (LVR)理论框架；Chow和Ghavamzadeh[2014]的CVaR约束策略理论。
AI.method: 设计四种互补毒性评分（分析性LVR代理、价格偏离价差、成交量加权实现毒性、swap规模特征）；使用PPO算法进行105次运行（7种观测配置×5个滚动窗口×3个随机种子），每次80,000时间步；基于Dune Analytics重建的24,019小时观测数据（2021年5月至2024年1月），覆盖$428B累积交易量和$214M累积费用。
AI.findings: (1) 所有7种PPO配置在均值超额收益上均优于被动宽度-20-tick基线，但效应量相对于结果方差较小，无统计显著性（Welch t-test, p>0.20; Fisher exact test, p>0.10）；(2) R5_volsize在五个滚动窗口中实现100%回合级胜率，是唯一具有严格正CVaR 10%（+$4.00）的配置；(3) 在压力市场下优于基线+$36.65；(4) R5_volsize的毒性观测与防御性范围扩宽动作之间的Pearson相关系数为r=+0.41；(5) 毒性信号在平静与压力时段之间的缩放因子为2.79×至8.46×。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了毒性信号作为尾部风险调节器而非均值回报增强器的实证证据；揭示了在标准均值回报目标下训练的智能体可自发形成CVaR约束策略的行为模式；证明了结构噪声主导性（资本结果标准差σ≈$23-$57超过跨配置均值差异∆≈$6-$16）是AMM奖励的基本特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 设计并公开验证了四种链上微结构毒性评分；公开所有代码、数据和训练模型，促进可重复性研究；提供了毒性感知DRL在AMM流动性提供中的完整实证基准，包括105次PPO运行的消融实验结果。

title:
LegacyRAG: A VRAM-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation 
Pipeline for Legacy Multi-GPU Inference via Vulkan
affiliations: New Jersey Institute of Technology

detail.title:
LegacyRAG: A VRAM-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation 
Pipeline for Legacy Multi-GPU Inference via Vulkan
detail.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines are increasingly deployed for privacy-sensitive document intelligence in resource-constrained organizations. Existing RAG systems assume modern GPU hardware with FP16 acceleration, large VRAM, and stable inference throughput. This paper presents LegacyRAG, a VRAM-aware RAG pipeline for end-of-life GPU hardware abandoned by CUDA but still viable through the Vulkan compute API. We deploy LegacyRAG on a dual NVIDIA Quadro K4200 workstation (Maxwell architecture, 4 GB VRAM per card, compute capability 3.0, dropped from CUDA 11.0 [2]) running a 3.82 B parameter quantized language model [5] via the llama.cpp Vulkan backend [3]. A pre-operation VRAM scheduler queries both GPUs via nvidia-smi before every embedding operation and routes workloads to CPU or GPU based on live free-VRAM thresholds, preventing out-of-memory crashes under concurrent load. Empirical evaluation reveals that generation dominates RAG pipeline latency at 99.86%, sustained generation throughput ranges from 0.29 to 1.66 tok/s due to non-deterministic Vulkan behavior on legacy hardware, and naive dual-GPU layer splitting degrades prompt prefill by 50× (from ∼26 to 0.52 tok/s) while leaving decode speed unchanged. The VRAM scheduler logged fifteen decisions with zero OOM events. LegacyRAG is released as open-source software to support reproducible research on constrained-hardware AI inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LegacyRAG，一个面向已停止CUDA支持的陈旧GPU（如NVIDIA Quadro K4200）的VRAM感知RAG管道，通过Vulkan计算API运行量化语言模型，并设计预操作VRAM调度器避免OOM崩溃。
AI.research_question: 在资源受限组织中，如何利用已被CUDA放弃但仍可通过Vulkan API运行的陈旧GPU硬件，构建稳定且可用的RAG管道？
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统假设现代GPU硬件（FP16加速、大VRAM、稳定推理吞吐），但许多资源受限组织仍在使用被CUDA抛弃的陈旧GPU，亟需一种能够适配这类硬件的RAG方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: Vulkan计算API、VRAM感知调度、量化语言模型推理、RAG管道延迟分析
AI.method: 在双NVIDIA Quadro K4200工作站上部署3.82B参数量化语言模型，通过llama.cpp Vulkan后端运行；设计预操作VRAM调度器，在每次嵌入操作前通过nvidia-smi查询GPU空闲VRAM，基于实时阈值将工作负载路由至CPU或GPU。
AI.findings: （1）生成阶段占RAG管道延迟的99.86%；（2）在陈旧硬件上持续生成吞吐量为0.29-1.66 tok/s，存在非确定性Vulkan行为；（3）朴素双GPU层分割使预填充速度下降50倍（约26→0.52 tok/s），解码速度不变；（4）VRAM调度器记录15次决策，零OOM事件。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了陈旧GPU上Vulkan推理的非确定性行为特性，量化了双GPU层分割在不同阶段（预填充vs解码）的非对称性能影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了面向陈旧GPU的开源RAG解决方案LegacyRAG；设计了简单有效的VRAM调度策略，在极端资源受限环境下实现了零OOM的稳定性。

title: Residue in Modern Systems: The Outsourcing of Meaning and Responsibility

detail.title: Residue in Modern Systems: The Outsourcing of Meaning and Responsibility

declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research. The author is solely responsible for all claims, errors, and omissions.

detail.abstract:
Modern systems—from large language models to financial instruments to pharmaceutical interventions—increasingly produce outcomes that exceed what any single actor intended or can fully account for. These outcomes are often framed as emergent, unpredictable, or statistically acceptable. This paper argues that such explanations obscure a deeper structural condition: capabilities accumulate as residue when systems are developed through distributed decision-making, local optimization, and the absence of explicit constraints on what must not exist.

The paper introduces the concept of developmental sovereignty—governance that operates before capability formation rather than after output observation—and proposes a Capability Gate to define disallowed classes of outcome in advance. It further identifies accountability evasion as a structural rather than intentional failure, arising when responsibility is fragmented across roles with no mechanism for aggregation at the level of total system behavior.

A Triple-Tier Model (Capability Authority, Development Accountability, Interpretive Responsibility) is offered to make accountability resolvable across institutional layers. Drawing on cases from AI security (unsolicited exploit generation), financial risk (aggregate liquidity exposure), and pharmaceutical safety (rare population-level effects), the paper demonstrates that the same failure structure recurs across domains.
