AI.tldr: 本文提出“隐藏剖面”（hiding profile）概念，解释高逆境原住民社区中行为健康测量的悖论——社区虽承载高ACE负担，却呈现中度功能水平。该剖面由高正向行为堆叠、中范围破坏性行为堆叠、及人为压缩的情感变异性三特征构成，是过程控制架构下的可预测测量伪影。研究者发展12个可证伪命题，整合Deming过程控制逻辑、Barrett建构情绪理论与环状模型，指出标准量表（PHQ-9、GAD-7等）因测量均值而非变异结构而无法检测该剖面，并推论成功干预会先引发变异度增加这一反直觉信号。
AI.research_question: 为什么在高逆境原住民社区中，标准行为健康测量工具持续显示“高创伤负荷但中度功能水平”这一悖论？这一悖论是由什么测量机制产生的？
AI.motivation: 现有标准心理测量工具在高逆境原住民社区中持续产生令人困惑的结果——社区承载最高逆境暴露（ACE）却只呈现中度功能障碍，导致这些社区被系统性地低估风险、未获得应有的干预资源。这种测量悖论如果得不到解释，将导致资源错配和干预失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: (1) Deming统计过程控制逻辑（SPC）——从过程架构而非均值视角解读测量信号；(2) Barrett建构情绪理论——情绪是对身体感觉的概念化分类，文化环境破坏导致概念库崩溃；(3) 环状模型（circumplex model）——情感变异性的压缩可产生伪均值呈现；(4) 隐藏剖面（hiding profile）——高正向堆叠+中范围破坏性堆叠+压缩情感变异性的三特征组合。
AI.method: 理论框架论文，发展12个可证伪命题（P1–P12），分为一般过程控制架构命题（5个）和隐藏剖面特定命题（7个）。整合前期四篇论文（The Fear Response Gap、ASTOP、The Denominator Problem、The Fate Mechanism）与Deming逻辑、Barrett理论和环状模型。
AI.findings: (1) 隐藏剖面是一个社区层面的过程控制签名，由高正向堆叠、中范围破坏性堆叠、压缩情感变异性三特征共同构成；(2) 标准量表（PHQ-9、GAD-7、WHO-5、环状模型情感量表）因测量均值呈现而非变异结构，无法检测隐藏剖面；(3) 自杀预防研究在原住民社区中效应量持续有限，因为测量架构只看到一个双峰阈值分布中的一个集群；(4) 成功干预的初始信号是变异度增加——标准量表会误读为恶化，但过程控制逻辑会正确识别为过程变得可测量。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出“隐藏剖面”概念作为社区层面的诊断签名；(2) 将Deming的统计过程控制逻辑从工业质量管理扩展至行为健康测量领域；(3) 将测量悖论从“测量异常”重新定义为“理论上可预测的过程控制伪影”；(4) 将概念库崩溃（companion paper）与测量行为表现建立直接连接；(5) 指出殖民地对传统文化环境的系统性破坏导致的内感受错误分类是隐藏剖面的深层根源。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 警示标准量表（PHQ-9、GAD-7、WHO-5等）在高逆境原住民社区中的根本性局限——无法检测隐藏剖面；(2) 解释为何自杀预防研究在该人群中效应量持续有限；(3) 提出“成功干预的初始信号是变异度增加”这一反直觉判断，防止临床误判；(4) 建议测量架构应从均值呈现转向变异结构；(5) 为资源分配和干预优先级提供理论依据，避免高负担社区因测量盲区而被系统性忽略。

title: Sovereign Revenue Optimisation and Regulatory Design in Subnational Economies: An Empirical Analysis of Comparative Asymmetries in India and Saudi Arabia

detail.title: Sovereign Revenue Optimisation and Regulatory Design in Subnational Economies: An Empirical Analysis of Comparative Asymmetries in India and Saudi Arabia
detail.abstract: Subnational economies navigate a structural fiscal paradox: they hold extensive operational mandates for localized public service delivery, infrastructural expansion, and socioeconomic alignment, yet they fundamentally lack sovereign monetary levers and currency-issuance authority. This working paper develops a formal optimization framework-the Fiscal-Regulatory Frontier-to analyze how subnational entities maximize Own-Source Revenue (OSR) while minimizing capital flight and informal sector substitution. Using a Most Different Systems Design (MDSD) comparative methodology, we evaluate the divergent institutional pathways of the Republic of India and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia over the 2016-2026 cycle. We operationalize the trade-offs between tax extraction, compliance friction, and capital mobility across Indian states adjusting to the post-Goods and Services Tax (GST) landscape, and Saudi provinces subject to state-directed spatial regionalism via the Public Investment Fund (PIF). The paper evaluates the structural fragilities of both models, including political economy constraints, subnational debt concealment via off-budget liabilities, informal market elasticities, and the distributional consequences of creating parallel legislative enclaves. Finally, we establish empirical institutional guidelines to stabilize subnational balance sheets without inducing central government debt contagion.

AI.tldr: 本文构建"财政-监管前沿"优化框架，通过比较印度（2016-2026年GST改革后）与沙特阿拉伯（PIF主导的区域主义）的次国家级财政路径，分析地方政府在缺乏货币主权条件下最大化自有收入与抑制资本外逃和非正式部门替代的权衡机制，并提出稳定地方财政的制度指南。
AI.research_question: 缺乏货币主权的次国家级政府如何通过优化税收征管、合规摩擦与资本流动性之间的权衡，实现自有收入（OSR）最大化，同时抑制资本外逃和非正式部门替代？
AI.motivation: 次国家级经济体面临结构性财政悖论：承担大量公共服务、基础设施和社会经济协调的运营职责，却缺乏主权货币杠杆和货币发行权。这一矛盾在印度GST改革后的各邦和沙特PIF主导的区域主义中尤为突出，亟需理论框架和实证指南。
AI.theoretical_framework: "财政-监管前沿"（Fiscal-Regulatory Frontier）优化框架，整合税收提取、合规摩擦与资本流动性之间的权衡分析。
AI.method: 最不同系统设计（MDSD）比较方法，对印度（2016-2026年各邦）与沙特阿拉伯（PIF下各省）进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 1）印度各邦在GST后需应对税收提取与资本外逃的权衡；2）沙特省级区域面临国家主导的空间区域主义约束；3）两种模式均存在结构性脆弱性：政治经济约束、预算外负债导致的地方债务隐匿、非正式市场弹性、平行立法飞地的分配效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统构建次国家级财政优化框架（Fiscal-Regulatory Frontier），将缺乏货币主权的结构性约束纳入正式模型分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出稳定次国家级资产负债表的实证制度指南，避免中央政府的债务传染效应。

title: The Effect of Gentrification on Crime in Los Angeles
affiliations: California State University, Los Angeles

detail.title: The Effect of Gentrification on Crime in Los Angeles

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The research was partly supported by the Haynes Foundation.

detail.abstract: The Adaptive Reuse Ordinance (ARO) of 1999 in Los Angeles incentivized the conversion of vacant historic buildings downtown into residential units, setting off a wave of gentrification. This study uses quarterly LAPD crime data from 1995 to 2010 and a difference-in-differences design to estimate the effect of ARO on neighborhood crime. Treated tracts saw significant declines in homicide, robbery, grand theft person, burglary, and theft from a vehicle compared to untreated tracts. Decadal demographic data point to the mechanism: incomes, rents, and homeownership rose in ARO tracts while poverty fell, patterns consistent with the "eyes on the street" and collective efficacy explanations rather than with the view that revitalization creates new criminal opportunities. The safety gains came at a cost of displacing low-income and minority residents. The results point to a policy tension arising from gentrification, which can make neighborhoods safer while displacing the communities already living in them. Pairing these incentives with protections for low-income housing offers one way to reduce the trade-off.

AI.tldr: 洛杉矶1999年的适应性再利用条例（ARO）通过将市中心空置历史建筑改造为住宅引发了绅士化。基于1995-2010年季度犯罪数据和双重差分法，研究发现ARO显著降低了处理街区的凶杀、抢劫等犯罪，其机制是"街道眼"和集体效能，而非创造犯罪机会。但安全改善以低收入和少数族裔居民流离失所为代价，揭示了绅士化政策中安全与社区置换之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 洛杉矶1999年适应性再利用条例（ARO）如何影响邻里犯罪率？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 城市更新与历史建筑改造政策日益普遍，但其对社区犯罪的影响方向存在争议：一方面，改造可能通过"街道眼"和集体效能提升安全性；另一方面，也可能创造新的犯罪机会。现有研究缺乏对这类大型城市更新政策的因果效应评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Jacobs的"街道眼"理论和Sampson等人的集体效能理论，预测更新改造通过增加街道活动和居民监控降低犯罪；同时考虑犯罪机会理论的竞争性解释，即改造活动可能引入新的犯罪目标。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），利用1995-2010年洛杉矶警察局季度犯罪数据，比较ARO处理街区与未处理街区在政策前后的犯罪变化。
AI.findings: ARO显著降低了处理街区的凶杀、抢劫、重盗窃、入室盗窃和车辆盗窃等犯罪；机制分析表明，处理街区收入、租金和住房自有率上升，贫困率下降，支持"街道眼"和集体效能解释；但这一安全改善以低收入和少数族裔居民流离失所为代价。
AI.theory_contributions: 为绅士化与犯罪关系提供了因果证据，区分了"街道眼"/集体效能与犯罪机会两种竞争性理论机制，揭示了城市更新政策在社会效益（安全）与社会成本（居民置换）之间的理论张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供了实证依据：历史建筑改造激励政策能有效降低犯罪，但必须配套低收入住房保护措施以缓解绅士化带来的社区置换问题，实现更均衡的城市更新。

title: The Value of W: Pricing Neighbourhood Prestige
affiliations: Yonsei University, University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business and University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business

detail.title: The Value of W: Pricing Neighbourhood Prestige
detail.abstract: Estimating the value of neighbourhood prestige is difficult because status is correlated with other desirable neighbourhood attributes. We estimate the value of prestige using a spatial regression discontinuity design in Vancouver, where the historic boundary between the wealthy "West Side" and the working-class "East Side" falls along Ontario Street. This boundary is a quiet residential street that offers no physical barrier, yet for homes on east-west streets, crossing it triggers an immediate switch in the address prefix from "East" to "West". Restricting the sample to homes within 150 meters of Ontario Street, we find a 20.5% premium for single-family homes on the west side.

AI.tldr: 利用温哥华历史边界（安大略街）的空间断点回归设计，发现单户住宅在西侧有20.5%的溢价，证实社区声望本身具有显著经济价值。
AI.research_question: 社区声望（neighbourhood prestige）本身是否具有独立的经济价值？如何排除其他邻里属性的干扰来估算声望溢价？
AI.motivation: 社区声望通常与其他理想属性（如学校质量、安全性）高度相关，导致难以分离声望本身的净效应。作者利用温哥华历史边界提供的准自然实验条件，试图解决这一识别难题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间回归不连续设计（Spatial Regression Discontinuity Design）；享乐定价理论（Hedonic Pricing Theory）；社会地位信号理论（Status Signaling Theory）。
AI.method: 采用空间断点回归设计（RDD），以安大略街为分割线，选取边界两侧150米范围内的住宅样本，比较东西两侧因地址前缀（"East" vs. "West"）不同而产生的房价差异，从而分离声望效应。
AI.findings: 在控制其他因素后，安大略街以西（西区）的单户住宅比东侧存在20.5%的价格溢价。由于边界是一条安静的居民街道，不存在物理阻隔，这一溢价可归因于历史形成的声望差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"地位经济"（status economy）提供了严谨的因果证据，证明社区声望作为一种社会建构属性，能独立于物质环境产生显著的经济溢价，丰富了城市经济学和邻里效应理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对住房政策制定者（如房产税评估、社区规划）、房地产从业者（定价模型）以及购房者（决策参考）均有直接意义；同时为其他存在历史声望边界的城市提供了方法借鉴。

title: An Econometric Analysis into Factors Associated with Temporary Accommodation in England, 2018-2022

detail.title: An Econometric Analysis into Factors Associated with Temporary Accommodation in England, 2018-2022
detail.abstract: Homelessness, in the form of temporary accommodation, cost the public purse more than £2.8bn in the 2024/25 financial year. This paper investigates factors that influence the number of households in temporary accommodation in England from 2018-2022. It uses predominantly open government data and a two-way fixed effects panel regression to test for statistically significant factors. This analysis is undertaken at the local authority level, including mapping Local Housing Allowance to local authority boundaries as opposed to Broad Market Rental Areas to control for local authority heterogeneity. This is an early analysis, which finds initial indicators that the Local Housing Allowance may be an effective policy lever in alleviating the growing public cost of temporary accommodation. Further research using denser data and additional statistical analysis is required to validate these findings.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2018-2022年英格兰地方政府层面的面板数据，通过双向固定效应模型分析影响临时安置住房数量的因素。初步发现地方住房津贴（Local Housing Allowance）可能是缓解临时安置公共成本的有效政策工具。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响英格兰临时安置住房的家庭数量？
AI.motivation: 2024/25财年，英国临时安置住房耗费公共财政超过28亿英镑，公共成本日益攀升，亟需识别有效的政策杠杆来缓解这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地方政府异质性视角，通过将地方住房津贴（LHA）匹配到地方当局边界（而非广义市场租金区域）以控制异质性，运用双向固定效应面板回归模型。
AI.method: 使用英国开放政府数据，采用双向固定效应面板回归（Two-way Fixed Effects Panel Regression）进行分析，分析单位为英格兰地方当局层面，时间跨度为2018-2022年。
AI.findings: 初步发现地方住房津贴（Local Housing Allowance）可能是缓解临时安置公共成本的有效政策杠杆。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将地方住房津贴精确匹配到地方当局边界而非广义市场租金区域，更好地控制了地方政府异质性，为住房政策与公共支出关系的研究提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了初步证据，表明调整地方住房津贴可能是控制临时安置住房公共成本的有效手段，有助于缓解英国日益严重的无家可归问题财政压力。

title: The Concept of 'Development' in International Economic Law: Three Definitions and an Inquiry Into Origin

detail.title: The Concept of 'Development' in International Economic Law: Three Definitions and an Inquiry Into Origin
detail.abstract:
The language of "development" pervades modern international law, yet the concept itself remains strikingly undertheorized in international legal instruments. This article investigates the meaning, origin, and migration of "development" in international economic law (IEL), arguing that the term carries embedded assumptions inherited from a specifically Western, post-Enlightenment view of history as linear and teleological. Drawing on the work of Gilbert Rist, Bruno Latour, Andrew Lang, and others, the paper first traces the philosophical genealogy of "development" from Aristotle and Ibn Khaldun—who conceived of historical change as cyclical—through Augustine, Descartes, Rousseau, Spencer, and Smith, whose writings reframed development as a continuous and necessary trajectory culminating in the "developed" Western state. It then examines how this construct was codified through the post-WWII Bretton Woods institutions and the International Bill of Rights.

The article's central contribution is a close textual analysis of recent free trade agreements that parses out three distinct working definitions of "development" in IEL: (1) Development as a Context (e.g., sustainable development), (2) Development as Creation/Improvement (the bettering of conditions, institutions, or trade), and (3) Development as a Hierarchy (an ordering of states by relative power and capacity). Using the Trans-Pacific Partnership as a baseline, the paper compares deployments of these definitions across FTAs spanning both developed and developing parties (TPP, NAFTA, EU-Vietnam) and FTAs among developed parties only (CETA, EU-Singapore, TTIP).

Engaging Andrew Lang's open question of whether "development" emerged from within IEL or was imposed upon it from human rights law, the paper concludes that the answer is "both": Development as Context and Development as Creation/Improvement migrated into IEL from human rights instruments, whereas Development as a Hierarchy—deployed almost exclusively by powerful states toward less-powerful ones—emerged from within IEL itself.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示"发展"这一概念在国际经济法中并非中性术语，而是源自西方线性进步史观的建构产物。通过对自由贸易协定的文本分析，论文识别出"发展"的三种操作定义——语境、创造/改进、等级——并追溯其来源：前两种从人权法迁移至国际经济法，而"等级性发展"则源自国际经济法内部，被强国用以规制弱国。
AI.research_question: "发展"一词在国际经济法中的含义、起源与迁移路径是什么？它是从人权法内部产生后输入国际经济法，还是从国际经济法内部自发形成的？
AI.motivation: "发展"概念虽普遍存在于现代国际法中，但其理论内涵未被充分审视。现有研究未能揭示这一概念所携带的西方中心主义预设（线性进步史观），也未厘清不同语境下"发展"的多重含义及其制度来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: Gilbert Rist的发展批判理论、Bruno Latour的现代性建构论、Andrew Lang的国际经济法理论；亚里士多德、伊本·赫勒敦（循环史观）到奥古斯丁、笛卡尔、卢梭、斯宾塞、斯密（线性目的论史观）的哲学谱系。
AI.method: 哲学谱系追踪（思想史分析）+ 比较文本分析：以TPP为基准，比较涵盖发达国家与发展中国家的FTA（TPP、NAFTA、EU-Vietnam）以及仅涉及发达国家的FTA（CETA、EU-Singapore、TTIP）中"发展"一词的使用方式。
AI.findings: 识别出三种"发展"的定义：(1) 作为语境的发展（如可持续发展）；(2) 作为创造/改进的发展（改善条件、制度或贸易）；(3) 作为等级的发展（按相对权力和能力对国家排序）。结论：前两种从人权法迁移至国际经济法；第三种（等级性发展）几乎仅由强国对弱国使用，源自国际经济法内部。
AI.theory_contributions: 回应并解答了Andrew Lang关于"发展"概念来源的悬而未决的问题——证明发展概念的双重来源；揭示了国际经济法中"发展"话语的权力不对称性；将哲学谱系分析引入国际经济法批判理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助国际法学者和实务工作者识别自由贸易协定中"发展"话语背后隐含的权力关系和西方中心预设；为发展中缔约国在贸易谈判中反思和应对"等级性发展"话语提供分析框架。

reference: FRB of Cleveland Working Paper No. 26-10
title: Fixing the Phillips Curve: Implications of Firms' Monopsonistic Wage-setting for Inflation Dynamics
affiliations: Bank of Japan and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

detail.title: Fixing the Phillips Curve: Implications of Firms' Monopsonistic Wage-setting for Inflation Dynamics

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Cleveland Working Paper No. 26-10
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Motivated by evidence documented in labor economics, we introduce firms' monopsonistic wage-setting in an otherwise standard DSGE model. Our model identifies shocks to the wage markdown as labor demand shocks—a feature absent from standard models. With both labor demand and supply shocks, our model empirically outperforms its standard counterpart model. Firms' monopsonistic wage-setting allows real unit labor cost to be decomposed into not only real marginal cost but also the wage markdown. This refined measure of real marginal cost enhances the Phillips curve's ability to describe inflation dynamics while obviating the need for price markup shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文将劳动力经济学中的垄断性工资设定引入DSGE模型，识别出工资加价冲击作为劳动需求冲击，改进了菲利普斯曲线对通胀的描述能力，并消除了对价格加价冲击的需求。
AI.research_question: 在标准DSGE模型中引入企业的垄断性工资设定，如何改善模型对经济周期和通胀动态的解释能力？
AI.motivation: 劳动经济学中已有充分证据表明企业在劳动力市场拥有垄断势力（monopsony power），但标准DSGE模型通常假设完全竞争劳动力市场，忽略了工资加价（wage markdown）冲击作为劳动需求冲击的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垄断性工资设定（monopsonistic wage-setting）理论；DSGE模型；菲利普斯曲线理论
AI.method: 将垄断性工资设定纳入标准DSGE模型，识别工资加价冲击作为劳动需求冲击，通过实证对比检验模型表现。
AI.findings: 1）工资加价冲击可作为劳动需求冲击；2）包含劳动需求与供给冲击的模型优于标准模型；3）实际单位劳动成本可分解为实际边际成本和工资加价两部分；4）修正后的实际边际成本指标增强了菲利普斯曲线对通胀的描述能力，且无需引入价格加价冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 将垄断性工资设定引入DSGE框架，为劳动需求冲击提供了新的微观基础解释；重新定义了实际边际成本的度量方式，丰富了菲利普斯曲线的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和宏观经济政策制定者提供了更精准的通胀预测工具，减少了模型中依赖外生价格加价冲击的必要性。

detail.abstract:
Background: Arboviral surveillance in Africa is limited by fragmented diagnostic capacity and insufficient integration of molecular detection with genomic epidemiology, particularly in settings where dengue (DENV), Zika (ZIKV), and chikungunya (CHIKV) viruses co-circulate and present with overlapping clinical syndromes.

Methods: We conducted a molecular surveillance study across multiple regions in Senegal, including samples collected from 367 individuals with febrile or non-febrile illness. A tiered workflow was implemented using multiplex reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) screening for DENV, ZIKV, and CHIKV, performed on a combination of individually tested samples (n=43) and pooled samples (three individuals per pool). DENV RT-qPCR-positive samples were further characterized by reverse transcription recombinase polymerase amplification (RT-RPA) serotyping and genomic sequencing.

Findings: Multiplex RT-qPCR revealed concurrent circulation of multiple arboviruses. Among individually tested samples, positivity rates were 20·9% (9/43) for DENV, 9·3% (4/43) for ZIKV, and 11·6% (5/43) for CHIKV. In pooled screening across all sites (108 pools), positivity rates were 18·5% for DENV (20/108), 5·6% for ZIKV (6/108), and 10·2% for CHIKV (11/108), indicating widespread arboviral transmission. DENV-1-4 serotyping by RT-RPA demonstrated complete concordance with RT-qPCR and identified exclusive circulation of DENV-2, enabling triage of samples for downstream genomic sequencing. Amplicon-based sequencing substantially improved genome recovery compared with metagenomic sequencing, yielding near-complete genomes in 77·8% (14/18) of RT-RPA-positive samples. Phylogenetic analyses demonstrated that all sequences clustered within the DENV-2 cosmopolitan genotype (genotype II), lineage II-F.1.1, closely related to recent strains from West Africa and Asia. Time-resolved reconstruction suggested recent emergence (~2022-2023) and rapid expansion, consistent with ongoing transmission and regional dissemination.

Interpretation: These findings demonstrate co-circulation of DENV, ZIKV, and CHIKV in Senegal and provide evidence of recent expansion of DENV-2 within a globally connected transmission network. A tiered strategy integrating pooled molecular screening with RT-RPA triage and genomic sequencing offers a scalable framework for arboviral surveillance in resource-limited settings.Funding​This study was funded by a Merck Investigator Studies Program (102977) award to BBH.

AI.tldr: 本研究在塞内加尔开展蚊媒病毒分子监测，采用分级策略（多重RT-qPCR筛查→RT-RPA分型→基因组测序），发现DENV、ZIKV和CHIKV共同流行，并鉴定出DENV-2型在2022-2023年的近期扩张，为资源有限地区的蚊媒病毒监测提供了可扩展框架。
AI.research_question: 在塞内加尔多个地区，DENV、ZIKV和CHIKV的共同流行情况如何？能否通过整合分子检测与基因组流行病学的分级监测策略，揭示虫媒病毒的传播动态和演化特征？
AI.motivation: 非洲虫媒病毒监测因诊断能力分散、分子检测与基因组流行病学整合不足而受到限制，尤其是在DENV、ZIKV和CHIKV共同流行且症状重叠的地区，亟需可扩展的监测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 虫媒病毒分子流行病学、基因组系统发育学、时间溯源分析
AI.method: 在塞内加尔多地区收集367份样本，采用分级工作流程：①多重RT-qPCR对DENV/ZIKV/CHIKV进行筛查（含个体检测n=43和每3人混合的混合样本检测108池）；②阳性样本通过RT-RPA进行DENV血清分型；③扩增子测序与宏基因组测序对比进行基因组测序；④系统发育与时间溯源分析。
AI.findings: ①多重RT-qPCR显示三种病毒共同流行，个体样本阳性率：DENV 20.9%、ZIKV 9.3%、CHIKV 11.6%；混合池阳性率：DENV 18.5%、ZIKV 5.6%、CHIKV 10.2%。②RT-RPA血清分型与RT-qPCR完全一致，鉴定出DENV-2型独占性流行。③扩增子测序显著优于宏基因组测序，77.8%的样本获得近乎完整的基因组。④系统发育分析显示所有序列属于DENV-2世界性基因型II型，谱系II-F.1.1，与西非和亚洲近期毒株接近；时间重构表明约2022-2023年近期出现并快速扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: ①首次在塞内加尔多地区系统证实DENV、ZIKV和CHIKV的共同流行格局；②揭示了DENV-2世界性基因型在全球传播网络中的近期扩张动态；③验证了RT-RPA血清分型与传统RT-qPCR的高度一致性，支持其作为替代技术。
AI.practical_contributions: ①提出"混合池分子筛查→RT-RPA分型分流→基因组测序"的分级监测策略，为资源有限地区提供可扩展的虫媒病毒监测框架；②扩增子测序方案可大幅提升基因组回收率，降低测序成本；③发现的DENV-2近期扩张为塞内加尔及西非地区的公共卫生干预提供了关键的流行病学证据。

detail.abstract: The impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on the availability and quality of jobs has received significant attention across scholarly, policy, and public discourse. Identified risks to labour include work intensification, de-skilling, job insecurity, and bias and discrimination in use of AI for employment purposes. Policy attention and advocacy have turned to the role of regulatory mechanisms in enabling and limiting the use of AI, and potential impacts of AI use across sectors, and those who work in or are otherwise stakeholders of those sectors. National regulation plays a critical role in setting baseline protections and expectations against these concerns. Collective bargaining of employees represents a complementary approach to regulation, and correspondingly, lens onto understanding how concerns are being navigated across sectors. Through collective bargaining employees negotiate conditions of their work, with varying systems internationally providing more or less strength to workers in these negotiations, towards a form of participatory governance. Negotiated agreements provide a distinctive lens onto concerns, and strategies for navigating, use of AI in workplaces. In Australia, the focus of this article, industrial relations, including collective bargaining and employment standards, is regulated by the Fair Work Act. This system provides some opportunity for worker collective bargaining and union representation. We identified enterprise agreements that refer to AI (n = 34 retained items), and extracting clauses relating to AI and worker conditions for analysis. Drawing on prior research, we use a framework to map features of these clauses, addressing: definitions of AI, training needs, change management, monitoring of impacts, fundamental rights, and consultative bodies. We discuss coverage of each of these, highlighting key tensions, and gaps. We find that AI is most commonly incorporated through extensions to existing technological change and consultation provisions, with limited substantive engagement with emerging risks such as algorithmic bias, data governance, or psychosocial impacts of digital work. The article concludes with directions of relevance to industrial relations. We demonstrate that agreements provide a useful additional lens in understanding navigation of AI in society, and in particular its regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析澳大利亚企业协议中涉及人工智能的条款，发现大多数协议只是将AI作为现有技术变革和咨询条款的延伸，缺乏对算法偏见、数据治理等新兴风险的实质性关注，展示了集体谈判作为理解AI社会规制的重要补充视角。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚企业集体谈判协议中如何涉及人工智能，以及这些条款在多大程度上应对了AI带来的劳动风险？
AI.motivation: AI对劳动力市场带来工作强度增加、技能去化、工作不安全感、偏见与歧视等风险，政策和学术关注转向规制机制的作用。集体谈判作为参与式治理的重要补充，提供了理解不同行业如何应对AI风险的独特视角，但目前缺乏对谈判协议中AI条款的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参与式治理理论——集体谈判作为工人参与工作条件协商的机制；规制互补视角——国家规制与集体谈判在AI治理中的互补关系。
AI.method: 内容分析：识别并筛选澳大利亚企业协议中提及AI的条款（保留34份），基于先前研究的框架，对条款中的AI定义、培训需求、变更管理、影响监测、基本权利、咨询机构等维度进行编码和分析。
AI.findings: 1. AI条款多作为现有技术变革和咨询条款的延伸，缺乏实质性内容；2. 对算法偏见、数据治理、数字工作的心理社会影响等新兴风险涉及有限；3. 协议内容反映了劳资双方在AI治理上的张力与缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将集体谈判协议作为理解AI社会规制的新分析视角，揭示了规制互补中参与式治理的现状与局限，为AI治理理论提供了劳动关系维度的补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、工会和雇主提供了集体谈判中应对AI风险的具体评估框架；揭示了现有协议在保护劳动者方面的不足，为改进集体谈判策略和规制设计提供了实证依据。

title: The Natural Shoreline Defined: Ancient Common Law Principles and the Boundary No Court has Ever Located

detail.title: The Natural Shoreline Defined: Ancient Common Law Principles and the Boundary No Court has Ever Located

detail.abstract:
For nearly a century and a half, the Supreme Court of Ohio has declared, without defining, the governing principle of littoral property law along Lake Erie: the boundary between the state’s public trust in the waters and the private upland title of the littoral owner is the “natural shoreline” — the line at which the water usually stands when free from disturbing causes. Sloan v. Biemiller (1878) borrowed the phrase from Illinois; Merrill v. Ohio Department of Natural Resources (2011) reaffirmed it unanimously. Neither case, nor any case in the 148 years between them, has ever defined what a disturbing cause is. No legislature has supplied the definition. No regulatory body has operationalized it. And until now, no legal scholar has attempted to do so.

This article fills that gap. The stakes are not academic. Approximately 15,500 littoral landowners along Ohio’s 311-mile Lake Erie coastline hold title that terminates, by law, at a boundary no one can reliably locate. Littoral owners seek certainty and the full exercise of their constitutionally protected property rights to a defined, ascertainable line. Environmental organizations and recreational users press an equal but opposite interest: the assurance that the public trust in the waters of Lake Erie is never severed from the water’s edge by an artificially frozen boundary. Both interests are legitimate. Both are currently unserved.

This article argues that the answer has been embedded in the ancient common law for centuries, requiring only that it be recognized and applied. The common law of littoral property has long distinguished two categories of forces that alter the water’s edge. The first category — accretion, reliction, erosion, and submersion — consists of processes that are gradual, long-term, imperceptible while underway, and ordinary in character. These processes have always been recognized as title-changers: they move the boundary with the water. The second category — avulsion, storm surge, seiche, atmospheric pressure change, ice effects, wind tide, and similar sudden forces — consists of processes that are abrupt, short-term, dramatic, and perceptible while underway. These are the disturbing causes: they do not move the boundary, because the water’s position under their influence is not the water’s natural position.

The key is perceptibility at the time the process is underway, not measurability after the fact. A disturbing cause can be seen happening. Accretion, reliction, erosion, and submersion cannot be perceived while they occur, only measured in retrospect. That distinction — ancient, principled, already embedded in American property law and confirmed by the Supreme Court of the United States — resolves the definitional problem that Merrill left open. The natural shoreline is the water’s edge in its ordinary, undisturbed condition: mobile across time with the gradual forces the common law has always recognized as title-changers, but stable against the perceptible disturbances the common law has never permitted to alter property boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文填补了俄亥俄州最高法院近150年来未定义的"自然岸线"概念空白，提出以"可感知性"区分扰乱原因（如风暴潮、冰塞等突发剧烈事件）与渐进过程（如淤积、侵蚀等缓慢变化），从而为伊利湖沿岸约15,500名土地所有者提供可界定的产权边界标准。
AI.research_question: 如何定义俄亥俄州伊利湖沿岸"自然岸线"法律概念中"扰乱原因"（disturbing cause）的具体内涵，以确定公共信托水域与私人滨岸土地所有权之间的边界。
AI.motivation: 俄亥俄州最高法院自1878年Sloan案至2011年Merrill案，近一个半世纪以来从未定义"扰乱原因"，导致约15,500名滨岸土地所有者的产权边界无法可靠确定，环境保护组织与公众信托权益也缺乏保障，这一法律空白亟需填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 普通法中滨岸财产法关于边界变动的两类区分：（1）渐进过程——淤积、蚀退、浸没等缓慢、长期、不可感知的变动，属于"改变所有权的力量"；（2）突发原因——河道突变、风暴潮、假潮、气压变化、冰塞、风增水等剧烈、短期、可感知的变动，属于"扰乱原因"。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与普通法历史梳理。通过追溯自1878年Sloan案至2011年Merrill案的司法判例史，结合普通法中关于滨岸财产边界的古老区分原则，进行概念界定与理论推演。
AI.findings: 区分两类力量的关键标准是"可感知性"（perceptibility at the time）：扰乱原因是正在发生时可被观察到的（如风暴、冰塞），而渐进过程在发生时不可被感知，只能事后测量。"自然岸线"即水体在通常、未受干扰状态下的边缘线，随时间因渐进力量而移动，但不受可感知的扰乱原因影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统界定了困扰俄亥俄州法律近150年的"扰乱原因"概念，将普通法中早已存在但未被明确适用的"可感知性"区分标准应用于伊利湖滨岸产权边界问题，弥合了理论与司法实践之间的关键空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为约15,500名伊利湖沿岸土地所有者提供了可操作的边界确定标准，平衡了私人产权保障与公共信托权益保护之间的张力，为立法机关和监管机构提供了明确的法律定义基础。

title: A Role for Artificial Intelligence in a Politicized Immigration World
affiliations: Drexel University Thomas R. Kline School of Law

detail.title: A Role for Artificial Intelligence in a Politicized Immigration World
detail.abstract:
Many debates about artificial intelligence boil down to one central question: who is better (or worse) at making decisions? Artificial intelligence doomsayers worry that AI will supplant human decision-making, with catastrophic consequences that render humans expendable. On the other hand, if AI can overcome human bias and nefarious intent, it holds the possibility of shielding humanity from its worst impulses.

This tension is evident in the realm of immigration policy, which for the last 100 years has revealed the frailties of human decision-making. Immigration debates prompt racial and ethnic stereotyping, reactionary proposals, and deliberate refusals to examine evidence or prioritize fact-based decisions. Introducing AI tools can add fuel to the fire. It can promote mass surveillance of noncitizens, mining social medial to find reasons to revoke visas, and perpetuate racial and ethnic bias.

While staying clear eyed about these risk, this essay suggests that immigration policymaking displays how human decision-making is so flawed that enabling greater use of AI technology--with appropriate guardrails and guiding principles--may actually help protect us from ourselves. It is possible that AI tools, which lack motivation and intent, can provide a buffer against human cruelty, implicit bias, and capacity limitations. This essay offers three principles to guide AI with respect to immigration. First, AI technology can offer independence and protection from political interference over day-to-day agency decisions. Second, given the way the current presidential administration is dismantling the federal workforce, AI tools may prove necessary for processing immigration applications and reducing backlogs. Third, AI use should be guided by the principle of affirming human dignity. In that way, AI can address situations where a noncitizen seeks the government's help while simultaneously protecting against the government's non-consensual intrusion upon individual rights, such as through expanded surveillance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在移民政策领域中，人类决策存在严重缺陷（如偏见、种族刻板印象等），而AI工具虽然在移民领域存在风险（如大规模监控、延续偏见），但在适当的护栏和原则指导下，反而可能帮助保护人类免受自身最糟糕的决策冲动所害。文章提出了指导AI在移民领域应用的三个原则：独立性（免受政治干预）、必要性（应对联邦劳动力削减）、以及维护人类尊严。
AI.research_question: 在移民政策制定中，AI能否以及如何比人类决策更好地发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 人类在移民决策中存在严重的种族偏见、情绪化反应、拒绝基于证据等缺陷；同时AI在移民领域的应用也面临风险（如大规模监控、延续偏见），但本文试图论证在适当引导下AI反而可以保护人类免受自身决策缺陷的伤害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类决策缺陷理论（偏见、刻板印象、能力限制）；AI缺乏动机与意图的特性；以人类尊严为核心的原则框架。
AI.method: 规范性分析/理论论证（essay形式），提出三条指导原则。
AI.findings: AI工具由于缺乏动机和意图，可以为人类决策提供缓冲，抵御人类的残忍、隐性偏见和能力限制；提出了三条指导原则：政治独立性、应对联邦劳动力削减的必要性、维护人类尊严。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI与人类决策的优劣辩论引入移民政策领域；提出了AI"无动机无意图"可作为对抗人类决策缺陷的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策中的AI应用提供了三原则框架（独立于政治、应对人力短缺、维护尊严）；为如何在实践中设置AI应用的护栏和指导原则提供了方向。

detail.title: Integration of Vastu Principles in Sugarcane Disease Management: A Comparative Agro-Spatial Study on Red Rot and Major Diseases in Sugarcane Cultivation
detail.abstract: Sugarcane cultivation remains vulnerable to several destructive diseases, including Red Rot, Smut, Wilt, and Grassy Shoot Disease. Conventional agricultural science associates these diseases with fungal pathogens, climatic conditions, water stagnation, monocropping, poor drainage, and infected planting material. However, traditional Indian environmental sciences such as Vastu Shastra propose that land orientation, directional balance, solar movement, airflow patterns, geomagnetic alignment, and water placement may also influence ecological harmony and biological health. This research paper investigates the relationship between agricultural spatial organisation and disease development in sugarcane cultivation through an interdisciplinary framework integrating plant pathology, environmental science, sustainable agriculture, and Vastu-based land planning. The study particularly focuses on the influence of moisture retention, sunlight exposure, field slope, air circulation, and irrigation layout on the prevalence of fungal diseases such as Red Rot. A comparative conceptual analysis has been conducted using climatic observations from tropical sugarcane-producing regions including Tamil Nadu (India) and Peru. The study proposes that certain traditional Vastu principles may correspond with scientifically measurable environmental variables including humidity management, ultraviolet exposure, drainage efficiency, and microclimatic regulation. The paper does not claim supernatural causation; rather, it explores whether traditional spatial agricultural knowledge may contribute toward healthier agro-ecological systems and sustainable disease management. The study recommends future experimental field trials for scientific validation of agro-spatial farming models.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了印度传统环境科学Vastu Shastra中的空间组织原则（如土地朝向、气流模式、地磁对齐等）与甘蔗真菌病害（如红腐病）发生之间的关系，通过跨学科框架整合植物病理学、环境科学、可持续农业和Vastu土地规划，提出传统空间农业知识可能对应可测量的环境变量（湿度管理、紫外线暴露、排水效率等），并呼吁未来进行田间试验验证。
AI.research_question: 农业空间组织（基于Vastu Shastra原则）与甘蔗病害（特别是真菌性红腐病）发生之间存在怎样的关系？传统空间知识能否对应科学可测量的环境变量？
AI.motivation: 甘蔗种植长期受到红腐病、黑穗病等多种病害威胁，传统农学将其归因于病原真菌、气候、积水、连作等因素，但印度传统环境科学Vastu Shastra提出土地朝向、方向平衡、气流模式等空间因素也可能影响生态和谐与生物健康。本文旨在通过跨学科视角，探索传统空间知识与现代病害管理之间的潜在联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 植物病理学（真菌病害发生机制）；2) 环境科学（微气候、湿度、光照、排水等环境变量）；3) 可持续农业理论；4) Vastu Shastra传统空间规划原则（土地朝向、方向平衡、太阳能运动、气流模式、地磁对齐、水体布局）。
AI.method: 比较概念分析（Comparative Conceptual Analysis）：基于热带甘蔗产区（印度泰米尔纳德邦和秘鲁）的气候观测数据，将Vastu原则与可测量的科学环境变量（湿度管理、紫外线暴露、排水效率、微气候调节）进行对应分析。论文为概念性研究，未进行实地试验。
AI.findings: 1) Vastu Shastra的某些空间原则（如土地朝向、气流通道、水体位置）可能对应科学上已知影响真菌病害的环境变量（湿度、光照、排水、通风）；2) 传统空间知识与现代科学在微气候调控方面存在潜在的一致性；3) 论文未声称超自然因果关系，但认为传统空间农业知识可能有助于构建更健康的农业生态系统；4) 传统知识可作为可持续病害管理的补充视角，但需未来田间试验验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出跨学科整合框架，将传统本土生态知识（Vastu Shastra）与现代植物病理学和环境科学进行对话；2) 为农业空间组织与病害关系提供新的理论视角，超越传统的单一病原-环境归因模型；3) 拓展了可持续农业的理论边界，纳入文化-空间维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为甘蔗种植者提供潜在的补充性病害管理思路（如优化田地方向、改善气流和排水布局）；2) 促进传统农业知识与现代可持续农业实践的结合；3) 提出了未来实验验证的方向，为农业空间规划设计提供参考；4) 有助于减少化学农药依赖，推动生态友好型病害管理。

title: The Institutional Origins of AI: Evidence from Large Language Models
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Institutional Origins of AI: Evidence from Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Organizations adopt artificial intelligence on cost and capability. They do not ask what else travels with the efficiency. This paper argues that institutional logics are embedded in AI systems through the production process itself-carried into every organization that adopts them, whether recognized or not. We develop a production-position framework identifying eight dimensions along which AI producers vary: organizational type, regulatory context, training data, human feedback labor, evaluation regimes, market positioning, funding structure, and distillation lineage. Drawing on institutional carrier theory (Scott, 2003) and epistemic cultures (Knorr-Cetina, 1999), we theorize AI as a new class of institutional carrier-one that transports institutional dispositions without the communities of practice that produced them. Two empirical studies test this framework. Study 1 administers 25 organizational decision scenarios to five frontier models from four institutional origins (3,125 observations): models diverge systematically on 68% of scenarios while maintaining 91.4% within-model consistency. Study 2 administers six open-ended knowledge-production tasks to nine frontier models from four institutional contexts (162 outputs): institutional signatures are detectable at the embedding level but not at the surface, manifesting as divergent epistemic commitments about what constitutes evidence, explanation, and legitimate inquiry. When knowledge workers collaborate with different AI, they encounter different epistemic cultures-not because of capability differences but because of production-origin differences. The configuration of production dimensions predicts behavioral similarity better than any single dimension-including geographic origin. AI selection is institutional selection. "Does it work?" must be joined by "whose world travels with it?

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI系统通过生产过程嵌入了制度逻辑，成为新型制度载体，将生产者的制度规范、认识论文化传播到所有采用组织中。通过8个生产维度框架和两项实证研究（3,125个决策情景和162个知识产出任务），发现不同制度来源的AI模型在决策和认识论承诺上存在系统性差异，且生产配置比地理来源更能预测模型行为相似性。
AI.research_question: AI系统中是否嵌入了制度逻辑？不同生产来源的AI模型是否携带不同的制度规范与认识论文化？
AI.motivation: 组织在采用AI时仅关注成本和能力，忽视了AI系统中隐藏的制度逻辑。作者试图揭示AI如何通过生产过程将生产者的制度规范传播到采用组织中，并证明这种影响是可测量的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度载体理论（Scott, 2003）和认识论文化理论（Knorr-Cetina, 1999）。将AI概念化为一种新型制度载体——在没有原生实践社区的情况下运输制度倾向。
AI.method: 提出包含8个维度的"生产-位置"框架。两项实证研究：研究1对5个前沿模型（4种制度来源）进行25个组织决策情景测试（3,125个观测值）；研究2对9个前沿模型（4种制度背景）进行6项开放式知识产出任务（162个输出）。
AI.findings: 研究1：模型在68%的情景上存在系统性分歧，但模型内一致性达91.4%。研究2：制度印记在嵌入层面可检测但在表面不可见，表现为关于证据、解释和合法探究的不同认识论承诺。生产维度配置比地理来源更能预测行为相似性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI作为新型制度载体的理论概念，拓展了制度载体理论；将认识论文化与AI研究结合，揭示AI传播制度逻辑的新机制——无需实践社区即可实现制度扩散。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织选择AI提供新视角：AI选择即制度选择，须追问"谁的观念世界随它而来"；帮助组织识别AI系统中隐含的制度偏见和认识论倾向。

title: Relief item priority dynamics in a distribution-allocation problem with divergent equity concerns
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), Dongbei University of Finance and Economics, University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) and INSEAD

detail.title: Relief item priority dynamics in a distribution-allocation problem with divergent equity concerns

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare No potential conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The work is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [72571254], [72471214], [72204241], [72404051] and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities [WK2040000111].

detail.abstract: In humanitarian logistics (HL), prioritizing of relief item distribution under limited transportation capacity is an important and practical problem that relief organizations face. The priority not only depends on the dynamic demand urgency, but also on the different equity concerns between distribution center (DC) managers and point of distribution (POD) managers. In this paper, through field investigations, we adopt deprivation cost to capture the dynamic priority among different relief items like drinking water or tents, and envy to represent the equity perceptions of victims, based on which we study a distribution-allocation problem to answer the following research questions: (1) Which kind of relief item at which time point should be distributed in priority with limited transportation capacity? (2) What’s the impact on distribution strategy when there are misalignments between DC and POD managers? Should the DC managers take envy of victims into account? We build a bi-objective model which minimizes the sum of deprivation cost of different relief items and the possible penalty caused by envy. A case study is conducted based on the real-world data of Lushan earthquake. The result proves the feasibility of using deprivation cost functions to demonstrate relief item priority dynamics in distribution-allocation problems, and shows that the consideration of envy may greatly influence the optimal distribution strategy and change the priority of relief items. Summarizing, this paper presents an original approach to incorporate the dynamic priority of relief item distribution with consideration of divergent equity concerns.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入剥夺成本（动态需求紧迫性）和嫉妒（受害者公平感知），构建双目标模型，研究人道主义物流中有限运输能力下的救援物资分配优先级问题，并基于芦山地震数据进行案例验证。
AI.research_question: (1) 在有限运输能力下，哪种救援物资在哪个时间点应优先分配？(2) 当配送中心（DC）和分发点（POD）管理者之间的优先级不一致时，对分配策略有何影响？DC管理者是否应考虑受害者的嫉妒心理？
AI.motivation: 人道主义物流中，有限运输能力下救援物资的优先级分配是一个重要且实际的问题。优先级不仅取决于动态需求紧迫性，还受到DC和POD管理者之间不同公平关切的影响，现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 剥夺成本理论（捕获救援物资的动态紧迫性）、嫉妒理论（代表受害者的公平感知）
AI.method: (1) 实地调研；(2) 构建双目标优化模型（最小化剥夺成本 + 嫉妒惩罚成本）；(3) 基于芦山地震真实数据进行案例研究
AI.findings: (1) 剥夺成本函数能有效展现救援物资在分配-运输问题中的动态优先级变化；(2) 考虑嫉妒因素会显著影响最优分配策略，并改变救援物资的优先级顺序。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种将动态优先级与不同公平关切纳入救援物资分配的新方法，拓展了人道主义物流中公平性问题的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为救援组织在有限运输能力下制定更合理的物资分配策略提供决策支持，提示管理者应关注受害者的公平感知。

title: Integrated Human-Robot Safety Management System (I-HR-SMS): A Validated Measurement Framework for Worker Safety Perception in Collaborative Robot Environments
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Integrated Human-Robot Safety Management System (I-HR-SMS): A Validated Measurement Framework for Worker Safety Perception in Collaborative Robot Environments

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
The rapid expansion of collaborative robots (cobots) in industrial environments has introduced new, insufficiently understood safety challenges at the point of human‑robot interaction (HRI). This study presents the Integrated Human‑Robot Safety Management System (I‑HR‑SMS), a three‑pillar measurement framework—Hazard Recognition and Signal Detection, Procedural Adherence and Safety Compliance, and Adaptive Response and Recovery—designed to quantify worker safety perceptions during discrete HRI events. Unlike prior research that treats the worker or organization as the unit of analysis, the I‑HR‑SMS designates the HRI event as the analytic unit, enabling detection of within‑person and cross‑sector variability across three deployment environments: Humanoid Robotics, Airport Luggage Operations, and Warehousing and Manufacturing.

A 36‑item, 6th‑grade‑literacy‑calibrated digital survey instrument was developed and administered using a gamified delivery platform to maximize comprehension and response completeness. A five‑stage multistage cluster sampling strategy (3 sectors × 5 industries × 5 cities × 3 shifts) produced a theoretical frame of 225 shift‑level sampling units, from which systematically sampled HRI events yielded a target sample of N = 102 event‑level records, consistent with G*Power requirements for medium‑effect multiple regression. The instrument includes three validated composite scales aligned to the I‑HR‑SMS pillars and incorporates attention‑check items to ensure data integrity.

The I‑HR‑SMS framework advances HRI safety research by (1) operationalizing safety perception at the event level, (2) integrating literacy‑aligned item design for frontline industrial workers, and (3) enabling comparative analysis across heterogeneous cobot deployment contexts. Findings are positioned to inform both theoretical models of safety climate and practical safety management strategies aligned with NIOSH priorities and A3 Robotics collaborative safety standards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以人机交互事件为分析单元的三支柱安全感知测量框架（I-HR-SMS），通过36题项、6年级阅读水平适配的数字化游戏化问卷，在三个行业（人形机器人、机场行李运营、仓储制造）中收集了102个事件级样本，旨在量化协作机器人环境中的工人安全感知，为安全氛围理论和实践管理策略提供新视角。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和验证一个以人机交互事件为分析单元、能够量化工人在协作机器人环境中安全感知的多维度测量框架？
AI.motivation: 协作机器人在工业环境中的快速扩张带来了尚未被充分理解的安全挑战，而现有研究多以工人或组织为分析单元，无法捕捉个体内部和跨部门的人机交互事件级安全感知变异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三支柱整合式人机安全管理系统：危害识别与信号检测、程序遵守与安全合规、适应性响应与恢复；以HRI事件（而非工人或组织）为分析单元。
AI.method: 开发36题项、6年级阅读水平适配的数字问卷，通过游戏化平台施测；采用五阶段多阶段整群抽样（3行业×5产业×5城市×3班次），系统抽样获得102个事件级记录；使用三项验证性复合量表，包含注意力检测题项。
AI.findings: I-HR-SMS框架能够在事件层面操作化安全感知，实现跨人形机器人、机场行李运营、仓储制造三类异构协作机器人部署环境的比较分析，数据完整性得到注意力检测保障。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将安全感知的操作化从工人/组织层面下探到HRI事件层面，支持个体内变异检测；(2) 整合了面向一线产业工人的阅读水平适配题项设计；(3) 实现了跨异构协作机器人部署情境的比较分析，推进了安全氛围理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了与NIOSH优先事项和A3 Robotics协作安全标准对齐的安全管理策略工具，可指导不同行业协作机器人部署中的安全干预措施设计。

title: A Privacy-Preserving Asynchronous Conversational Architecture for Automated Healthcare Appointment Scheduling Using Persistent State Recovery
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: A Privacy-Preserving Asynchronous Conversational Architecture for Automated Healthcare Appointment Scheduling Using Persistent State Recovery

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Healthcare organizations manage operational tasks such as appointment scheduling, wellness reminders, transportation coordination, and patient follow-ups. The majority of conversational healthcare systems now in use rely on third-party services and centralized cloud-based transformer models [1], [2], which raises issues with patient privacy, operating costs, regulatory compliance, and reliance on outside infrastructure. Furthermore, asynchronous communication and dependable workflow recovery following disruptions are not adequately supported by many chatbot systems, which are designed for real-time engagement [5]-[8]. This work offers a lightweight, privacy-preserving asynchronous conversational framework for automated healthcare appointment scheduling using deterministic workflow execution and persistent-state recovery. The suggested design, in contrast to traditional cloud-hosted chatbot systems, uses recovery-driven queue processing and SQL-based persistent-state monitoring to preserve multi-stage scheduling continuity in the event of interrupted and delayed communication. The system operates entirely on-premises using standard SMTP and IMAP protocols and was implemented in Python with Microsoft SQL Server, with deployment as a standalone executable using PyInstaller [9], [10]. Experimental evaluation using 106 synthetic patient records generated with the Synthea platform [11] produced 283 asynchronous conversational workflow events. Controlled fault-injection testing demonstrated successful persistent-state recovery after simulated crashes, zero duplicate scheduling events, zero message loss, and reliable workflow continuity. The proposed architecture provides a cost-effective, HIPAA-oriented, privacy-preserving alternative for smaller healthcare organizations requiring dependable appointment scheduling without centralized cloud infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级、保护隐私的异步对话框架，用于自动化医疗预约安排。该框架采用确定性工作流执行和持久状态恢复，完全在本地部署，基于SMTP/IMAP协议和SQL Server实现。实验表明，该架构能在无中央云基础设施的情况下实现可靠的工作流连续性，为小型医疗机构提供了一种符合HIPAA的、经济高效的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种轻量级、保护隐私的异步对话框架，在无需中央云基础设施的情况下，实现可靠的医疗预约自动化安排？
AI.motivation: 现有医疗对话系统多依赖第三方云服务，存在患者隐私泄露、运营成本高、合规风险大、对外部基础设施依赖强等问题；同时，许多聊天机器人仅支持实时交互，缺乏异步通信和中断后的工作流恢复机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 确定性工作流执行（Deterministic Workflow Execution）、持久状态恢复（Persistent-State Recovery）、基于恢复的队列处理（Recovery-Driven Queue Processing）、SQL持久状态监控。
AI.method: 系统在Python中实现，使用Microsoft SQL Server作为数据库，通过标准SMTP/IMAP协议进行通信，部署为PyInstaller生成的独立可执行文件。实验使用Synthea平台生成的106份合成患者记录，产生283个异步对话工作流事件，并通过受控故障注入测试验证恢复能力。
AI.findings: 故障注入测试表明：系统在模拟崩溃后成功实现持久状态恢复，零重复调度事件，零消息丢失，工作流连续性可靠。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将确定性工作流执行与SQL持久状态监控相结合的异步对话架构，解决了医疗场景中中断通信下的工作流连续性问题，为去中心化、保护隐私的医疗对话系统提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需中央云基础设施、符合HIPAA标准、经济高效的医疗预约调度方案，特别适用于资源有限的小型医疗机构；系统完全本地部署，降低了运营成本和隐私风险。

title: Causal Inference, Cancer Registry Data, and a Single State Policy Change: Evaluating Virginia's HPV Vaccine Mandate
affiliations: Des Moines University and Des Moines University

detail.title: Causal Inference, Cancer Registry Data, and a Single State Policy Change: Evaluating Virginia's HPV Vaccine Mandate

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts to disclose.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Background: Cancer epidemiologists increasingly contribute evidence evaluating the causal effect of policies on cancer outcomes. The validity of such evidence relies on attention to conceptual, analytic, and data aspects of causal inference research. To highlight these important aspects and contribute our own policy-relevant evidence, we aimed to evaluate Virginia's Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination mandate on cervical cancer incidence. HPV vaccination mandates were intended to increase vaccine uptake and reduce cervical cancer incidence, yet causal evidence on cancer incidence remains scarce. Virginia implemented an HPV vaccine mandate in 2008, providing an opportunity to leverage this natural experiment within a causal inference framework. Methods: After motivating why traditional methods may be invalid, we estimated the effect of Virginia's HPV vaccine mandate on cervical cancer incidence among females aged 20-24 with a synthetic control triple differences design. Our post-period begins in 2016, when the first mandate-exposed cohort reached ages 20-24. State-level cancer registry data (2003-2019) were used to compare Virginia's incidence trends to a weighted combination of control states, while adjusting for within-state trends across age groups exposed and not exposed to the mandate. Results: Cervical cancer incidence among 20-24-year-old females declined over time in both Virginia and comparison states. Ignoring within-state differential age-group trends, the synthetic control difference-indifferences design showed no evidence of any effect. The synthetic control triple difference design estimated that Virginia's mandate was associated with 1.6 additional cervical cancer cases per 100,000 population (CI = 0.4, 2.7). Alternative specifications, including adjustments for screening and multiple sensitivity analyses, produced consistent results in direction and inference.

AI.tldr: 本文利用合成控制三重差分法评估了弗吉尼亚州HPV疫苗强制接种政策对20-24岁女性宫颈癌发病率的影响，发现该政策与宫颈癌发病率增加有关，而非预期的减少。
AI.research_question: 弗吉尼亚州2008年实施的HPV疫苗强制接种政策对20-24岁女性宫颈癌发病率有何因果效应？
AI.motivation: HPV疫苗强制接种政策旨在提高疫苗覆盖率并降低宫颈癌发病率，但关于政策对癌症发病率的因果证据仍然稀缺。弗吉尼亚州2008年的政策提供了一个自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果推断框架，包括合成控制法、双重差分法和三重差分法，以处理传统方法可能存在的效度问题。
AI.method: 使用合成控制三重差分设计，基于2003-2019年州级癌症登记数据，比较弗吉尼亚州与加权对照组州的宫颈癌发病率趋势，并调整暴露与非暴露年龄组内的州内趋势差异。
AI.findings: 合成控制双重差分显示无效应；合成控制三重差分估计显示政策与每10万人增加1.6例宫颈癌病例相关（CI=0.4, 2.7）。多种敏感性分析结果方向一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了在政策评估中运用因果推断框架（特别是合成控制三重差分法）处理传统方法偏差的重要性；揭示了强制性公共卫生政策可能产生非预期负面后果的理论可能性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HPV疫苗强制接种政策的意外后果提供了因果证据，提醒政策制定者在实施类似强制政策时需关注潜在的非预期负面效应，并建议进一步研究政策设计与执行细节。

title: From Rainy Day Funds to Digital Gold: The Politics and Prudence of State-Level Bitcoin Reserves
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: From Rainy Day Funds to Digital Gold: The Politics and Prudence of State-Level Bitcoin Reserves
detail.abstract: Beginning in 2025, a growing number of U.S. states enacted legislation authorizing public funds to be invested in Bitcoin and other digital assets, marking a significant departure from traditional public finance principles that prioritize liquidity, stability, and capital preservation. This paper examines the national trend of statelevel cryptocurrency reserve legislation, with a detailed case study of Texas, the first state to fund such a reserve. The analysis synthesizes legislative frameworks, investment mechanics, political motivations, and documented outcomes through May 2026. Particular attenion is paid to fiscal prudence concerns raised by economists and lawmakers, including volatility risk, taxpayer exposure, and governance challenges. While proponents argue these initiatives hedge against inflation and signal economic competitiveness, the evidence to date suggests substantial risks have materialized, with Texas's initial purchase showing an unrealized loss exceeding 11%. The paper concludes that current initiatives remain more politically symbolic than financially substantive, though their long-term implications for public finance warrant continued scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 自2025年起，美国多个州通过立法允许将公共资金投资于比特币等数字资产，本文以德克萨斯州为案例，分析了这一趋势的立法框架、投资机制、政治动机及至2026年5月的实证结果。研究发现，尽管支持者声称此举可对冲通胀并提升经济竞争力，但德州的初始投资已出现超11%的未实现亏损，表明这些举措目前更多是政治象征性，而非财务实质性。
AI.research_question: 美国州级加密货币储备立法的国家趋势如何？其财政审慎性、风险与收益如何？德克萨斯州的案例提供了什么经验证据？
AI.motivation: 美国多州自2025年起陆续通过立法授权公共资金投资比特币等数字资产，这背离了传统公共财政强调流动性、稳定性和资本保全的原则，引发了经济学家和立法者对财政审慎性的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统公共财政理论（强调流动性、稳定性和资本保全）、风险对冲理论（认为比特币可对冲通胀）、政治经济学中的象征性政策理论。
AI.method: 综合立法分析、投资机制梳理、政治动机解读，以及对德克萨斯州的详细案例研究（包括截至2026年5月的投资结果追踪）。
AI.findings: 1）德克萨斯州的初始比特币投资已出现超过11%的未实现亏损；2）实质性风险（波动风险、纳税人风险敞口、治理挑战）已显现；3）当前举措更多是政治象征性，而非财务实质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公共财政理论与加密货币投资实践相结合，揭示了数字资产投资与传统公共财政原则之间的结构性矛盾，为政治象征性政策的理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公共财政管理者提供了州级加密货币储备的真实风险证据，警示了纳税人资金可能面临的波动风险，并呼吁对公共资金投资数字资产的长期影响进行持续审慎监管。

title: Tidy Homes Have Green Walls: Uncovering the “Tidy = Sustainable” Association
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Marketing and

detail.title: Tidy Homes Have Green Walls: Uncovering the “Tidy = Sustainable” Association

publicationDetails.detailsText: NHH Dept. of Business and Management Science Discussion Paper No. 2026/5
publicationDetails.journalName: Norwegian School of Economics, Department of Business & Management Science Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this research we uncover a tidy=sustainable association, which informs consumers’ evaluations and decisions. Across ten studies (N=2700), we find that consumers judge tidy (versus untidy) places, as well as objects within those places, to be more sustainable. We posit that consumers develop this learnt association because of the link through the multi-faceted concept of minimalism, which encompasses aspects related to aesthetics (as represented in spatial tidiness) and consumption (with impact sustainability outcomes). Supporting this mechanism, we show that spatial tidiness increases perceptions of minimalistic consumption practices—where consumers perceive tidy spaces as reflecting reduced number of possessions and mindful consumption—which in turn increases sustainability evaluations. Importantly, we show that the tidy=sustainable association operates bidirectionally, is amplified among consumers with higher minimalism values, and has downstream consequences on purchase, recommendation, and joint consumption decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，整洁与可持续之间存在一种习得性联想，消费者认为整洁（相对于凌乱）的空间及其中的物品更具可持续性，这种联想通过极简主义（涵盖美学和消费两方面）的中介机制发挥作用，并对购买、推荐和联合消费决策产生下游影响。
AI.research_question: 消费者是否会将"整洁"与"可持续"联系起来？这种联想如何影响消费者的评价和决策？
AI.motivation: 尽管整洁和可持续性在直觉上可能存在关联，但现有文献尚未系统探究这一联想的存在性、内在机制及其对消费者行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极简主义（Minimalism）——涵盖美学维度（空间整洁性）和消费维度（减少物品数量、有意识的消费），作为联结整洁与可持续的关键中介机制。
AI.method: 10项研究（N=2700），包括实验法，操纵空间整洁性，测量可持续性评价及下游消费决策。
AI.findings: （1）消费者认为整洁（vs.凌乱）的空间及其中物品更可持续；（2）极简主义感知（减少物品数量、有意识的消费）中介了该效应；（3）该联想具有双向性；（4）在极简主义价值观较高的消费者中效应更强；（5）影响购买、推荐和联合消费决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示"整洁=可持续"的消费者联想，提出并验证了极简主义作为联结整洁美学与可持续消费的理论机制，拓展了消费者可持续性判断的心理学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商、品牌和营销人员提供了通过空间整洁性影响消费者可持续性感知和购买决策的实践启示；对产品展示、店面设计和可持续营销策略具有指导意义。

title: Organisational Design and the Integration Failure at the Heart of Megaproject Underperformance
affiliations: University of Oxford - Saïd Business School

detail.title: Organisational Design and the Integration Failure at the Heart of Megaproject Underperformance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No primary research.

detail.abstract: Complex infrastructure projects fail at integration. The failure is structural before it is cultural: it stems from decisions about organisational design, contractual form, and the allocation of interface risk, made years before any construction begins. This paper develops an analytical framework to explain why integration fails on complex infrastructure projects and what a viable alternative looks like. Drawing on three UK cases (Crossrail (the Elizabeth line), the A14 Cambridge to Huntingdon road improvement, and the Thames Tideway Tunnel), the paper argues that the dominant project delivery model concentrates integration risk within a single client body without establishing the structural mechanisms that such concentration requires. The conventional response, a central authority board, only relocates the problem it is meant to solve. The alternative, demonstrated at Tideway and partially prefigured at the A14, is organisational design that embeds lateral connections between contractors in governance structures, encodes them in commercial terms, and pushes decision authority to where knowledge sits. The paper identifies three principles: integration is a structural problem, not a cultural one; empowerment requires verified competence and aligned incentives; and lateral connections must be designed in, not improvised. Implications are drawn for contract design, project leadership diagnostics, and the ongoing reform of the NEC contract suite.

AI.tldr: 复杂基础设施项目失败的根本原因是结构性整合失败，而非文化问题。本文通过三个英国案例，提出了一种将横向连接嵌入治理结构、商业条款和决策权的替代性组织设计方案。
AI.research_question: 为什么复杂基础设施项目在整合上会失败，以及可行的替代方案是什么？
AI.motivation: 大型基础设施项目普遍存在整合失败问题，且失败在项目建设前就已由组织设计、合同形式等结构性决策所决定，现有解决方案如中央权力委员会只是转移问题而非解决问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性整合理论：整合失败是结构性问题而非文化问题；赋权需要验证的能力和一致的激励；横向连接必须预先设计而非临时凑合。
AI.method: 基于英国三个大型基础设施项目（Crossrail伊丽莎白线、A14剑桥至亨廷顿公路改造、泰晤士潮汐隧道）的案例研究。
AI.findings: 主导的项目交付模式将整合风险集中在一个单一的客户机构内，但缺乏所需的结构性机制。传统应对方式（中央权力委员会）只是转移问题。替代方案将横向连接嵌入治理结构、编码于商业条款、并将决策权下放到知识所在处。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合失败的三个结构性原则：整合是结构问题而非文化问题；赋权需要能力验证与激励对齐；横向连接必须预先设计。将组织设计理论延伸至复杂基础设施项目情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合同设计（尤其是NEC合同套件的改革）、项目领导力诊断提供了具体指导；展示了Tideway和A14项目中横向连接机制的实际运作方式。

title: AI Comes at a Cost
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: AI Comes at a Cost

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it is a systematic literature review and synthesis of publicly available published research, and does not involve direct data collection from human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence has emerged as one of the most transformative technological forces in human history. The speed and scale of AI adoption are unprecedented-ChatGPT reached 100 million users in two months, and by 2026 over 400 million users generate 15 billion queries weekly. However, this rapid integration raises urgent questions about hidden costs to human cognition, skills, and society. This paper provides a comprehensive, evidence-based examination of AI's promises and perils. It synthesizes findings from recent empirical studies including the Microsoft 2025 Critical Thinking survey (n=319 knowledge workers), the Springer 2025 scoping review on AI addiction (27.8% prevalence), the Duke 2025 creativity study (47% higher homogeneity in AI output), the Yurt and Kuşci 2025 study (n=422, β =-0.37, p<.001 for AI use on critical thinking), the Save My Exams 2026 survey (93% of students using AI), and the NBER 2026 economic forecasting study (10 million potential job losses under rapid AI scenarios). The paper introduces the concept of Cognitive Dependency Syndrome, examines AI's impact across employment, education, mental health, geopolitics, and existential risk, and proposes a five-level AI Use Maturity Model as a practical framework for balanced integration. The central argument is that AI's long-term impact will be determined by the intentionality with which societies approach regulation, education, and the preservation of essential human skills.

AI.tldr: 本文全面审视AI的承诺与风险，引入"认知依赖综合征"概念，提出五级AI使用成熟度模型，论证AI的长期影响取决于社会在监管、教育和保护人类核心技能方面的意图性。
AI.research_question: AI的快速普及对人类认知能力、技能和社会带来了哪些隐藏成本？如何在利用AI优势的同时避免认知退化等风险？
AI.motivation: AI以史无前例的速度渗透生活（ChatGPT两月破亿用户），但对其认知、技能和社会层面的负面影响缺乏系统性、证据为基础的审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知依赖综合征（Cognitive Dependency Syndrome）；AI使用成熟度五级模型（AI Use Maturity Model）
AI.method: 综合多项近期实证研究：Microsoft 2025批判性思维调查（n=319）、Springer 2025 AI成瘾范围综述（患病率27.8%）、Duke 2025创造力研究（AI输出同质性高47%）、Yurt & Kuşci 2025研究（n=422, β=-0.37, p<.001）、Save My Exams 2026调查（93%学生使用AI）、NBER 2026经济预测（快速AI场景下1000万潜在失业）
AI.findings: AI使用与批判性思维显著负相关（β=-0.37）；AI成瘾患病率约27.8%；AI输出导致创造力同质性增加47%；学生AI使用率高达93%；快速AI采用可能导致1000万岗位流失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"认知依赖综合征"这一新概念，系统刻画AI过度依赖导致的认知能力退化现象；构建"五级AI使用成熟度模型"，为平衡AI整合提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、教育工作者和个体提供可操作的AI使用指南和监管建议，帮助在享受AI红利同时保护人类核心认知技能。

title: Response Adaptivity Across Clinical Trials in Portfolios of Biomedical Innovations
affiliations: , INSEAD - Technology and Operations Management and Cornell University - School of Operations Research and Information Engineering

detail.title: Response Adaptivity Across Clinical Trials in Portfolios of Biomedical Innovations
detail.abstract: New medical treatments are costly to develop and unlikely to successfully make their way through clinical trials, market access, and reimbursement. Moreover, new treatments for rare diseases are limited in both patient populations and reimbursement levels, further reducing their attractiveness as an investment. To increase the incentive to develop new treatments, portfolios of investments in new treatments in clinical trials have been proposed to financially de-risk drug development. We explore an important lever for further improving the incentives to develop treatments that is new in the context of biomedical portfolios: response-adaptive pilot studies in clinical trials that allow investments to be adjusted across projects as data are observed and that account for the importance of cost-effectiveness in gaining market access. We propose and analyze a model that shows that even a modest level of response adaptivity can materially improve financial outcomes from portfolios and improve the chances of new treatments making it to market, particularly when investment amounts are limited. We derive expected value of information heuristics to guide clinical trial management in the portfolio and the design of the portfolio, and use an illustrative numerical study motivated by pediatric oncology to show the value of using response-adaptive pilots for improving financial and health access outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在生物医药投资组合中采用响应自适应试点试验，以改善新药研发的财务激励和市场准入结果，特别是在罕见病和投资有限的情况下。
AI.research_question: 响应自适应试点研究如何在生物医药投资组合中改善新药研发的财务激励和市场准入结果？
AI.motivation: 新药研发成本高、成功率低，罕见病药物因患者群体有限和报销水平低而缺乏投资吸引力。需要新的机制来降低药物开发财务风险并提高研发激励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合理论、响应自适应实验设计、预期信息价值（Expected Value of Information）启发式方法。
AI.method: 建立数学模型分析响应自适应对投资组合财务结果的影响；推导预期信息价值启发式方法用于指导临床试验管理和投资组合设计；以儿童肿瘤学为背景进行数值模拟研究。
AI.findings: 即使是适度的响应自适应水平也能显著改善投资组合的财务结果，提高新药上市的可能性，特别是在投资金额有限的情况下。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将响应自适应试验设计引入生物医药投资组合背景，提出预期信息价值启发式方法用于动态调整跨项目投资。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制药公司和投资者提供了一种新的风险管理工具，有助于提高罕见病药物研发的投资吸引力，改善患者的药物可及性。

detail.abstract:
This is an amicus brief in support of affirmance in EPA et al. v Green & Healthy Homes Initiative, Inc. et al., (D.C. Md. 1:25-cv-01096).  Amicus is interested in ensuring that contractors, grantees, and others who do business with the Government and/or participate in Government funded programs are treated fairly when pursuing their rights and remedies and also ensuring that public institutions (particularly the courts) appreciate and account for the many ways that Congressional mandates, public contracts, grants, cooperative agreements, and other funding mechanisms impact  the public's quality of life.

The brief asserts that the Government errs and does a disservice to the public interest in suggesting that any challenge relating to the termination of a federal grant or cooperative agreement is necessarily a garden-variety breach of contract claim that must be pigeon-holed within the cramped jurisdiction of the U.S. Court of Federal Claims.

The brief explains that: (1) federal (procurement) contracts and federal assistance agreements are distinct, fundamentally different governance tools and that different dispute resolution regimes apply to each; (2) the Court of Federal Claims' Tucker Act jurisdiction does not foreclose federal district court review of all matters related to federal assistance; and (3) that the long-familiar approach - determining the appropriate forum for each claim through the process of matter- and claim-specific consideration (Bowen, Megapulse) - makes good sense.

The brief was prepared by David Livshiz, Nathaniel Castellano, Jayna Rust, Catherine Katz & Miguel Serrano.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份法庭之友意见书，支持维持原判，主张联邦拨款和合作协议的终止争议不应被简单归为合同违约案件而推至联邦索赔法院管辖，而应区分采购合同与资助协议的不同法律性质，并采用逐案审查的方式确定适当管辖法院。
AI.research_question: 联邦拨款或合作协议终止引发的争议，是否应当被归类为普通合同违约之诉并仅限于联邦索赔法院管辖？
AI.motivation: 确保与政府有业务往来或参与政府资助项目的承包商、受资助方等在寻求权利救济时受到公平对待，并确保公共机构（特别是法院）认识到国会授权、公共合同、拨款等机制对公众生活质量的广泛影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦采购合同与联邦资助协议是性质不同的治理工具，适用不同的争议解决机制；联邦索赔法院的塔克法管辖权并不排除联邦地区法院对所有与联邦资助相关事项的审查。
AI.method: 法律论证与分析，援引先例（如Bowen案、Megapulse案）确立的逐案审查方法。
AI.findings: 政府将拨款终止争议简单归为合同违约之诉，是错误的，且损害了公共利益；应区分联邦采购合同与联邦资助协议，并适用不同的争议解决机制；联邦地区法院对某些联邦资助事项仍具有管辖权。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了联邦采购合同与联邦资助协议在法律性质上的根本区别，以及由此产生的不同管辖和救济路径，丰富了对政府行为法律分类的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临联邦资助终止的受资助方提供了更灵活的救济路径选择，避免被强行纳入联邦索赔法院的有限管辖，有助于保护受资助方的合法权益，维护政府资助项目的公平性。

detail.title: After ARIHQ: The Non-Delegable Arbitration Mandate in the Age of A
detail.abstract: In April 2026, the Superior Court of Quebec annulled an arbitral award for the first time in the world on the ground that the arbitrator had taken his reasoning from a generative AI tool whose every cited authority was a hallucination. The decision was reported within days across the global arbitration community. It has been read as a Quebec curiosity, as a cautionary tale for counsel, and as the empirical case that the leading skeptics of AI soft law had said did not yet exist. It is each of these things. It is also something more useful: a long-awaited application of an old principle to a new tool. The arbitrator's mandate is personal. It is the reason the parties chose this arbitrator and not another. It can be supported by tools. It cannot be transferred to them. The arbitrator may take help. The arbitrator may not transfer the decision.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2026年魁北克高等法院全球首次因仲裁员使用生成式AI工具产生幻觉引用而撤销仲裁裁决的案例，论证该判决本质是将"仲裁员职责具有人身性"这一古老原则应用于新工具：仲裁员可以借助工具，但不得将决策权转移给AI。
AI.research_question: 当仲裁员依赖生成式AI工具进行推理并引用幻觉性权威时，该行为在法律上如何定性？"仲裁员职责的人身性"原则如何适用于AI时代？
AI.motivation: 该判决是AI软法怀疑论者等待的实证案例，但此前学界多将其视为地方性奇闻或警示故事，缺乏从根本原则角度的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仲裁员职责的人身性（personal mandate）原则：仲裁员的选任基于其个人资质，裁决权力不可转移给他人或工具。
AI.method: 案例分析法，结合仲裁法基本原则与AI技术特性进行规范性论证。
AI.findings: 判决表面上是关于AI幻觉的警示，实质是人身性原则对AI工具适用的经典判例：仲裁员可借助工具协助，但不得将实质决策权转移给AI。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"仲裁员职责人身性"原则在AI时代提供了首个权威司法适用；区分了"借助工具"与"转移决策"的界限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际仲裁实践提供了明确的行为边界：AI可作为辅助工具，但最终推理和裁决必须由仲裁员独立完成。

detail.abstract: The confluence of global energy transitions, the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution, and great power militarism is causing demand and prices for critical minerals to surge. China has weaponized export controls on critical minerals as part of the ongoing US-China technology and trade wars. Many mineral-rich middle-income and developing economies are eager to move up the value chains from just producing ore to also refining and processing these materials and are using export restrictions as leverage to encourage inward investment. Meanwhile, the United States remains highly dependent on imports of these minerals, including rare and heavy rare earth elements, which are critical for semiconductors, renewable energy, and national defense applications. AI.tldr: 本文分析了全球能源转型、人工智能革命和大国军事化背景下，关键矿产需求激增及其引发的供应链安全问题。研究了美国通过Project Vault（120亿美元战略储备计划）应对中国关键矿产出口管制和资源民族主义的策略，探讨了该计划作为保险机制的设计挑战。
AI.research_question: 美国如何通过关键矿产战略储备（Project Vault）有效应对供应链中断风险？该储备计划作为保险机制应如何设计才能克服市场失灵问题？
AI.motivation: 全球能源转型和AI革命导致关键矿产需求激增，中国已武器化出口管制，矿产丰富的发展中国家也利用出口限制提升价值链地位，而美国高度依赖进口，供应链中断可能造成巨大经济和社会成本，因此研究战略储备方案具有紧迫性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 保险市场理论：分析Project Vault作为保险机制如何应对逆向选择和道德风险等市场失灵问题；供应链风险管理理论；资源安全与地缘政治经济学。
AI.method: 政策分析与案例研究：基于美国Project Vault计划的设计框架，结合保险市场理论和供应链风险管理原则，分析战略储备方案的有效性。
AI.findings: 供应链中断风险构成战略储备的充分理由；Project Vault作为保险机制必须解决逆向选择和道德风险问题；储备计划的设计需要兼顾保险市场运作原理才能有效发挥安全网作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将保险市场理论应用于关键矿产战略储备分析，揭示了政府储备计划设计中的市场失灵问题及其解决路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国Project Vault计划的设计提供政策建议，指出战略储备作为保险机制需要解决逆向选择和道德风险问题，为其他依赖关键矿产进口的国家提供参考。

title: Green in the Shadow. The Information View on Green Banking Regulation
affiliations: University of Amsterdam - University of Amsterdam Faculty of Law and University of Wroclaw

detail.title: Green in the Shadow. The Information View on Green Banking Regulation

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Banking Institute Working Paper Series No. 210
publicationDetails.journalName: European Banking Institute (EBI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We investigate the hurdles to the effective implementation of sustainable banking regulation. We argue that existing approaches rest on an implicit assumption of verifiable asset quality, which is inconsistent with the informational structure of banking. Accordingly, we develop an analytical framework centred on structural asset opacity and information asymmetry: banks operate through opaque balance sheets and possess superior information about asset quality relative to both markets and supervisors. This opacity generates moral hazard in the asset classification when regulatory incentives tied to ‘green’ or ‘brown’ labels induce strategic misrepresentation and adverse selection.

We recast the main regulatory tools proposed in the literature. The analysis shows that incorporating sustainability objectives into prudential requirements, particularly capital regulation, is prone to distortion under conditions of unverifiable information, while supervisory tools remain constrained by their reliance on bank-generated data. We advance an alternative approach based on mandatory contractual mechanisms embedded in lending relationships. Properly designed and supervised, these private law tools operate as sorting devices that differentiate between green and brown activities without requiring full information about asset quality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可持续银行监管实施中的障碍，指出现有监管依赖可验证资产质量这一隐含假设与银行信息结构不符。作者基于资产不透明和信息不对称构建分析框架，认为绿色/棕色标签引发的道德风险会导致资产分类扭曲，并提出基于强制性契约机制的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 可持续银行监管有效实施的障碍是什么？如何在信息不对称条件下设计有效的监管工具？
AI.motivation: 现有可持续银行监管方法隐含假设资产质量可验证，但银行本质上具有资产不透明和信息不对称特征，导致监管激励扭曲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产结构性不透明、信息不对称、道德风险、逆向选择、契约理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架，对现有监管工具进行重新审视并提出替代方案。
AI.findings: 将可持续目标纳入审慎要求（尤其是资本监管）易在信息不可验证条件下产生扭曲；监管工具受限于依赖银行生成数据；强制性契约机制可在无需完全信息条件下区分绿色和棕色活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了可持续银行监管中信息不可验证性的根本困境，建立了资产不透明性与监管激励扭曲之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出基于强制性契约机制（嵌入贷款关系中的私人法律工具）的替代监管路径，为政策制定者提供了不依赖完全信息即可实现绿色分类的可行方案。

detail.title: AI Gatekeepers

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 932/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The paper gives an overview on what established gatekeeper theory on financial markets was designed to achieve. It moves on to introduce three groups of AI-gatekeepers: established auditors, new entrants, and publicly accredited gatekeepers. Then, the paper describes designated AI-laws and designated AI-gatekeepers, both optional and mandatory. It concludes with a preliminary roadmap for regulating AI-gatekeepers.

The paper makes three contributions to the debate. First, it shows why a transplant of the proposal to introduce a version of strict gatekeeper liability from the financial-market setting is inadequate for AI-gatekeepers. Second, it suggests a two-layer transparency regime: aggregate disclosure of testing methodologies and standards, combined with compact certifications or scores at the individual level. Third, the paper proposes ex ante governance requirements operating at two sites: At the gatekeeper itself, through accreditation and independence requirements modelled on the EU's notified-body regime. Additionally, at the interface of the gatekeeper with the client, through institutional structures analogous to the audit committee but designed for the interdisciplinary translation problem that distinguishes AI-compliance review from classical audit.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将金融市场的"看门人"理论迁移至AI治理领域的可行性，提出了针对AI看门人的双层透明度和事前治理要求，并构建了初步的监管路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和监管AI领域的看门人（AI-gatekeepers），使其有效发挥治理作用？
AI.motivation: 金融市场中的看门人理论（如审计师、评级机构）已较为成熟，但AI治理面临独特的透明度、专业性和责任分配挑战，直接移植金融市场的严格看门人责任制度并不适用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 看门人理论（gatekeeper theory）；严格看门人责任（strict gatekeeper liability）；透明度制度（transparency regime）；事前治理（ex ante governance）
AI.method: 概念分析与比较法研究：将金融市场的看门人理论与AI治理情境进行对比分析，提出制度设计方案。
AI.findings: 1）金融市场的严格看门人责任移植到AI领域不充分；2）提出了双层透明度制度（总体披露+个体认证/评分）；3）提出了两处事前治理要求：看门人自身（认证与独立性，参照欧盟公告机构制度）及看门人-客户界面（类似审计委员会的跨学科翻译机制）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融看门人理论向AI领域移植的局限性；提出了适应AI特殊性的双层透明度和双层事前治理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI监管政策制定提供了初步路线图；区分了三类AI看门人（传统审计师、新进入者、公共认证看门人）；设计了可选和强制性的AI法律及AI看门人制度框架。
